izzyondroid:com.audiosoftware.jaliscope.name: Jaliscope
izzyondroid:com.audiosoftware.jaliscope.summary: A vectorscope program centered around performance, accuracy, and customizability
izzyondroid:com.audiosoftware.jaliscope.description:
This is an audio visualizer program , it takes audio files and converts them to lines rendered on screen where you can modify them as you desire with the functions available inside the buttons! Such program is sometimes classified as a Vectorscope Program , or a Lissajous Plot program to be specific.
 First thing you see when you boot up the program is a rendering of the sound being currently played, and they are being used to play a nice tune.
 HOW was it made?
 The program is built using C++ , and by using the SDL3 library for the renderings, and the MINIAUDIO single-header library for the audio playback buffering.
 CONTROLS
 When you tap the screen, 9 buttons in abstract minimal style shows up, layered on the edges of the screen before you, each one of them has a functionality.
 Make a double tap under 500 milliseconds , and the audio stops, the rendering with it.
 Starting clockwise from the bottom left, we have:
 SCALE: scales up, or down, the rendering window of the lines, it doesn't scale up the rendering view, but rather scales up the allowed space the lines can render in!
 MISCELLANEOUS: houses many options and settings that affects the rendering and sound, like Rotating the rendered lines! or Adjusting the audio buffer's size! or saving your preferences and many more!
 FILE: Clicking it opens the platform's file selector for choosing the audio file you wish to render.
 THEME: shows 3 slider bars for changing the theme of the program as a whole, Red bar on the left, Green bar on the bottom, Blue bar on the right, making all colors zero won't make the GUI invisible, so don't worry about that :D
 SPLINES: One of the most fun parts of the program. It allows you to change the number of lines that are drawn onto screen! Making a soothing real-time drawing of the lines, or letting you draw over 8000 lines on screen in a second. it's your choice!
 X/Y PADDING: lets you move the rendering in any position without screen bounds!
 SPEED: resamples the sample rate of the audio, which changes the pitch and tempo of the audio down the thousandth (0.001)!
 SEEKER: instant seeking to any part of the audio down the milliseconds, with the audio time being on-top the seeking bar.
 VOLUME: As the name and button suggests, you change the in-program audio volume.
 Some Quirks
 Changing the frames chunk size can flush the audio buffer, which skips some chunk of the audio, with this, you can flush the buffers on the audio's halfbeat to make the audio play in a swing rhythm!
 Rotating the rendering fast enough can give a stroboscopic effect for the rendering lines. In my opinion, this is very mesmerizing!
 Add that with the splines changing at your whim, and you'd get a virtually infinite numbers of combos!
 IMPORTANT NOTES!
 For now, the app can ONLY process the following audio formats: FLAC , WAV , MP3 . Ogg, and Opus formats, will be supported in future releases.

fdroid:com.goldmaster.im2sms.name: IM2SMS
fdroid:com.goldmaster.im2sms.summary: A simple app to import IM chat histories into Android’s SMS storage.
fdroid:com.goldmaster.im2sms.description:
A simple app to import IM chat histories into Android’s SMS storage.
 Features 
 Easy Import: 
Import chats directly from an IM app's share menu or by browsing the phone's storage for exported chat files.
 Chat Preview: 
Preview individual chats before importing into SMS.
 Material You: 
The app's theme and icon automatically adapts to the phone's wallpaper and system colours.
 Dark Mode: 
Automatically switches between light and dark themes based on the phone's settings.
 Supported Apps 
 Currently Supported: 
 WhatsApp: Use the 'Export chat' option within WhatsApp and share the exported file with IM2SMS. Or browse previously exported chats and view both individual and group chats.
 Telegram: The mobile app does not support exporting a chat backup via the share menu, but can be done using the desktop version, by exporting to JSON format and transferring the export to the phone.
 Planned Support: 
 Facebook Messenger: Support for importing from a Facebook data takeout is planned.
 Telegram: Future support is planned.
 Signal: Future support is planned via backup files or secure backups.
 FAQ 
 Will an iOS version be available? 
No. Due to technical limitations, iOS does not allow third-party apps to write to the SMS database.
 Why export to SMS? 
SMS is a universal, device-native format. By converting chat histories to SMS, you get a durable, open-standard backup that isn't locked into a single proprietary app.
 Why the name? 
The name stands for Instant Messenger to SMS. It reflects the app’s broad support for multiple IM platforms beyond just WhatsApp.
 Can group chats be imported? 
There is basic support for importing group chats, however, there are significant limitations due to how Android and apps like Google Messages handle the legacy SMS/MMS storage. At present, there is no way for third-party apps to programmatically set a group chat name in the system's SMS database that Google Messages will recognise, so the chat name will typically appear as a list of participant numbers. Additionally, a "Mass Text" warning may show if Google Messages cannot verify that all participants are using modern RCS (Rich Communication Services). To fully continue a group chat as a single thread, all members must be using RCS. Once everyone is on RCS, the group chat should automatically "upgrade" and function as a normal group thread.
 Can I use IM2SMS to back up my existing SMS messages? 
The core purpose of IM2SMS is to import Instant Messenger chat histories into the phone's SMS storage. However, before an import, a backup of the current sms storage is made. Under Settings, there is an option to restore the latest snapshot or browse and restore. This feature has been added to comply with Google requirements.
 Why does the app have to be set as the default SMS app? 
Android only allows the current default SMS app to write to the system's message database. To import chats, IM2SMS must temporarily become the default app. After the import process completes, opening the preferred messaging app provides a prompt to restore it as the default.
 Contributing 
 If you find this app useful, please consider donating via PayPal or Patreon . If donation is not possible, please visit our source code repository to learn how to contribute through code and testing.

fdroid:net.alexbarry.calc_android.name: AlexCalc
fdroid:net.alexbarry.calc_android.summary: Scientific calculator with LaTeX equation display, buttons and plaintext input
fdroid:net.alexbarry.calc_android.description:
AlexCalc is a scientific calculator with some neat features (note: also available as a web app at https://alexbarry.github.io/AlexCalc/ ):
 nicely formatted (LaTeX) equation display. This avoids the need to count brackets to make sure the equation was entered correctly. Also includes LaTeX code generation.
 complex number support, in rectangular or polar form (e.g. `3 + 4i` or `1 angle 90`)
 variable storage (e.g. `123 -> x` then `3*x^2 - 4*x + 5 -> y`)
 units in equations, and conversion (e.g. `1 inch * 3 ft to cm^2` or `sqrt(60 acre) - 100 ft`)
 can enter input by button presses, typing, or copy/pasting. Button presses are all converted to plaintext input for easy copy/pasting.
 equation display is simplified upon pressing enter. This means that when entering an equation, it is usually possible to look only at the LaTeX display and not the plaintext input: but when pressing enter, it will look nice. Redundant brackets are removed, including those that are needed for plaintext input (e.g. `(a + b)/(c + d)` can become "a + b" on the numerator and "c + d" on the denominator without brackets).
 light/dark themes
 previous input history can be accessed and edited by pressing "up" or "down" buttons.
 previous inputs/vars/recently used units preserved when the app is closed
 standard scientific calculator features, such as:
 trigonometric functions: sin, cos, tan, arcsin, arccos, arctan
 base 10 and natural logarithmic functions: log (base 10), ln (base e)
 `e`, `pi` constants, and square root function
 scientific notation input (e.g. `1.23E6` is 1.23 times 10^6)

Paltalk is a global community platform built around live, topic-based chat rooms.
Join thousands of active rooms organized around shared interests such as music, culture, sports, current events, and more. Each room centers on a specific topic, creating space for group discussions to grow naturally within a community setting. Take part in live group conversations using video, voice, or text, or simply listen and follow along. You choose how you participate. Paltalk focuses on interest-based rooms and structured community spaces designed for group interaction. Community experience is supported with safety in mind. Chat rooms include active moderators, room management tools, reporting options, and community guidelines to help maintain respectful and welcoming discussions.
With over 20 years of experience in social technology, Paltalk provides a stable and reliable environment for live group communication across desktop and mobile devices.
Download the app and join live community rooms built around your interests.
LIVE COMMUNITY CHAT ROOMS
• International Community vs. Local Flavor. Whether you’re looking to learn a new language, rock out to your favorite song, or examine the social issues in your city elections, Paltalk has a room for you. Explore thousands of active rooms organized around shared interests and ongoing group discussions.
GROUP VIDEO, VOICE, AND TEXT
• Participate in live conversations within structured rooms and choose how you engage in each community space. Upgrade to join more rooms simultaneously. Plus, no extra fees for international messaging or calling.
REAL-TIME MODERATION AND SAFETY TOOLS FOR LIVE CHAT ROOMS
• Live human room moderators
• Room management controls
• One-tap reporting
• Community guidelines
• AI Safety filters
CREATE YOUR OWN ROOM
• Can’t find a specific topic? Create a group and host your own room. Start a topic-based room and guide discussions using built-in management tools.
VIRTUAL GIFTS AND RECOGNITION
• Send virtual gifts within rooms and earn recognition within the Paltalk community, with special appearances from pop culture characters and brands you love; try sending gifts to say hello in a room. Each gift sent or received earns points toward special status as a Paltalk Crown member.
ACCESS ANYWHERE
• Join from desktop or mobile and stay part of your favorite community rooms wherever you are. Paltalk will even run in the background of your device if you want to listen to your favorite room or talk to a friend while you read emails. Never miss a great moment again.
If you enjoy the Paltalk community, we appreciate your review. For support, contact ptmobile@paltalk.com. We read and respond to every message.

apple-macos:1541027222.name: ScreenZen- Screen Time Control
apple-macos:1541027222.description:
Multiple strategies to reduce your screentime
1. Delay before opening your app: A bit of time before choosing if you need to open your distracting app. You can have the wait time increase each time you open your app.
2. Interrupt your scrolling: Check your distracting apps for short periods of time so you don't get sucked in.
3. Set an app goal and optionally block when you reach your limit.
4. Configurable for different days of the week and time by app.
5. Messages like "Is this important" before opening your app.
6. See your screen time for only your distracting apps. Don't worry about Google Maps bloating up your time.
7. Strict block your apps: Either for time ranges, after a certain number of opens or ScreenTime.
8. Locks on Settings to prevent you from changing your settings when you want to open an app.
9. Breathing and other activities to encourage you not to need to open the app while waiting for it to unlock.
10. Streaks to encourage you not to exceed your limits or override your settings.

apple-macos:288419283.name: RadarScope
apple-macos:288419283.summary: Download RadarScope by Base Velocity, LLC on the App Store. See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips, and more apps like RadarScope.
apple-macos:288419283.description:
RadarScope is an AMS-award-winning weather visualization tool that empowers meteorologists, public safety officials, storm spotters, and weather enthusiasts to view a full suite of single-site radar data and related severe weather products. Your initial purchase provides professional radar visualization in a fully native app, free from distracting and invasive practices, with optional subscription packages to add even more capabilities.
Whether you’re scanning for a mesocyclone’s tell-tale hook echo, pinpointing the landfall of a hurricane’s eye wall, or identifying velocity couplet, hail spike, or debris ball signatures, RadarScope displays native radar data in its original radial format. You see what the radar sees almost as soon as the radar sees it, with automatic updates every two to ten minutes depending on the radar’s scanning strategy.
Your initial app purchase includes the following:
• Full suite of single-site radar products for the US, Canada, Guam, Denmark, Finland, and Germany
• 10-frame radar loops
• Two built-in providers for radar data
• Tornado, thunderstorm, flash flood, marine, snow squall, extreme wind, tropical, and other warnings in the US
• Selected severe weather warnings in Canada and Australia
• Severe weather watches in the US and Canada
• NWS-generated storm tracks with hail, TVS, and mesocyclone attributes
• Inspector and distance tools
• Color palette options for radar data
• Weather Pulse data plan integration
• Spotter Network integration for storm and location reporting
• mPING integration for submitting weather reports to NSSL
• Bundled maps with political borders, water bodies, and highways, optimized for low-bandwidth use
• Support for widgets and complications
• Universal app for Apple platforms, including Apple Watch, and Apple TV
• CarPlay support
• Family Sharing support
RadarScope Pro Tier One is an optional annual subscription that adds more features for tracking severe weather:
• 30-frame radar loops
• Cloud-to-ground lightning strikes
• Special weather statements in the US and Canada
• Mesoscale convective and precipitation discussions
• SPC convective, tornado, hail, wind, and fire outlooks
• WPC excessive rainfall outlooks in the US
• Local storm reports in the US
• Custom color palette support
• Multi-pane display (2 on phones; 4 on larger devices)
• Family Sharing support
RadarScope Pro Tier Two is an optional annual or monthly subscription that transforms RadarScope into a more complete visualization tool for a larger suite of weather products, including:
• Everything in Pro Tier One
• 50-frame radar loops
• A third provider for US radar data
• 30-year archive of NEXRAD Level II radar data
• 6-year archive of NEXRAD Level III data
• 30-day archive of super-res and non-US radar data
• 20-year archive of NWS bulletins
• GOES satellite data
• Multi-Radar Multi-Sensor (MRMS) data
• Real-Time Mesoscale Assimilation (RTMA) data
• GFS, ECMWF, HRRR, HRW, NAM, and RRFS model data
• Surface observations
• ProbSevere layer
• Atmospheric soundings in the US
• Hail size, hail probability, and azimuthal shear contours with a 30-day archive
• More detailed transportation and satellite imagery maps
• Custom color palette support for GOES, MRMS, RTMA, and forecast products
• Server-sent events for radar and warning updates
• Cross-platform subscription sharing on up to 5 devices
If you choose to buy a RadarScope Pro subscription, it will be charged to your App Store account. The subscription will be auto-renewed within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the same price you originally paid. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal disabled via your App Store account settings after the purchase. Once purchased, the subscription cannot be canceled during the active subscription period.

Please visit our web site for more information.

flathub:com.dosbox_x.DOSBox-X.name: DOSBox-X
flathub:com.dosbox_x.DOSBox-X.summary: x86/DOS emulator with sound and graphics
flathub:com.dosbox_x.DOSBox-X.description:
DOSBox-X is an open-source DOS emulator for running DOS games and applications.
DOS-based Windows such as Windows 3.x and Windows 9x are officially supported.
Compared to DOSBox, DOSBox-X is much more flexible and provides more features.
 DOSBox-X emulates a PC necessary for running many DOS games and applications that simply cannot be run on modern PCs and operating systems, similar to DOSBox. However, while the main focus of DOSBox is for running DOS games, DOSBox-X goes much further than this. Started as a fork of the DOSBox project, it retains compatibility with the wide base of DOS games and DOS gaming DOSBox was designed for. But it is also a platform for running DOS applications, including emulating the environments to run Windows 3.x, 9x and ME and software written for those versions of Windows. By adding official support for Windows 95, 98, and ME emulation and acceleration, we hope that those old Windows games and applications could be enjoyed or used once more. Moreover, DOSBox-X adds support for emulating the NEC PC-98 such that you can also play PC-98 games with it.
 DOSBox-X emulates a legacy IBM PC and DOS environment, and has many emulation options which you can find documented on the DOSBox-X website.

fedora-packages:bsp/bsp.name: bsp
fedora-packages:bsp/bsp.summary: The most popular node builder for Doom
fedora-packages:bsp/bsp.description: Before you can play a level that you have created, you must use a node builder to create the data that Doom will use to render the level. Doom uses a rendering algorithm based on a binary space partition, otherwise known as a BSP tree. This is stored in a data lump called NODES in the WAD file. This data structure must be pre-calculated and stored in the WAD file before the level can be played; the tool that does this is called a node builder. BSP is one of several node builders that can do this. There are others: idbsp is the original node builder that id Software used on the original Doom levels, for instance. BSP was the best known and most widely used node builder throughout the height of the Doom editing craze in the mid 1990s.

fedora-packages:e00compr/e00compr-devel.name: e00compr-devel
fedora-packages:e00compr/e00compr-devel.description: E00compr is an ANSI C library that reads and writes Arc/Info compressed E00 files. Both “PARTIAL” and “FULL” compression levels are supported. This package can be divided in three parts: • The ‘e00conv’ command-line program. This program takes a E00 file as input (compressed or not) and copies it to a new file with the requested compression level (NONE, PARTIAL or FULL). • A set of library functions to read compressed E00 files. These functions read a E00 file (compressed or not) and return a stream of uncompressed lines, making the E00 file appear as if it was not compressed. • A set of library functions to write compressed E00 files. These functions take one line after another from what should be a uncompressed E00 file, and write them to a file with the requested compression level, either NONE, PARTIAL or FULL. The e00compr-devel package contains libraries and header files for developing applications that use e00compr.

fedora-packages:gfs-theokritos-fonts/gfs.name: gfs-theokritos-fonts
fedora-packages:gfs-theokritos-fonts/gfs.summary: GFS Theokritos, a 20th century decorative Greek font family
fedora-packages:gfs-theokritos-fonts/gfs.description: Yannis Kefallinos (1894–1958) was one of the most innovative engravers of his generation and the first who researched methodically the aesthetics of book and typographic design in Greece. He taught at the Fine Arts School of Athens and established the first book design workshop from which many practicing artists of the 60’s and 70’s had graduated. In the late 50’s Kefallinos designed and published an exquisite book with engraved illustrations of the ancient white funerary pottery in Attica in collaboration with Varlamos, Montesanto, Damianakis. For the text of Kefallinos’ Δέκα λευκαί λήκυθοι (1956) the artist used a typeface which he himself had designed a few years before for an unrealized edition of Theocritos’ Idyls. Its complex and heavily decorative design does point to aesthetic codes which preoccupied his artistic expression and, although impractical for contemporary text setting, it remains an original display face, or it can be used as initials. The book design workshop of the Fine Arts School of Athens has been recently reorganized, under the direction of professor Leoni Vidali, and with her collaboration George D. Matthiopoulos has redesigned digitally this historical font which is now available as GFS Theokritos.

fedora-packages:ghc-esqueleto/ghc-esquel.name: ghc-esqueleto
fedora-packages:ghc-esqueleto/ghc-esquel.summary: Type-safe EDSL for SQL queries on persistent backends
fedora-packages:ghc-esqueleto/ghc-esquel.description: 'esqueleto' is a bare bones, type-safe EDSL for SQL queries that works with unmodified 'persistent' SQL backends. Its language closely resembles SQL, so you don't have to learn new concepts, just new syntax, and it's fairly easy to predict the generated SQL and optimize it for your backend. Most kinds of errors committed when writing SQL are caught as compile-time errors---although it is possible to write type-checked 'esqueleto' queries that fail at runtime. 'persistent' is a library for type-safe data serialization. It has many kinds of backends, such as SQL backends ('persistent-mysql', 'persistent-postgresql', 'persistent-sqlite') and NoSQL backends ('persistent-mongoDB'). While 'persistent' is a nice library for storing and retrieving records, including with filters, it does not try to support some of the features that are specific to SQL backends. In particular, 'esqueleto' is the recommended library for type-safe 'JOIN's on 'persistent' SQL backends. (The alternative is using raw SQL, but that's error prone and does not offer any composability.) Currently, 'SELECT's, 'UPDATE's, 'INSERT's and 'DELETE's are supported. Not all SQL features are available, but most of them can be easily added (especially functions), so please open an issue or send a pull request if you need anything that is not covered by 'esqueleto' on <https://github.com/bitemyapp/esqueleto>. The name of this library means "skeleton" in Portuguese and contains all three SQL letters in the correct order =). It was inspired by Scala's Squeryl but created from scratch.

fedora-packages:ghc-hashable/ghc-hashabl.name: ghc-hashable
fedora-packages:ghc-hashable/ghc-hashabl.summary: A class for types that can be converted to a hash value
fedora-packages:ghc-hashable/ghc-hashabl.description: This package defines a class, 'Hashable', for types that can be converted to a hash value. This class exists for the benefit of hashing-based data structures. The package provides instances for basic types and a way to combine hash values. 'Hashable' is intended exclusively for use in in-memory data structures. 'Hashable' does /not/ have a fixed standard. This allows it to improve over time. Because it does not have a fixed standard, different computers or computers on different versions of the code will observe different hash values. As such, 'hashable' is not recommended for use other than in-memory datastructures. Specifically, 'hashable' is not intended for network use or in applications which persist hashed values. For stable hashing use named hashes: sha256, crc32, xxhash etc.

The goal of this project is to implement various new algorithms and benchmark them on various compiler and architectures. HPCombi was initially designed using the SSE and AVX instruction sets, and did not work on machines without these instructions (such as ARM). From v1.0.0 HPCombi supports processors with other instruction sets also, via SIMD Everywhere. It might be the case that the greatest performance gains are achieved on processors supporting the SSE and AVX instruction sets, but the HPCombi benchmarks indicate that there are also still significant gains on other processors too.

fedora-packages:python-locket/python3-lo.description: Locket implements a lock that can be used by multiple processes provided they use the same path. Locks largely behave as (non-reentrant) Lock instances from the threading module in the standard library. Specifically, their behaviour is: * Locks are uniquely identified by the file being locked, both in the same process and across different processes. * Locks are either in a locked or unlocked state. * When the lock is unlocked, calling acquire() returns immediately and changes the lock state to locked. * When the lock is locked, calling acquire() will block until the lock state changes to unlocked, or until the timeout expires. * If a process holds a lock, any thread in that process can call release() to change the state to unlocked. * Behaviour of locks after fork is undefined.

Facebook Privacy Guard helps protect your privacy while browsing Facebook by automatically blurring selected visual and identifying content.

firefox-addons:740644.name: Toggl Track: Productivity & Time Tracker
firefox-addons:740644.summary: Puts a timer into any web tool and allows quick real time productivity tracking with all the data stored on your Toggl Track account. Time tracking has never been easier!
firefox-addons:740644.description:
Whether you use Salesforce, Producteev, Slack, Trello, Todoist, Asana, Basecamp, Google Drive or one of the 90+ integrated tools, start tracking time without opening a new tab. Toggl Track timer can now also fill your Pomodoro needs through automated reminders.
If you were looking for Toggl Button, you're in the right place -> we've just rebranded as Toggl Track, but the functionality of the extension remains the same (and we also switched colors a bit as well).
Toggl Track extension is already available in: Toggl Plan, Pivotal Tracker, Github, Asana, Unfuddle, Gitlab, Trello, Worksection, Redbooth, Podio, Basecamp, JIRA, Producteev, Bitbucket, Stifer, Google Docs, Redmine, YouTrack, CapsuleCRM, Xero, Zendesk, Any.do , Todoist, Trac, Wunderlist, Toodledo, Teamwork.com , Google Mail, Taiga, Habitica, Axosoft, Countersoft Gemini, Drupal, Esa, Help Scout, Flow, Sprintly, Google Calendar, TestRail, Bugzilla, Breeze, BamBam, GQueue, Wrike, Assembla, Waffle, Codeable, Salesforce, Salesforce Lightning, Draftin, FogBugz, Google Keep, Gingko, Google Inbox, Wordpress, Kanbanery, Planbox, Zoho Books, Slack, Doit.im , Sunrise Calendar, Cloudes, eProject.me , Freshdesk, Newsletter2Go, Gogs, DevDocs, LiquidPlanner, SourceLair, Remember The Milk, Evernote, MantisHub, TargetProcess, VisualStudioOnline (TFS), SmartBoard, Phabricator, OpenProject, SherpaDesk, miniCRM, AgenoCRM, Zube, Rindle, TickTick, Bitrix24, Exana.io , Workfront, OnlyOffice, MeisterTask, Overv.io , Clubhouse.io , Desk.
 Click "+ Add to Firefox".
 Log in to Toggl Track from the extension menu
 You will quickly start noticing the Toggl Track extension in your favorite productivity tools
 Start timer inside one of the supported web tools and the task’s name and project will be added to your Toggl Track time entry.
 Tracking your time will help boost productivity in no time
Toggl Track extension also has advanced features like:
* Pomodoro timer
* Idle detection
* Tracking reminder
Toggl Track extension is open source and we welcome all your contributions, check out our Github repo - https://github.com/toggl/toggl-button 
You can check out the change log here - http://toggl.github.io/toggl-button 
Introduction article is available at: https://support.toggl.com/en/articles/2206984-toggl-track-button-browser-extension 
Privacy
The extension sends your Toggl Track account details and the time entries you track (including descriptions picked up from the page you start a timer on) to Toggl. This is required for it to work.
Usage statistics (via PostHog) and error reports (via Sentry) are optional and off by default. Usage statistics include your Toggl account ID, extension version, browser and operating system details, and which features and integrations you use. Error reports include the error message and stack trace, your Toggl user ID, extension version, and browser and operating system details. Neither ever includes page URLs, page content or time entry details. Both can be turned off at any time in the extension settings under Telemetry.
The data collected in the add-on is also covered by the policies in our Privacy Policy: https://toggl.com/legal/privacy 
Toggl Track Overview
Toggl Track is the leading online time management tool for teams and solo users. It allows users to track the time spent on various projects and analyze productivity. You can use Toggl Track on the web, as a desktop widget or on your mobile – all your data gets synced in real time.
Toggl Track is the ultimate simple online timer. Whether you need to track your work, time online and offline activities or just need a simple stopwatch from time to time, add Toggl Track extension to your browser and see the benefits for yourself.
Join over 3 million productive Togglers!

firefox-addons:3009112.name: Web Tools Companion
firefox-addons:3009112.summary: A companion extension for my Web Tools website. Designed to be a utility to automate or help with certain actions without the need of manual insertions to my website.
firefox-addons:3009112.description:
Web Tools Companion ✨
Ever get tired of having to constantly verify your schedule during enrollment and only end up with a dead hour or even have to manually create a weekly schedule? I know, kaumay pre. Now we can make it a lot easier, your welcome :) 
The Web Tools Companion is a browser extension that bridges the gap between FEU Portal (SOLAR & OSES) and the Web Tools, making schedule planning faster, smarter, and more interactive.
🚀 Key Features:
⚡ Real-Time Auto-Sync: As you Load OSES with existing or when Adding and Dropping Subjects, you can now see your schedule in Real-Time through the Web-Tools.
🏝️ Companion Hub (Dynamic Island): A Non-intrusive status overlay injected directly into the portal. Watch when data payloads go outbound from the Portal or Inbound to the Web-Tools.
📡 Secure Messaging Bridge: Your data stays local. I used a secure, ACK-based local handshake to ensure your schedule only ever moves from the portal to your visualizer never to an external server.
🏫 Full Branch Support: Optimized for FEU Tech, with hopes and dreams of compatibility for FEU Alabang and FEU Diliman portals. (sorry cant verify, me no access 😫)
🛠️ How it Works
Open the FEU Enrollment Portal (SOLAR).
Open Web Tools Visualizer or Pre-Requisite Mapping.
Then Proceed to do your actions. Don't worry the extension is on point, it will try to hold hands with you through and through, and if you follow instructions, you might be a Good Boy or a Good Girl.
⚖️ Philosophy & Disclaimer
Both this extension and the Web Tools site are built with a "lightweight and on-point" philosophy. They are designed to be efficient, "use and be done" type of tools, providing exactly what you need for enrollment without unnecessary bloat, complex setups, or background resource heavy lifting.
🌱 An Evolving Project
This extension is a personal project born out of a desire to make enrollment less of a headache. It is an ever-evolving tool, as the main Web Tools site grows and gains new features, this companion will continue to expand with new automations, specialized scrapers, and QoL improvements to match.
🛡️ Privacy First
I believe student data should be private. This extension does not collect, store, or share your personal information. All extraction and synchronization happen entirely within your own browser.
Made with ❤️ for the FEU community.
— Kenneth Davila (imjustapotato)

firefox-addons:2957461.name: QuickTools – Save Page as PDF or Image
firefox-addons:2957461.summary: Save any webpage as a PDF or image with one click. QuickTools captures the page locally in your browser and downloads it instantly — no uploads, no servers, 100% privacy-friendly.
firefox-addons:2957461.description:
QuickTools lets you save any webpage as a PDF or image directly from your browser, with all processing done locally on your device.
What you can do
 • Save the current page as a PDF with one click
 • Save the current page as a PNG image
 • Use the toolbar popup or the right-click context menu
 • Keep your data private – no file uploads, no external servers

How it works
QuickTools uses browser APIs and client-side libraries to capture the page and generate a PDF or image directly in your browser. The resulting file is downloaded immediately – nothing is sent to any remote server.
Perfect for
 • Saving articles, documentation, and receipts as PDFs

 • Users who care about privacy and prefer local processing
QuickTools.one is a free, privacy-first collection of PDF and image tools that run 100% in your browser. This add-on brings the most useful “save page” features right into Firefox.

bluejetty:00145416:ios.description:
BabyScroll: Toddler Screen Lock is a thoughtfully designed sensory development app created specifically for infants and toddlers.
Unlike high-energy, overstimulating cartoons, BabyScroll focuses on high-contrast visuals, gentle interactions, and calming sounds to support your baby’s early cognitive development and visual tracking skills. This baby sensory app provides a peaceful environment for early learning.
WHY CHOOSE BABYSCROLL?
In a world of loud and distracting media, BabyScroll offers a slow-tech alternative. Our app provides a curated environment where your little one can explore shapes, colors, and patterns at their own pace. It is an ideal first app for babies that prioritizes brain development over distraction.
Let your child discover sound, shapes, colors, and cause-and-effect play in a safe, ad-free environment. With intuitive touch interactions and no confusing menus, even the youngest fingers can tap, swipe, and giggle with delight.
It is the perfect tool for tummy time, airplane travel, car rides, or those moments when you need a safe, educational distraction for your child.
KEY FEATURES FOR EARLY DEVELOPMENT
Colorful Baby-Friendly Games: A curated library of simple, interactive games designed to inspire curiosity and early learning.
High-Contrast Visuals: Specially designed patterns and animations that cater to developing infant eyesight and focus.
Simple Gesture Controls: Easy-to-use scroll and tap mechanics that empower babies to interact with the screen independently.
Curated Sensory Themes: Choose from various themes including animals, geometric shapes, and nature to keep your child engaged.
Soothing Soundscapes: Calming audio designed to soothe rather than overstimulate, perfect for winding down before naps.
Safe for Babies and Toddlers: No ads, no pop-ups, no hidden buttons, and no external links. Just a clean space for play.
Offline Play: Use BabyPhone anywhere without needing an internet connection, making it the best travel app for toddlers.
EDUCATIONAL BENEFITS

زخرف اسمك ورسائلك، وغيّر شكل كيبوردك بضغطة، واكتب بأجمل الخطوط في أي تطبيق.
ثيمات لكل ذوق
- أكثر من 170 ثيم مقسّمة بأقسام سهلة: إسلامي، تدرّج لوني، رياضي، معماري، طبيعة، فضاء، حب، فن وأشكال، ألوان سادة
- ثيمات جديدة بتوصلك باستمرار، بدون ما تحتاج تحدّث التطبيق
- صور بدقة عالية تشوف فيها شكل الكيبورد قبل ما تختاره
صمّم كيبوردك بضغطة
- زر فاجئني بيعطيك تصميم جديد كل مرة
- أشكال أزرار جاهزة: زجاجي، شفاف، دائري، فاتح، داكن، نيون
- حط صورتك خلفية، أو اختار لون، وغيّر الخط وحجم الحروف
- زر اجعل الحروف أوضح بيختار لون الحروف المناسب للخلفية تلقائياً
- تراجع عن أي تغيير بضغطة، أو ارجع للشكل الأصلي
- عدّل أي ثيم جاهز واحفظه نسخة إلك
زخرفة النصوص والأسماء
- زخارف عربية وخطوط إنجليزية مميزة
- إطارات للأسماء تناسب البروفايل والألعاب
- نصوص جاهزة مزخرفة لكل مناسبة: صباح الخير، العيد، رمضان، الحب وغيرها
- رموز وأشكال ووجوه نصية تضيفها بضغطة
- انسخ أو شارك النتيجة مباشرة
زخرفة مباشرة وأنت تكتب
اختار شكل الزخرفة من الكيبورد مرة وحدة، وكل كلمة بتكتبها بتطلع مزخرفة في المحادثات والمنشورات.
كيبورد مريح للكتابة
- عربي وإنجليزي، مع الأرقام والرموز والإيموجي وبحث الإيموجي
- اقتراحات الكلمات والتصحيح التلقائي وتوقّع الكلمة التالية
- تحكّم بارتفاع الكيبورد والصوت والاهتزاز
- معاينة حية للإعدادات، وشرح تفعيل بثلاث خطوات بسيطة
خصوصيتك أولاً
الكيبورد بيحتاج السماح بالوصول الكامل عشان الثيمات والصوت والاهتزاز بس. ما بنجمع ولا بنرسل أي شي بتكتبه، وتعلّم كلماتك بيضل على جهازك.
الجديد في هذا الإصدار
- أقسام للثيمات: إسلامي، رياضي، معماري، تدرّج لوني، طبيعة، فضاء، حب وغيرها
- أكثر من 170 ثيم جديد بصور أوضح
- تبويب سريع بالتخصيص: فاجئني، أشكال أزرار جاهزة، حروف أوضح، وتراجع
- زر عدّل لأي ثيم جاهز
- زخارف جديدة ونصوص جاهزة للعيد ورمضان والجمعة
- تحكّم بارتفاع الكيبورد، ومعاينة حية للإعدادات
- شرح تفعيل بثلاث خطوات، وشروحات جديدة داخل التطبيق
- تصميم جديد للتطبيق وأيقونات أجمل
- دعم iOS 27 وإصلاحات لشريط الاقتراحات
التطبيق مجاني بالكامل ومدعوم بالإعلانات. نزّله الحين وخلّي كل رسالة تطلع بأحلى شكل.

bluejetty:00179430:ios.name: WalkMe | Walking in Madeira
bluejetty:00179430:ios.summary:
Discover Madeira like never before with WalkMe Levadas Madeira, the #1 hiking app designed by locals to help you explore the island’s famous levadas and trails safely and with confidence.
Try your first trail for free! Unlock full offline
bluejetty:00179430:ios.description:
Discover Madeira like never before with WalkMe Levadas Madeira, the #1 hiking app designed by locals to help you explore the island’s famous levadas and trails safely and with confidence.
Try your first trail for free! Unlock full offline GPS navigation and our entire trail catalog with a Premium plan (Monthly or Lifetime).
Why WalkMe Premium?
Mapping mountain trails with precision and ensuring your safety requires daily work on the ground. By subscribing to the Premium plan, you are supporting a dedicated team that regularly checks the paths, ensuring you have access to reliable offline maps even where there is no mobile network. Hike safely and support this local project!
Key features:
- 50+ curated trails with detailed descriptions, photos, and difficulty levels, including Levada do Caldeirão Verde, Pico do Areeiro, Pico Ruivo among others.
- Offline GPS navigation – never get lost, even without internet
- Real-time alerts: closures, weather updates, safety warnings
- Export GPX to your smartwatch or GPS device (Garmin, Apple Watch, Xiaomi, etc.)
- Emergency contacts and location sharing for extra security
- Favorites, filters, and personalized lists to plan your perfect hike
Sustainable Adventure at Your Fingertips
Walking is one of the most eco-friendly ways to explore Madeira. With WalkMe, you reduce the need for paper maps and guidebooks while supporting conscious tourism.
Trusted by Thousands of Hikers
Over 300,000 downloads worldwide. Whether you’re a casual walker or a seasoned trekker, WalkMe Levadas Madeira is your essential companion to explore, discover, and protect the unique nature of the island.
Download now and start your adventure with confidence. Madeira is waiting for you!
-----

FACEBOOK: www.facebook.com/WalkMe.Guide
SUPPORT: We love hearing from users: info@walkmeguide.com
LEGAL: Terms & Conditions: https://walkmeguide.com/en/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00070187:ios.description:
Sporun kalbi cebinde atsın!
Türkiye'nin en çok izlenen spor kanalı A Spor artık cebinde! Resmî A Spor Mobil Uygulaması ile futbolun, basketbolun, tüm spor dünyasının heyecanı her an seninle! Son dakika gelişmeleri, canlı yayınlar, maç özetleri, fikstürler ve daha fazlası tek bir uygulamada seni bekliyor!
A Spor Mobil’de Neler Var?
7/24 Canlı Yayın:
A Spor ekranları artık hep yanında! Günün her saati, her yerden canlı yayın keyfi!
Son Dakika Spor Haberleri:
Gol oldu mu? Transfer geldi mi? Ne varsa anında cebinde! Futbol, basketbol, tenis ve daha fazlası için ilk sen öğren!
Canlı Skor & Maç Özetleri:
Süper Lig’den Premier Lig’e, Şampiyonlar Ligi’nden EuroLeague’e… Canlı skorlar, maç özetleri, goller ve en kritik anlar parmaklarının ucunda!
Özel İçerikler:
Beşiktaş, Fenerbahçe, Galatasaray, Trabzonspor ve tüm Anadolu kulüplerinden tarafsız ve doğru haberler sadece burada!
Ziraat Türkiye Kupası (ZTK):
ZTK’nın resmî yayıncısından tüm maç özetleri, goller ve özel içerikler tek adreste, tek tıkla!
Fikstür & Puan Durumu:
Liglerin nabzını tut! Güncel fikstür ve puan durumlarına anında ulaş, yarışta kim önde takip et!
Anlık Bildirimler:
Gol olduysa ilk sen bil! Canlı skorlar, flaş gelişmeler ve son dakika haberleri cebine düşsün!
Zengin Multimedya:
Maç anlatımları, gol videoları, dev galeriler, analizler… Sporun heyecanını dolu dolu yaşa, beğendiğin içerikleri kolayca paylaş!
Aspor.com.tr ile Sporda Dijital Devrim!
2014’ten bu yana Türkiye’nin spor ekranı olan A Spor, aspor.com.tr ile dijitalde de fark yaratıyor! Futbol, basketbol, tenis, motor sporları ve tüm branşlarda en güncel haberler, özel programlar, videolar ve galerilerle sporun dijitaldeki adresi A Spor!

bluejetty:00122618:ios.description:
CoinKeeper³ is an upgraded version of the legendary app. Recording and tracking your expenses has never been simpler. Start your new financially conscious life with new CoinKeeper.
WONDER HOW TO SAVE MONEY?
The intuitive diagram will show you:
categories you should spend less money on;
categories you spend the most of your money on;
how to make correct decisions based upon specifically your financial situation.
KEEP SPENDING MORE THAN PLANNED?
CoinKeeper shows you when it’s time to stop.
Set the limits on expense categories and once you are over your budget, you’ll see it.
WANT TO SET UP A FAMILY ACCOUNT? 
Shared budgeting has never been easier: your family members record expenses in their own devices. Accounts’ balances will be displayed on each device. 
LOOKING FOR INDIVIDUAL SOLUTIONS?
CoinKeeper³ is a handy, simple and intuitive app that provides you with:
all your accounts, cards and cash is shown on one screen;
fast access to any of your financial information in one easy swipe;
tags and comments, that help you to specificate your expenses; 
the unlimited number of expense categories for making your very own budgeting system. 
You can buy CoinKeeper Plus or Premium subscription and get every feature. Premium subscription is available on monthly basis for $7.99 or $59.99 per 1 year.

American Taxi Dispatch, Inc. is the largest suburban Chicago, IL taxi dispatch service serving all suburbs, airports and downtown. All rides must begin or end in a suburb. We offer low flat rates to and from airports and downtown locations. 
Our easy and secure online ordering through tablet and smartphone, or any computer, goes direct to dispatch so there is no delay in the order process. When you log in you can order your taxi immediately, or choose a later time or date and the order will remain in the dispatch system until it is completed.
You can retrieve your order on your mobile device to check for estimated time of arrival to your pick up location, change date, time or any other feature, or cancel your order.
You can add commonly used travel locations (except airports, which are already shortcuts) to make ordering faster and easier. Save the shortcut name, such as work, dentist, home, or favorite restaurant, and the name and address of the location in your permanent profile and you can scroll to that shortcut to quickly enter that location in your order. 
Save all cell phone, office and home phone numbers in your profile so if you need to call, our automated system will recognize any of those numbers and quickly place your order.
We accept all major credit cards, coupons and village sponsored senior discount taxi coupon programs. Remember, it's quicker to click than to call!

bluejetty:00153502:ios.summary: Step into the shadows of history in "Hidden Legacy: Dark Heirloom", an unforgettable entry into the world of hidden object games and atmospheric adventure games. You are Gabriel Vanyard, a skilled genealogist called to investigate a mysteri
bluejetty:00153502:ios.description:
Step into the shadows of history in "Hidden Legacy: Dark Heirloom", an unforgettable entry into the world of hidden object games and atmospheric adventure games. You are Gabriel Vanyard, a skilled genealogist called to investigate a mysterious heirloom linked to generations of death in the Montgomery family. As you solve mystery games packed with intrigue and travel across timeworn estates and historical ruins, you must find hidden objects that unravel the twisted fate of a cursed bloodline. Do you have what it takes to end the curse before it claims its final victim?
The Montgomery family’s legacy is haunted by a curse that has claimed generation after generation. A genealogist is invited to investigate a mysterious ring said to bring death to every bearer. Gabriel Vanyard is no stranger to family heirlooms, but the Montgomery family's cursed ring is unlike any artifact he has ever encountered. Gabriel travels across the world, from the crumbling estate in Ireland to the grandeur of the Scottish Highlands, from London to Canada, seeking answers to break the curse before it destroys the last remaining member of the family. Will he succeed, or will the Montgomery family be doomed forever?
· Explore eerie locations!
Travel through ghostly estates, ancient ruins, and mysterious libraries in hidden object games. Designed for fans of adventure games and exploration, each location challenges you to find hidden objects and solve puzzles essential to unraveling the Montgomery family’s grim legacy!
· Puzzles and mini-games!
Use logic and intuition in a range of dynamic hidden object games. Hidden Legacy combines classic point-and-click mechanics with search and find games challenges that immerse you in the narrative. If you like to solve mystery games, this game delivers hours of rewarding gameplay!
· Collect special items!
Track down rare collectibles, complete achievements, and find hidden objects woven throughout. A treat for completionists, this adventure blends search and find games with compelling rewards and exciting hidden object games. Each collectible also helps you solve mystery games with added lore and insight!
· Unearth a dark family history!
Through journals, ghostly visions, and hidden letters, you'll unravel the origins of the Montgomery curse. It’s a story-driven journey that elevates it beyond typical hidden object games, perfect for fans of deep and emotional adventure games. Don’t forget to solve mystery games and puzzles along the way!
From haunted family estates in Ireland to fog-covered castles in Scotland, explore the free trial of the "Hidden Legacy: Dark Heirloom" right now!

bluejetty:00149354:ios.description:

- Boosting low water pressure
- Troubleshooting irrigation systems
- Installing new faucets, shower heads, garbage disposals, toilets, vanities, and sinks

bluejetty:00161585:ios.name: CNA® Practice Exam Prep 2026
bluejetty:00161585:ios.summary: CNA: Nursing Assistant Prep is a comprehensive study solution designed to help students master the knowledge and skills required to pass their 2026 CNA test. CNA: Nursing Assistant Prep provides a structured and data-driven approach to CNA
bluejetty:00161585:ios.description:
CNA: Nursing Assistant Prep is a comprehensive study solution designed to help students master the knowledge and skills required to pass their 2026 CNA test. CNA: Nursing Assistant Prep provides a structured and data-driven approach to CNA exam preparation, ensuring you are fully equipped for the official CNA curriculum and nursing assistant clinical standards.
Whether you are just beginning your nursing assistant journey or are looking for a final review before your CNA exam date, CNA: Nursing Assistant Prep offers the tools necessary for success. Our content is meticulously curated to align with official source materials and previously seen questions, providing a realistic simulation of the actual testing environment.
Key Features:
Passing Probability - our advanced analytics engine evaluates your practice data in real time to calculate your specific probability of passing the test. By identifying your strengths and weaknesses, the app helps you focus your study efforts where they matter most, giving you the confidence to know exactly when you are ready to sit for the official exam.
2,000 Professional Practice Questions - access an extensive library of 2,000 practice questions written by high-scoring test takers. These questions reflect the style, difficulty, and content of the actual certification exam. To ensure deep understanding, every question includes: detailed explanations for every answer choice to reinforce core nursing concepts and helpful hints to guide your critical thinking when you encounter challenging scenarios.
Comprehensive Practice Quizzes - with over 14 practice quizzes tailored to each section of the official nursing assistant curriculum, you can master specific topics one at a time. This targeted approach ensures that you have a firm grasp of every domain, from basic nursing skills and restorative skills to emotional and mental health needs.
Full-Length Timed Exams - prepare for the pressure of the testing center with full-length exams. These timed assessments allow you to practice your pacing and build the stamina required for the actual CNA exam. Mark questions for later review and simulate the true exam day experience.
Missed Question Review - efficiency is key to effective studying. Our missed question review feature automatically tracks every question you answer incorrectly, allowing you to revisit and master the material you find most difficult. This ensures there are no gaps in your knowledge before the big day.
Full Textbook Notes and Cram Sheets - transition from active testing to deep review with our integrated textbook notes. We provide comprehensive summaries of essential nursing assistant material and condensed cram sheets for quick review sessions. These resources are perfect for memorizing key terms, vital sign ranges, and procedural steps.
Prepare with a tool designed specifically for the CNA candidate. Download CNA: Nursing Assistant Prep today and take the first step toward your career as a healthcare professional.

bluejetty:00107372:android.description:
About MobiKwik
MobiKwik is a payment app offering bill payments, loans up to ₹2,00,000, and investments in FDs, P2P lending, mutual funds, and digital gold. You can also experience the power of Pocket UPI on MobiKwik, where UPI transactions don’t require a bank account. With Pocket UPI, enjoy enhanced security, higher transaction limits, and unmatched convenience for your digital payments.
Pocket UPI
- No Bank Account Required: Perform UPI transactions safely without linking a bank account.
- Higher Transaction & Wallet Limits: Load up to ₹2 lakhs in your wallet and transact up to ₹1 lakh per day.
- Flexible Payments: Pay to any QR code, UPI ID, or mobile number.
- Multiple Top-Up Options: Load your wallet through UPI, debit card, or credit card.
- No PIN Required: On-device biometric security (Fingerprint/Face ID) for quick, secure payments.
- Streamlined Interface: Keep Pocket UPI transactions separate from bank statements for better tracking.
- Budget Management: Assign a set amount for spending to manage personal or family budgets.
Free Credit Score
-Check your credit score for free every month.
-Get immediate access to your credit score for detailed insights.
-Reliable and accurate credit data sourced from CRIF.
UPI Payments
- Secure UPI Setup: Create a fast and secure UPI handle in-app.
- Universal Compatibility: Send/receive money via BHIM UPI, phone numbers, or direct bank account transfers.
- RuPay Credit Card Integration: Link and use your RuPay credit card to pay via UPI.
- Scan & Pay: Make payments at supermarkets, restaurants, pharmacies, and petrol pumps using the MobiKwik Wallet UPI handle.
- Trusted Brand Payments: Pay securely at Reliance Fresh, Croma, Apollo Pharmacy, and more.
EPFO Balance Checker
Access your provident fund details and track employer contributions using your registered phone number.
Track Bank Balance
Safely track multiple bank accounts with LENS. Download statements and analyze spending with smart spend insights.
Fixed Deposits
- Earn up to 9.5% Returns: Invest with Unity Small Finance Bank, Suryoday Small Finance Bank, Mahindra Finance, and more.
- Special Rates: Senior citizens receive an additional 0.5% interest, and females get an extra 0.1%.
Xtra
P2P investment platform in partnership with RBI-approved NBFC Transactree Technologies Private Limited (“Lendbox”) 
- Earn upto 10-14% p.a.
- Start investing with ₹10000
- Payout to Bank accounts
- No account opening or withdrawal fees
ZIP EMI
- Get funds/loans up to ₹500,000 for online shopping & pay back in monthly instalments.
- Interest rates starting from 0.8% per month with a tenure of 3-26 months.
Lending partners (NBFC): Transactree Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (Lendbox), Hero FinCorp Limited, SMFG India Credit Co. Ltd.
Lending partners (Bank): IDFC First Bank Limited
Sample EMI Calculation:
Loan Amount: ₹50,000
Interest rate (APR): 16% p.a.
Tenure: 12 months
EMI: ₹4,537
Total interest paid: ₹4,444
Processing Fees (2%): ₹1,000
Disbursed Amount: ₹49,000 (Principal Amount - P.F.)
Total Cost of Loan: ₹55,444
Online Recharge & Bill Payment
-Mobile Recharge: Quick recharge for Airtel, VI, Jio, BSNL, and more.
-DTH Recharge: Recharge Tata Sky, Airtel TV, Dish TV, and more.
-Bill Payment: Pay for electricity, water, broadband, LPG, FASTag, property tax, etc., covering 300+ billers.
-Credit Card Payments: Settle HDFC, ICICI, SBI, Amex, and other card bills with instant processing and reminders.
-Money Transfer: Send money instantly via IMPS, UPI, wallet, or credit card.
Contact Us
One MobiKwik Systems Limited (www.mobikwik.com/help)
Unit No. 102, 1st Floor, Block-B, Pegasus One, Golf Course Road, Sector-53, Gurugram, Haryana 122003, India
080-69808320 (Mon to Sat, 9:00 am to 8:00 pm)

bluejetty:00147121:ios.description:
The only wallpapers you'll ever need. Say hello to Backdrops.
• Explore
Sift through hundreds of original wallpapers hand crafted in house by the the Backdrops team. Enjoy exclusive walls designed specifically for your devices. You won't find these backgrounds in any other app.
• Let's Get Social
Join in on the action and upload wallpapers yourself. Share your own pieces of work or photography. Only high quality original submissions will be approved for the Community tab. This ensures a full collection of photos worthy of becoming your wallpaper. The Backdrops team will be side by side with you sharing high quality public domain photos with some delicious edits.
• Wall of the Day
Come back every day for a new treat. This is where we showcase newly created backdrops, or just some of our favorites. Contact us if you want your own original work in the spotlight.
• Variety is the Spice of Life
Enjoy a wide variety of different wallpaper styles and flavors, such as material, minimal, aesthetics, patterns, scenery, outer space, earth views, abstract, photography, geometric, dark AMOLED friendly walls and much more.
• Premium Collections
Unlock bonus collections to gain access to even more original designs. These collections will be updated along with the Explore section. More backdrops equals a happier you.
• Go Pro
Going Pro unlocks a few extra features, including a completely ad-free experience, and all Pro Collections of exclusive backgrounds that we'll continuously be updating with new designs. Access to future Pro features are also covered.
• Favorites
Click some hearts and build a collection of your own. Have all your favorites handy for quick access.
• Sync Your Favs
Sign in to sync and save your collection of favorites across multiple devices.
• Stunning UI
Fall in love with a beautifully designed app. Open up Backdrops continually for some daily eye candy.
• Updated Daily
We'll be constantly designing new backdrops for you. This means new high quality content within the app every day.
Follow Us on X aka Twitter: https://twitter.com/backdropsapp
Please note that the Backdrops app consists of high quality wallpapers. Regular usage can use a lot of data. Please be aware that your Internet Service Provider or mobile carrier's normal rates and fees may apply to your use of Backdrops. You are solely responsible for such charges and fees, as stated in our Terms of Use.
This app contains ads that can be removed with an IAP.

Experience the Future of Bible Study with AI-Powered Chat!
Discover Grace – Bible Chat, where cutting-edge AI meets timeless scripture. Grace puts AI-powered chat at the forefront, enabling you to ask spiritual or life-related questions and receive personalized, Bible-based answers instantly. Perfect for anyone seeking immediate guidance, daily inspiration, or a deeper connection with their faith.
For premium subscription customer, you would have AI-Powered Chat for Spiritual Guidance
- Instant, Personalized Answers: Engage in dynamic conversations with an advanced AI that delivers context-aware responses grounded in scripture.
- Scripture-Integrated Insights: Receive Bible-based answers complete with relevant references to deepen your understanding.
- Interactive & Engaging: Whether you’re seeking advice, spiritual encouragement, or clarity on life’s challenges, our AI chat is your faithful companion.
- Review Past Conversations: Easily access and revisit your chat history to reflect on your spiritual journey.
Comprehensive Bible Reading
- 9 Bible Translations: Explore popular versions like King James Version, Luther Bible and more.
- Multi-Language Support: Enjoy scripture in English, German, French, and Spanish.
- Effortless Navigation: Seamlessly browse books, chapters, and verses with an intuitive interface.
Daily Inspiration & Engagement
- Verse of the Day: Start each day inspired by a handpicked scripture to uplift your spirit.
Tailored for Your Spiritual Journey
- Personalized Profiles: Customize your experience by setting preferences like denomination, language, and Bible reading habits.
- Clean, Intuitive Design: Focus on what matters most with a distraction-free, user-friendly interface.

bluejetty:00131200:ios.name: Knowunity: AI Study & Homework
bluejetty:00131200:ios.summary: Hey, I'm Knowie - your new way of learning. Whatever you're working on, I'll help you understand it, remember it, and walk into your next SAT, ACT, or AP feeling ready. 30 million students already study with me, I am created by the best stu
bluejetty:00131200:ios.description:
Hey, I'm Knowie - your new way of learning. Whatever you're working on, I'll help you understand it, remember it, and walk into your next SAT, ACT, or AP feeling ready. 30 million students already study with me, I am created by the best students and the core tools are free.
This is a the new way of learning - here is how we do it. Everything runs through one place: your exam plan. Instead of a pile of separate features, I pull it all together - flashcards, quizzes, summaries, mock exams, voice practice, and the official SAT, ACT, and AP guidelines - and structure it into a day-by-day plan built around your test date and your topics.
Your exam plan, made with you. Tell me when your test is and what you need to cover, and I'll map out exactly what to do each day, with the right notes and flashcards for your course. Add your class timetable and I'll fit study around your lessons - no all-nighters. As the test gets closer the plan adapts, and you always see what you've got down and what's next.
Study that actually sticks - active recall. Rereading feels productive but fades fast, so your plan is built around active recall: pulling answers out of your own memory. Quizzes and flashcards ask you to remember, not just recognize, and mastery tracking shows each topic move from shaky to solid.
Just say it out loud. This is where voice comes in. With voice recall in your plan, you say your answer from memory and I check it with you - hands-free, out loud, the way real recall works. And in chat, switch on voice mode to talk to me like a tutor: ask anything, no typing needed.
Stuck on homework? Snap a photo of any problem - math, chemistry, physics, biology - and I'll walk you through it step by step, so you get the how, not just the answer. Keep a separate chat for each class so nothing gets mixed up.
Turn anything into study material. Upload PDFs, slides, photos, or handwritten notes, paste in text and links, bring your old flashcard decks, or drop in a YouTube video - I'll turn it into flashcards, quizzes, and clean summaries in seconds, ready to slot straight into your plan. Need vocab for a language class or a clearer essay outline? I've got you there too.
Practice like it's the real thing. Take full, AI-scored mock exams in real SAT and AP format and see where you stand before test day - then I fold the results back into your plan, so you review exactly what needs work.
Learn from real students. Browse over 1 million notes, summaries, and past-paper solutions shared by students in your subject and grade - right alongside everything we make together.
Keep your streak going. Earn XP as you study, join a weekly league of up to 30 classmates, and climb from Bronze to Gold. A little friendly competition to keep you coming back.
I'm built for every subject - AP courses, Math, Sciences, Social Studies, English, World Languages, Computing, and SAT and ACT prep. Whether you're cramming tonight or planning weeks ahead, we'll get you there - and the core tools are always free.
Ready when you are. Download Knowunity, and let's study smarter, not harder.
TOS: https://knowunity.com/legal/tos

bluejetty:00174639:ios.name: SafeInCloud 1
bluejetty:00174639:ios.summary:
SafeInCloud Password Manager allows you to keep your logins, passwords, and other private info safe and secure in an encrypted database. You can synchronize your data with another phone, tablet, Mac or PC via your own cloud account.
KEY FE
bluejetty:00174639:ios.description:
SafeInCloud Password Manager allows you to keep your logins, passwords, and other private info safe and secure in an encrypted database. You can synchronize your data with another phone, tablet, Mac or PC via your own cloud account.
KEY FEATURES
◆ Easy to Use
◆ Strong Encryption (256-bit Advanced Encryption Standard)
◆ Cloud Synchronization (iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, NAS, WebDAV)
◆ Login with Touch ID & Face ID
◆ Autofill in Apps
◆ Apple Watch App
◆ Password Strength Analysis
◆ Password Generator
◆ Free Desktop App (Windows, Mac)
◆ Automatic Data Import
◆ Cross-Platform
EASY TO USE
Try it yourself and enjoy an easy-to-use yet powerful user interface.
STRONG ENCRYPTION
Your data is always encrypted on a device and in a cloud with a strong 256-bit Advanced Encryption Standard (AES). This algorithm is used by the U.S. Government for protection of a top secret information. AES is also widely adopted worldwide and became the de facto encryption standard.
CLOUD SYNCHRONIZATION
Your database is automatically synchronized with your own cloud account. Thus you can easily restore your entire database from a cloud to a new phone or computer (in case of a loss or an upgrade). Your phone, tablet and computer are also automatically synchronized between each other via a cloud.
LOGIN WITH TOUCH ID & FACE ID
You can instantly unlock SafeInCloud with a fingerprint on devices with Touch ID. You can also unlock SafeInCloud by face recognition using Face ID technology.
AUTOFILL IN APPS
You can autofill login and password fields into any app on your phone directly from SafeInCloud. You don't need to copy and paste them manually.
APPLE WATCH APP
You can put some selected cards on your wrist to easily access them on the run. These could be your credit card PINs, door and locker codes.
PASSWORD STRENGTH ANALYSIS
SafeInCloud analyses your password strengths and shows a strength indicator next to each password. The strength indicator displays an estimated crack time for a password. All cards with weak passwords are marked with a red sign.
PASSWORD GENERATOR
The password generator helps you generating random and secure passwords. There is also an option to generate memorable, but still strong passwords.
FREE DESKTOP APP
Download a free Desktop application for Windows or Mac OS from www.safe-in-cloud.com to be able access your database on your computer. The Desktop application also makes data entry and editing fast and easy using a hardware keyboard.
AUTOMATIC DATA IMPORT
The Desktop application can automatically import your data from another password manager. You don't need to manually reenter all your passwords.

bluejetty:00086891:ios.description:
HealthTap is a telehealth app where you choose & keep one primary care doctor you love to get ongoing care — affordably with or without great insurance or benefits!
Get personalized, quality medical advice without an expensive and inconvenient trip to a doctor’s office. Meet with your favorite new doctor regularly for health checkups, prescriptions, lab tests & results, treatment plans and referrals to specialists. Our amazing doctors seek to build long-term, trusted relationships with their patients to take care of Americans' ongoing health needs.
Our top U.S. board-certified doctors are available for virtual visits 7 days per week in all 50 U.S. states.
~~~ SUBSCRIPTION BENEFITS ~~~
Subscribe for $15/month* (billed twelve months at a time) to save hundreds of dollars & countless hours each year with:
• Same day or week video appointments with your doctor — $44/visit or less**
• Free texting with your doctor for follow-ups and clarifications
• Speak with the first available doctor during nights, weekends, holidays, or while traveling out of state for urgent care — $59/visit or less**
• Get prescriptions, lab tests ordered, referrals to specialists, and even doctor’s notes for school or work
• Save up to 75% on prescriptions with coupons for local pharmacies
• Set up profiles for your children at no additional cost
We accept hundreds of insurance plans and even HSA/FSA cards.
* Subscription may be covered by select insurance plans
** Insurance coverage may reduce your out-of-pocket cost
~~~ AVAILABLE WITHOUT SUBSCRIPTION ~~~
$129 Urgent Care Video Visits — talk with the first available doctor within minutes (7 days per week) over video or text for advice, prescriptions, test orders, and referrals. Just $129 per visit (retail price) or your insurance copay.
FREE Educational Doctor Answers — Get educational text answers to your health questions from a network of over 90,000 U.S. doctors across 147 specialties volunteering their time to help millions like you for FREE! Search millions of answers or post your own and get responses from real doctors within hours.
~~~ WHAT WE TREAT ~~~
We can help with a broad range of medical issues, including the following examples:
MANAGING YOUR CONDITION
High blood pressure, diabetes, asthma, allergies, high cholesterol, arthritis, thyroid disorders
WOMEN’S HEALTH
UTI, birth control, menopause, period problems, yeast infections, skin and hair care
CHILDREN’S HEALTH (ages 2+)
Cold & flu symptoms, diarrhea or constipation, skin rashes, allergies
MEN’S HEALTH
STI symptoms, erection issues, bladder or bowel issues, skin and hair care
SENIOR HEALTH (ages 65+)
Muscle or joint pain, medication management, preventive health screenings
WELLNESS & PREVENTION
Weight counseling, skin and hair care, supplements, health screenings, stress reduction
SEXUAL HEALTH
STI prevention or testing, erectile dysfunction, birth control counseling
MENTAL & BEHAVIORAL HEALTH
Anxiety, depression, sleep issues, school or work stress, alcohol abuse, smoking cessation
…and much more!
~~~ SEE WHAT MEMBERS ARE SAYING ~~~
“Great prices, very friendly doctor, very convenient, and I was able to get a same or next-day appointment and prescriptions that I needed.” – Joe C
“Super quick and efficient. Doctor was very personable and made me feel comfortable through the telehealth visit. She explained everything and made sure I understood.” – Katlyn A
“When I moved I lost my medical insurance. I found HealthTap and it was a lifesaver. I have told many people about it.” – Steven B
“My doctor is extremely accommodating. She has multiple appointment times open throughout the weekend. She is never in a hurry and very thorough. HealthTap is a wonderful service!” – Diana C
~~~
100% SECURE & CONFIDENTIAL:
We take your privacy very seriously. Your visit with the doctor is confidential and HIPAA compliant.
QUESTIONS?
You’re always welcome to contact us at support@healthtap.com for responsive and helpful support.

• Kidnap princesses for good conversation, to bait heroes, or for a light snack
• Isn't it a little sexist to always kidnap princesses? Kidnap a prince instead
• Ransack holy temples, blaspheming against vengeful gods

bluejetty:00175299:ios.name: IPVanish VPN: Fast & Secure
bluejetty:00175299:ios.summary:
"Help secure your WiFi with IPVanish VPN for iPhone and iPad. Use the IP location changer of our fast VPN to help defend your private data and connect to content from almost anywhere. Get started today!
IPVanish provides a simple solution
bluejetty:00175299:ios.description:
"Help secure your WiFi with IPVanish VPN for iPhone and iPad. Use the IP location changer of our fast VPN to help defend your private data and connect to content from almost anywhere. Get started today!
IPVanish provides a simple solution to help secure your internet connection. Start a free VPN trial to experience our private WiFi and mobile network protection.
-----
Online privacy should be quick and easy. IPVanish’s secure VPN is an IP changer to help defend your personal data from advertisers, network interferences, and hackers. The app VPN tunnel uses encryption to secure video streaming and web browsing activity at the touch of a button.
To use IPVanish, launch the app and select the location changer source of your new IP address to establish a private connection to the internet.
Delivering reliable and fast VPN service for over a decade, IPVanish is committed to giving subscribers the quality care they deserve. With 24/7 customer support through in-app live chat, email, and phone, a team member is always available to answer questions or lend a helping hand.
► IPVANISH VPN HELPS YOU:
• Secure WiFi & mobile networks
• Thwart ads, stop trackers, and block harmful websites
• Protect your data from third parties & sites
• Shield your visible location with an IP changer
• Set up automatic connections
• Access online media from almost anywhere
• Conceal your IP address from tracking
• Keep your online traffic more anonymous
• Defend yourself from DDoS attacks while gaming
• Encrypt network traffic to protect it from snoopers
• Use online banking securely
• Download & share private files quickly
► IPVANISH VPN FEATURES
• Free VPN trial to download and try IPVanish at no cost
• Access to over 3,200 fast VPN servers in 150+ locations
• Threat Protection, an ad blocker, anti-tracker, and malicious site filter
• QR code and short URL link scanning tools 
• No logs are recorded, verified in a third-party audit
• 24/7 customer support via in-app live chat, email, and phone
• Secure VPN connections for every device you own from one account
• WireGuard® and IKEv2 connection protocols
• Advanced-standard encryption (AES-256)
• Default Location, which automatically picks the best VPN server available
• On-Demand VPN activated by custom network and traffic rules
• Split tunneling, which allows specific domains to operate outside the VPN
• Internet connection kill switch to prevent lapses in protection
► AUTOMATIC RENEWAL
• IPVanish VPN for iPhone and iPad is a paid service, so you’ll need a subscription to use it.
• You can purchase a subscription directly within the app.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at the confirmation of purchase.
• Your subscription will automatically renew 24 hours before the end of each current period unless auto-renew is turned off.
• You can manage subscriptions and disable auto-renew anytime within your Apple ID Account Settings -> Manage Subscriptions.
► PRIVACY POLICY
https://www.ipvanish.com/privacy-policy
► TERMS OF SERVICE
https://www.ipvanish.com/tos/
► CONTACT US
If you need help, have a question, or just want to leave some feedback, email us at support@ipvanish.com or start a live chat within the app or at https://www.ipvanish.com"

bluejetty:00040892:ios.summary: Aeroport Taxi & Limousine is a leading provider of Airport Taxi and Limo services in the Greater Toronto Area. Dedicated to servicing Toronto's Pearson International Airport since 1968. We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very la
bluejetty:00040892:ios.description:
Aeroport Taxi & Limousine is a leading provider of Airport Taxi and Limo services in the Greater Toronto Area. Dedicated to servicing Toronto's Pearson International Airport since 1968. We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free app.
Key Features of the application include:
• Book a reservation in as few as 2 clicks
• Instantly Receive Discounted Flat Rates Up To 15% Off Regulated Rates
• Watch Your Vehicle Drive To You 
• Ability to pre-pay by Credit Card within the app
• Create a list of favorite addresses
Quick and Easy sign-up process takes less then 30 seconds, no credit card required:
• Account creation only requires Email, Name, Phone # and Password
• Enter your pickup address and select which airport and your on your way.
• Reservations can be immediate or for a future time/date.
On booking a reservation, you will immediately receive a confirmation number, along with an update when your vehicle has been assigned. From here you can monitor the progress of your vehicle as it moves towards your pickup location.
The Aeroport Taxi application retains a history of your previous reservations (up to 30 days) for expense management and to quickly rebook the same trip with the push of a button. You may also create a list of favorite locations (Home, Work, etc.) to speed the booking process.
At Aeroport Taxi your comfort and safety are our top priorities! Let us know how we can serve you better by providing feedback via the application or by calling 1-800-465-3434.
We service all of southern Ontario the following cities:
Mississauga, Brampton, Oakville, Burlington, Ajax, Whitby
We look forward to adding many exciting new features to the Aeroport Taxi application in the months ahead, and are always interested in what you have to say!

bluejetty:00026967:ios.name: Freedom Trail Boston Guide
bluejetty:00026967:ios.summary:
Bring the Founding Fathers and the American Revolution to life with the #1 Best-Selling Self-Guided Audio Tour App for the Boston Freedom Trail!
Boston’s Historic Freedom Trail:
Walk down storied streets in the footsteps of the Founding Fa
bluejetty:00026967:ios.description:
Bring the Founding Fathers and the American Revolution to life with the #1 Best-Selling Self-Guided Audio Tour App for the Boston Freedom Trail!
Boston’s Historic Freedom Trail:
Walk down storied streets in the footsteps of the Founding Fathers. Hear the story of how the first sparks of revolution flew in Boston, and how those sparks became an inferno that engulfed the American colonies! The architects of the revolution come alive along this historic trail as you pass sights like the Boston Common and the Old North Church, where Paul Revere’s famous lanterns once hung.
Learn about the Sons of Liberty and the webs of conspiracy and unrest which once threatened to shatter Boston into a thousand pieces. Uncover the truth about misunderstood events like the Boston Massacre and the Boston Tea Party.
See the city of Boston in a brand new light as you travel back to the time of John Hancock, Paul Revere, and Benjamin Franklin, all without having to fuss with a map! As you walk, audio stories will automatically pop up and start playing. It’s revolutionary history like you’ve never heard it before!
Start in the Boston Common or Bunker Hill Monument and tour with total flexibility. Featuring riveting stories, a phenomenal narrator, and easy automatic audio, this app puts exploration in the palm of your hand!
See all these historic sites and more along the Freedom Trail:
■ Boston Common
■ Massachusetts State House
■ Park Street Church
■ Granary Burying Ground
■ King's Chapel
■ Franklin Statue
■ Old Meeting House
■ Old Corner Bookstore
■ Old State House
■ Boston Massacre Site
■ Faneuil Hall
■ Paul Revere House
■ Old North Church
■ Copp's Hill Burying Ground
■ USS Constitution Museum
■ Bunker Hill Monument
RAVE REVIEWS:
“This was an amazing way to walk the Freedom Trail!!! The tracking through the GPS was spot on and it was having all the information provided on all the points!!!”
“I did not know a lot about the American revolutionary war and without overwhelming me, it brought the events of the time to life for me”
"The freedom trail tour was great. Wife and I shared a pair of wireless earbuds which I recommend. The tour is broken into many small sections which automatically stayed as we walked to the next point on the trail. It all worked perfectly, was extremely easy to use and very informative.
APP FEATURES:
■ Award-winning platform
The app, which has been featured on Thrillist, received the famed “Laurel Award” from the Newport Mansions, who use Action Tour Guide for over a million tours per year.
■ Plays automatically
The app knows where you are and which direction you are heading, and plays audio automatically about the things you are seeing, plus stories and tips and advice. Simply follow the GPS map & the routing line.
■ Fascinating stories
Be immersed in an engaging, accurate, and entertaining story about each point of interest. The stories are professionally narrated and prepared by local guides. Most stops also have additional stories that you can optionally choose to hear.
■ Works offline
No data, cellular or even wireless network connection needed while taking the tour. Download over Wi-Fi/Data Network before your tour. 
■ Freedom of travel
Explore on your own time, at your own pace, and with the flexibility to linger at stops that interest you. You have total freedom to skip ahead, stop and restart, and take as many photos as you’d like.
FREE DEMO vs FULL ACCESS:
Check out the free demo to get an idea of what this tour is all about. If you like it, purchase the tour to get full access to all of the stories.
QUICK TIPS:
■ Download ahead of time, over data or Wi-Fi.
■ Be sure the phone battery is fully charged, or take an external battery pack. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. This app uses your location service and GPS tracking feature to allow real-time tracking of your route.
T&C - https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Scanner is a convenient and easy-to-use application for scanning text documents. 
With this app you can easily scan, save and share docs.
You can scan any text information. 
Contracts, business cards, receipts, paper notes, articles, book pages - all this will be saved on your phone in PG format, and you can combine these images into PDF files.
