- fast scanning of documents;
- storage of documents;
- the ability to group documents;
- editing documents;
- the ability to sign documents;
- creation of multipage pdf files;
- sending fax from your iPhone;
- the ability to share documents;
- printing of documents.

bluejetty:00121596:ios.name: Ludo Master - Real Club King
bluejetty:00121596:ios.summary: Ludo Master game is fun and hilarious game to play with friends and family. It is King of all board games, lets you share some wonderful time with your loved ones. Don't wait any further, get the dice rolling to be the king of Board Games.
bluejetty:00121596:ios.description:
Ludo Master game is fun and hilarious game to play with friends and family. It is King of all board games, lets you share some wonderful time with your loved ones. Don't wait any further, get the dice rolling to be the king of Board Games.
This game has stayed popular throughout the ages, varying only a little in its game structure. The game is played between 2 to 4 players and you have the option of playing the game against the computer and against your friends.
** Features
- Added rules/options which are played and popular in the world.
- Option to show safe cells(square) which is represented by star icon.
- Option to get another turn on both dice number 1 and 6.
- All the rules are optional so you can play both international version.
- New modern design with wooden board.
- Option to choose the dice number 6 which will start the coin.
- Option to choose the number of coins to be played with 2,3 and 4.
- Multi player in the same device, 2 and 4 player Real-Time Ludo Master.
- Play against Computer.
- 3 consecutive rolls of 1 kills one own playing coin
- 3 consecutive rolls of 6 brings a coin out if all coins are in the yard
- New modern design with wooden or white board
- Dice changing color according to color of actual player on turn
- Variety of rules to meet your own taste of gaming experience
- Multiplayer in the same device up to 4 player
- Chest system to earn more rewards
Whoever gets all four tokens to the end first is the winner. However, each move can only be made based on the number decided by casting a six-sided die, and each token can only move out of their home by casting a six. Additionally, the competition factor of the games is upped by the fact that while moving if another player's token lands on the same square as your token, compete against world wide players and much more to go.
** Some rules of Game
- Each player chooses one of the 4 colors (green, yellow, red or blue) and places the 4 pieces of that color in the corresponding starting circle.
- Calling all the kings of Ludo Master game, here is your most popular & most loved Ludo Master game in its classical form. 
- How often you all wondered if we have a Ludo Master game in the wooden board? The board that we used to play when we were kids. 
** DESIGN
- You got classic wood and neo-Ludo Master boards (paper & white).
- It gives you a better visual experience and nostalgic feelings. 
- The sketch marks and crystal clear tokens will make us feel the same old classic Ludo Master board.
- The board is the square shape with 3 columns of squares and supports up to 4 players (2, 3 & 4 players in combination with Computer).
- Each player will take one color from bright yellow, green, red and blue. You can also assign all players as Computer and quietly watch each, it is quite a lot fun. :)
** DICE ROLLING
- We built an entirely new physics engine for die-rolling mechanics that will simulate the real-time rolling of a die or dice.
- The physics behind die-rolling was very challenging and I am proud to be the first one to implement. This will make it look like a 3D Ludo Master game.

Additionally, the competition factor of the games is upped by the fact that while moving if another player's token lands on the same square as your token, compete against world wide players and much more to go.

** Some rules of Game
- Each player chooses one of the 4 colors (green, yellow, red or blue) and places the 4 pieces of that color in the corresponding starting circle.
- Calling all the kings of Ludo Master game, here is your most popular & most loved Ludo Master game in its classical form. 
- How often you all wondered if we have a Ludo Master game in the wooden board? The board that we used to play when we were kids. 

** DESIGN
- You got classic wood and neo-Ludo Master boards (paper & white).
- It gives you a better visual experience and nostalgic feelings. 
- The sketch marks and crystal clear tokens will make us feel the same old classic Ludo Master board.
- The board is the square shape with 3 columns of squares and supports up to 4 players (2, 3 & 4 players in combination with Computer).
- Each player will take one color from bright yellow, green, red and blue. You can also assign all players as Computer and quietly watch each, it is quite a lot fun. :)

** DICE ROLLING
- We built an entirely new physics engine for die-rolling mechanics that will simulate the real-time rolling of a die or dice.
- The physics behind die-rolling was very challenging and I am proud to be the first one to implement. This will make it look like a 3D Ludo Master game.

bluejetty:00014248:ios.description:
Grafio turns 10. It's been around for a decade already - polished, efficient and with more features than ever before.
Grafio is not a tool for professionals only. Its smooth learning curve allows everyone to convey their ideas visually and with ease. Hundreds of thousands use Grafio worldwide, due to its simplicity and affordability.
There are no ongoing subscription costs or upgrade charges. Once you purchase it, you have access to an ongoing number of libraries (shapes and symbols) and a multitude of new features with every update.
Since Grafio was released 10 years ago, there have been 3 major upgrades, including dozens of new object libraries and a fresh new look to the layout.
To begin, simply draw a rectangle, circle or an ellipse and see what makes drawing with Grafio so easy and fun.  Grafio can recognize and replace any of the shapes mentioned with a perfectly looking one for your diagram or schematic, ready to be used over and over.
Drag and drop objects on the canvas for more complex diagrams. Make connections, add text labels and images.
SHAPE RECOGNITION
The shapes you draw are automatically closed and straightened, all basic shapes are instantly recognized. The lines you draw between shapes are automatically turned into connections thanks to our shape recognition magic.
STENCILS
Some diagrams require more advanced objects. Grafio provides thousands of shapes that you can easily drag in from the library. In addition, you can embed images from your Camera Roll into shapes and connect them to your other shapes.
AUDIO RECORDINGS
Recording audio notes to your shapes can be a way for you to collect your thoughts and include them in the finishing product, or as a reference.
- Video tutorials on Grafio can be found on YouTube:
http://bit.ly/grafiovideo
+++ FEATURE SET +++
• Shape recognition - recognizes hand drawn basic shapes
• Drag & drop shapes from many libraries
• Insert, embed, or paste images
• Precise drawing with Apple Pencil
• Build diagrams and graphs through connections
• Label shapes and connections
• Select, move, rotate and scale everything (even scribbles)
• Change size, color, opacity and other properties of your shapes
• Have a favorite font? Import your font from popular websites
• 10 Different connection types with adjustable radius
• Precision toolbar for nudging, rotation and resizing
• Flip, align and distribute shapes with a single tap
• AirPlay and video output for presentations
• Export to PDF, PNG or JPG
• Record audio notes with each object
• Export videos with how your design reaches the final product
• iCloud and Files integration
+++ THE POSSIBILITIES +++
• Make Designs
• Take Visual Notes
• Vector Sketches 
• Flowcharts and network diagrams
• Any diagram type that has a name: ArchiMate, Audit, Block, Cabling, Data Flow, Electrical, Gantt, P&ID, Sankey, SDL, TQM, UML, Use Case, Venn, Wireframe, Workflow, etc.
• Industrial Processes
• Organizational Charts 
• Basic Charts and Graphs 
• Mind Mapping (Brainstorming Diagram) 
• Web Site Maps 
• Road Plans
• Military operational and tactical plans
and many more...
+++ STENCILS +++

bluejetty:00063842:ios.description:
#1 Online Casino game of Pai Gow Poker!
Pai Gow Poker is a variant of Chinese Domino game also named Pai Gow, played with playing cards instead of Pai Gow's Chinese dominoes.
It is also known as Double Hand Poker. 
Pai Gow Poker can be thought of as a combination of 7-Card Stud Poker and the domino game.
In Pai Gow Poker you make two poker hands - one 5-card hand and one 2-card hand.
If your two poker hands beat the dealer's two poker hands, you win.
If only one of your hand wins, it's a push. And if both of your hands lose, you lose your bet.
You can start playing the Pai Gow Poker as soon as you open our game with 100,000 Bonus chips.
How To play :
1. A single 53-card deck is used, consisting of the usual 52 cards, plus one joker.
2. The joker is semi-wild. It may be used as an ace, or to complete a straight, flush, or straight flush, or royal flush.
3. Player makes an Ante bet and/or Fortune Bonus bets.
4. Player and the dealer get seven cards each. Dealer cards are dealt face down. The player examines his own cards.
5. The player will separate his seven cards into a five-card high hand, and two-card low hand. The high hand must be of higher poker value than the low hand.
6. The five-card hand is ranked according to conventional poker rules. The only poker hand in the two-card hand is a pair or no pair, after which the individual cards determine the value.
7. After the player has set his hand, the dealer cards are turned over and divided in the same manner, according to specified rules known as the "house way."
8. The two high hands will be compared, and the two low hands, the hand with the higher poker value winnings. If the event of a tie, for example both two-card hands are ace/king, then the tie has go to the "banker."
9. If the player wins both comparisons, then the player will win even money on his bet. If the player wins one and loses one, then the bet shall push. If the player loses or ties both, then the player shall lose his wager.
10. "Fortune" is a side bet in Pai Gow Poker that pays based on the value of the player's seven cards. It doesn't not matter how the player sets his hand. It pays based on the Fortune Bet payout table given below.

5 Aces 400 to 1
Royal Flush 150 to 1
Straight Flush 50 to 1
4 of a Kind 25 to 1
Full House 5 to 1
Flush 4 to 1

bluejetty:00069958:ios.description:
WRTI: Classical Music & Jazz Radio from Philadelphia
The WRTI App is the place to discover the best in classical and jazz radio. Time-honored and new recordings are meticulously selected by our staff, who create a consistently unique experience that is always a pleasure and always interesting. Our knowledgeable, friendly, and engaging hosts deepen your connection to the music. You’ll return again and again for the rich variety of music that is impossible to find on any other App. WRTI is one of America’s leading public radio stations devoted to music, on the air in Philadelphia for more than 60 years. Member-supported WRTI is a broadcast service of Temple University. 
App Features:
Live classical music stream
Live jazz stream
Real-time playlists
One-click stream switching – flip over to the other stream with a single click
On-demand arts stories
A built-in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to WRTI.
Easy access to pledge form
Listen to WRTI in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails! 
Listen to live streams from WRTI even while traveling! Start the App and your favorite station starts playing.
About WRTI
Broadcasting from Philadelphia for over 60 years, WRTI is one of America’s leading public radio stations, and one of the only stations devoted exclusively to to classical music and jazz. We also bring you weekly Sunday broadcasts of The Philadelphia Orchestra in Concert recorded live at the Kimmel Center for the Performing Arts, the Metropolitan Opera Saturday Matinee Broadcasts, Jazz Night in America from NPR, and much more.

bluejetty:00026949:ios.summary:
TheGrint is where golfers track their game, manage their handicap, and build a complete history of every round.
More than a golf scorecard, TheGrint brings your Handicap Index®, score tracking, golf stats, friends, games, and on-course too
bluejetty:00026949:ios.description:
TheGrint is where golfers track their game, manage their handicap, and build a complete history of every round.
More than a golf scorecard, TheGrint brings your Handicap Index®, score tracking, golf stats, friends, games, and on-course tools together in one place. Post scores, follow your progress, compare performance over time, and keep every round connected to your golf identity.
HANDICAP TRACKING & SCORE HISTORY
 • Track your golf handicap and see how it changes over time 
 • Link your USGA Handicap Index® and sync eligible scores in the US
 • Connect to the GHAP handicap network outside the US
 • Post rounds quickly with simple score uploads 
 • Get a Handicap Estimate if you don’t have an official handicap 
 • Look up other golfers’ handicaps and playing history 
 • Keep your score history organized in one golf app 
GOLF SCORECARD & ROUND TRACKING
 • Record scores hole by hole with an easy digital golf scorecard 
 • Track FIR, GIR, putts, penalties, and 18+ detailed performance stats modules
 • Save every round to build a long-term picture of your game 
 • Track scores from your phone or Apple Watch 
 • Upload a scorecard photo with TheGrint Pro 
GOLF STATS & PERFORMANCE
Turn every score into something useful.
 • Analyze trends across your rounds and across seasons
 • See strengths and weaknesses across key golf stats customized to your game
 • Compare your performance with golfers at your skill level with Pro benchmarks 
 • Follow your scoring, putting, accuracy, and approach-game progress over time 
PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Golf is better when your rounds are connected.
 • Add friends and follow their rounds 
 • Create live leaderboards 
 • Play Skins, Stableford, Match Play, Wolf, Vegas, Animals, and more 
 • Share scorecards, chat, and compete with your group 
 • See how your game stacks up against the golfers you play with most 
Discover where to play next, rank the courses you've played, and build your golf bucket list.
 • Search and explore golf courses with our golf-specific Course Discovery Map
 • See golfer ratings, course difficulty, scorecards, conditions, and other course details
 • Find out which courses your friends have played and discover highly rated courses nearby
 • Build your personal course rankings with quick head-to-head course comparisons
 • Keep track of your favorite courses and golf bucket list
 • Explore TheGrint Top 100 rankings across the U.S., Canada, UK & Ireland, and around the world
 • See how courses rank based on real golfer ratings, rankings, and playing activity
APPLE WATCH FOR GOLF
Keep your phone in the bag.
 • Enter scores and stats from your Apple Watch 
 • Track shots during your round 
 • View on-course distances from your wrist 
 • Access Green Maps with TheGrint Pro on supported courses 
GPS, RANGEFINDER & COURSE TOOLS
When you need on-course information, TheGrint has it.
 • GPS maps for 40,000+ golf courses worldwide 
 • Distances to greens, hazards, and landing areas 
 • Green Maps for 25,000+ courses with TheGrint Pro 
 • Explore courses, scorecards, rankings, difficulty, and friend activity 
 • Target dispersion tool for smarter shot planning
 • Additional GPS widgets, with green depths and labeled points on the map
THEGRINT PRO
The free plan covers the main things you'll need to like Score tracking, GPS, and playing with friends. Upgrade to Pro for deeper game tracking and more ways to play:
 • Advanced stats and insights 
 • Community performance benchmarks 
 • Green Maps at 25,000+ courses
 • Enhanced Apple Watch features 
 • Additional games and presses
 • Additional GPS tools and widgets
 • Scorecard Picture Service 
Whether you’re working toward a lower handicap, tracking every score, analyzing your golf stats, or competing with friends, TheGrint gives you one place to build your golf history and follow your game over time.
Download TheGrint and make every round count.
WHERE GOLF HAPPENS.

bluejetty:00161906:ios.description:
Avrora is the best sleep tracking app for those who would like to fall asleep easily and wake up energized with the help of special breathing techniques, mindfulness sessions, calming sounds–including white noise, nature sounds and sleep music– and refreshing alarm melodies.
The Avrora sleep helper app is based on the only extremely effective drug-free option for overcoming sleeping problems. Unlike sleeping pills, our sleep monitor it helps to eliminate the underlying causes of sleeping problems and develop better sleep habits.
HOW AVRORA WORKS
Falling asleep:
Deep calm breathing combined with relaxing sleep music and sleep sounds leads to the predominance of the processes of inhibition in the central nervous system. It allows Avrora to regulate pressure and heartbeat, focus attention on breathing, thereby distracting from unwanted thoughts and promoting better sleep. Deep and controlled breathing is evolutionarily associated with a feeling of rest and relaxation. In addition, soothing sleep sounds provide an opportunity to relax and get a positive emotion, effectively reducing the likelihood of excitation before sleep.
Sleep recording:
Our sleep tracker app is also a snore recorder and sleep recorder which helps you track snoring and other sleep habits, including sleep apnea.
Sleep retention:
Breathing techniques results in more reliable replacement of wakefulness rhythms (alpha and beta waves) with low-amplitude sleep waves (theta and delta waves), thus making sleep much more durable. Meditation sessions promote deep relaxation and mindfulness, bring the body to a deep and lasting sleep. Bedtime meditation qualitatively improves the most fragile REM phase, which allows you to complete a full sleep cycle and feel yourself full of energy in the morning.
Waking Up Refreshed
After a good deep sleep your body is restored and is ready to function in full. Our Smart alarm analyzes your sleep patterns and wakes you up gently from the lightest phase in your sleep cycle. Pleasant alarm melodies allow you to wake up gently, gradually and with no stress. It is very important for mental wellness to live the first minutes of your day with positive emotions and thoughts.
Sleep Sounds
Our sleep app offers a variety of nature sounds, sleep music, white noise, brown noise and pink noise options to choose from to ensure you can wind down from your stressful day, relieve anxiety and relax.
WHY DO YOU NEED AVRORA?
Ask yourself the following questions:
- Do you face difficulty getting to sleep or staying asleep?
- Do you feel tired in the morning right after you wake up?
- Do you have difficulty concentrating during the day?
- Are you struggling to stay organized?
- Do you feel so tired that all you can think about is sleep?
If you answered yes to any of these questions, then you can definitely benefit from using the Avrora app for sleep and wellness. Download Avrora and enjoy your perfect sleep experience.
WHY AVRORA?
We help you fall asleep easily.
We care about your sleep during the night. 
We wake you up smoothly with no stress.
FEATURING

- 30+ relaxing meditations for a better night’s sleep

- adjusting sleeping schedule

bluejetty:00014789:ios.description:
Unleash your Legal Compliance with TRF: Your Studio's Superpower!
Tired of the chaos of paper waivers and filing cabinets? Tired of petty apps that claim miracles for pennies? TRF is your solution, crafted by legit tattooers, revolutionizing the client waiver process AGAIN. Elevate your studio flow and reputation with a digital experience as sharp as your art.
Why TRF is a Must-Have for Tattoo Artists:
-Intuitive INCLUSIVE Client Experience: Clients start with a simple tap, gliding through an easy-to-use interface requiring no assistance, keeping you focused on what matters—your art. Your clients will find a human-loving, inclusive tone, as Voluta Digital respects human choices.
-In-Depth Artist Notes: Document all aspects of your tattoo sessions, from pigments to equipment, before or after the tattoo, ensuring compliance.
-Rock-Solid Cloud Security: TRF generates sharp, searchable PDF waivers stored securely in YOUR cloud, so they are never 'lost'. Currently supporting Dropbox, OneDrive, and (coming soon) Google Drive.
-Health Inspector Approved: Rest easy with TRF’s detailed and compliant waiver process that easily meets health regulations.
-Continual updates reflect the features YOU request.
Why TRF Reigns Supreme in the Tattoo World:
-Battle-Tested and Industry Approved: TRF app has been in the App Store for 11 years. An old goat! Driven by feedback from thousands of tattoo artists globally, we completely burned down, redesigned, and recoded TRF. It is the ultimate tool for serious professionals and young tattooers on the come-up!
-Absolute Customization: Dial in TRF to your local health and legal requirements to ensure seamless compliance.
-Unmatched PDF Waivers: Capture client IDs, signatures, tattoo details, health info, artist notes–and photos!–in every waiver.
-Blazing Fast Setup: Get your studio up and running with TRF in 10 minutes—no expert training is needed. Who needs crazy giant technical software and a guru to run it?
-Support from Your Peers: TRF rocks an in-app Knowledge Base we are proud of, and direct support from fellow tattoo artists with real online identities and portfolios.
Elevate Your Studio’s Efficiency and Professionalism:
-Cut Costs and Save Time: Eliminate paper, printer ink, and storage expenses. Free up your team's time for painting and sketch fights.
-Strengthen Legal Protection: Protect your studio with detailed, compliant digital waivers that stand up to health inspector scrutiny.
-Impress Your Clients: Offer a sleek, modern, and informative waiver process that clients will read. They need to know what they are signing!
-Save the Trees: Help us stop wasting trees for human legal dramas. You know you love trees!
Flexible Pricing for all of Us:
-Three ways to pay: Pay-As-You-Go Bundles and two Subscription choices, each with features designed to help studios of any size. You CAN afford to outsource that fear in your belly over health and legal compliance. Regulation is coming; look it up. Regulation = Documentation. Solve this for cheap with one app.
Brought to You by Tattoo Artists, for Tattoo Artists:
Conan Lea, a 27-year custom artist, designed TRF with a team of tattoo collectors with ADULT DAYJOB SKILLS who know and love our industry. With over 20,000 hours of tattooing in every tattoo style and a rich history of involvement in conventions as an artist, client, speaker, competition judge, award winner, and mentor to 17 tattooers, Conan has poured his industry knowledge into creating a tool that solves the most complex challenge to our success: Admin duties. This app is more than software; it’s Conan’s give-back to the artists and industry that made him.
Download TRF today and revolutionize your tattoo studio!
Join the global community of artists who trust TRF. Ditch the paperwork, innovate your studio, and shine with the professionalism and efficiency that only TRF can provide.

bluejetty:00135124:ios.description:
This app lets you measure the point-to-point (great-circle) distance between two or more waypoints on a map or measure the surface area defined by a polygon having three or more points as its corners.
It uses online maps so it needs an internet connection.
Tap and hold to set a new waypoint, tap the options icon to read the manual or to open the settings view to change the map type or the measuring unit. You can choose between (kilo)meters, feet/yards/miles and nautical miles. The options menu also lets you choose to go to the Save/Restore view.
Tap the calculated measurement at the bottom of the map to switch between feet/yards/miles or meters/hectometers/kilometers.

bluejetty:00075512:ios.name: Cladwell: AI Stylist & Outfits
bluejetty:00075512:ios.summary:
Cladwell is your digital closet and outfit planner. Open the app and today's outfits are waiting, styled from the clothes you already own, with your AI stylist's best picks first and a note on why each look works.
TODAY'S OUTFITS, PICKED F
bluejetty:00075512:ios.description:
Cladwell is your digital closet and outfit planner. Open the app and today's outfits are waiting, styled from the clothes you already own, with your AI stylist's best picks first and a note on why each look works.
TODAY'S OUTFITS, PICKED FOR YOU
Your stylist's recommended outfits lead each day, with a short note on why they suit you. Want more? Tap View more outfits and watch new looks appear as they're styled. Swap any piece, ask for a restyle, or add looks inspired by a photo you love. Switch on morning outfits and a few looks are ready when you wake up. Rate the looks you wear and your stylist learns what you love.
PLAN AHEAD, LOOK BACK
Plan outfits for the week ahead, or log what you wore on an earlier day. Build a look from any clothing or accessory you own, up to 12 pieces, with the same search and filters as your closet. Save outfits to Lists for work, trips or weekends, and find them from any capsule. Your outfits-worn count and streak show how much more of your closet you're wearing.
SEE IT ON ME
See an outfit from your closet on a photo of you before you get dressed.
YOUR SEASON CAPSULE
The Style tab builds a capsule for the season: about 33 pieces, mostly ones you already own. You get outfit formulas, the role each color plays, and the few pieces worth finding. Like it? Make it your capsule in one tap.
A SHOPPING LIST THAT FILLS REAL GAPS
Each missing capsule piece becomes a shopping list item with 3 to 5 real products from the brands you choose, within your budget. No impulse buys, just the pieces that unlock more outfits.
YOUR STYLE MAP
Take the free Style Quiz and get your Style Map: a plain description of the style you already have, and where you want to take it.
FIND YOUR COLORS
Take one photo and Cladwell reads your natural coloring to find your color season and palette. Your photo is used only to read your coloring, never to judge how you look or to infer your identity, age, gender, body or health.
A STYLIST THAT REMEMBERS
Ask Cladwell anything, from "what goes with these boots?" to "what should I pack?" Your stylist remembers what you tell it, knows which screen you're on, and can save a look, add it to a list or show it on you in one tap. Your rules and what your stylist has noticed live together in Style preferences. You can also connect Cladwell to ChatGPT from Settings.
A CLOSET THAT TAKES CARE OF ITSELF
- Add a piece and Cladwell recognizes and describes it. You can edit every detail.
- Improve photo cleans up your pictures, several in a row, with a before and after slider.
- Search, filter and tag everything you own.
- See your closet at a glance: what you wear, what you don't, and what's working.
Made for iPhone and iPad, including Split View.
FREE AND SUBSCRIPTION
Building and organizing your closet is free. Outfits, See it on me, your season capsule, the shopping list, color analysis and the stylist need a Cladwell subscription. A free trial is available for eligible new users. AI features include a monthly allowance, and Settings shows how much you've used.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.
Terms: https://cladwell.com/terms-of-service
Privacy: https://cladwell.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00084161:ios.description:
Your All-in-One AI Music and Voice Creation Companion
Reimagine the way you create and communicate with Echo AI - an advanced app that turns your words and ideas into music and speech. Whether you’re an aspiring musician or simply want to add more personality to your content, Echo AI helps you explore new creative possibilities and express yourself with ease.
Key Features
 - AI Song Creator:
Create music effortlessly - no instruments needed. Whether you’re experimenting for fun or working on professional projects, Echo AI helps you bring your musical ideas to life.
 - Realistic Text-to-Speech:
Transform text into natural-sounding audio in seconds. Choose from 25 diverse voice actors, male and female, to match the mood and style you’re looking for.
 - Global Language Support:
Create and communicate in over 28 languages, making it easy to reach audiences around the world.
 - Instant MP3 Export:
Export your audio to MP3 quickly and share it with friends, listeners, or collaborators.
 - Recording History:
Access all your past creations in one place with a convenient history feature that keeps your recordings organized.
 - Cartoon Voices:
Add a playful touch to your audio with a selection of animated, character-style voices.
User Access:
Echo AI allows you to try core features of the app to get a feel for music and voice creation.
Subscription Users:
Upgrade your creative workflow with subscription plans. Weekly plans allow up to 20 song generations and 60 voiceovers per week with full access to the voice library. Monthly and annual plans include up to 20 songs and 60 voiceovers per month. Subscribers can also clone up to three voices, with the option to add more, to better match their personal style.

bluejetty:00033937:ios.name: GPS Phone Location Tracker
bluejetty:00033937:ios.summary: Locato is a powerful and reliable GPS phone tracker that allows you to track and locate your loved ones in real-time. With Locato, you can ensure the safety of your family and friends by knowing their exact whereabouts at all times. Our app
bluejetty:00033937:ios.description:
Locato is a powerful and reliable GPS phone tracker that allows you to track and locate your loved ones in real-time. With Locato, you can ensure the safety of your family and friends by knowing their exact whereabouts at all times. Our app provides real-time location updates, comprehensive location history, and smart geo-fence notifications to keep you connected with those who matter most.
Key Features:
Real-Time Location Tracking: Know the current location of your loved ones on a live map.
Accurate GPS Tracking: Find the exact location of your family members and friends in real-time.
Location History: Access past location data to see where they've been.
Geofence Zones: Set up geofence zones to receive notifications when someone enters or leaves a specific area.
Device Tracking: Find lost or stolen phones using another family member's registered device.
Place Alerts: Get notified when family members arrive or leave specific locations like home or school.
Privacy and Consent: Location sharing is only possible with mutual consent to ensure privacy.
How It Works:
Add your family members' phone numbers to the app.
They accept the invite and share their location.
Track their location on the map in real-time.
Why Locato?
Easy Setup: Simply add your loved ones by their phone number and start tracking.
Peace of Mind: Ensure your family members are safe at all times.
Lost Phone Recovery: Track your lost or stolen phone using the app.
Please note that continuous use of location services can decrease battery life.
Subscription Information:
Locato offers a premium subscription plan with additional features, including unlimited location alerts, extended location history, and an ad-free experience. Subscription plans are available on a weekly, monthly, and yearly basis. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscriptions in your account settings.
By using Locato, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
Privacy Policy: https://reidxsoft.com/locato/gizlilik.html
Terms of Use: https://reidxsoft.com/locato/kullanim.html

bluejetty:00146248:ios.name: 84000 - All Buddha's Words
bluejetty:00146248:ios.summary:
Access a dynamic collection of teachings on the mind, straight from the source. The 84000 app offers a growing digital library of the Buddhist sūtras set within a minimal, functional design for a clean reading experience. 
84000’s interact
bluejetty:00146248:ios.description:
Access a dynamic collection of teachings on the mind, straight from the source. The 84000 app offers a growing digital library of the Buddhist sūtras set within a minimal, functional design for a clean reading experience. 
84000’s interactive Reading Room is a leading resource for accurate and nuanced translations of the words of the Buddha used by scholars of Buddhist Studies, Tibetan Buddhist teachers of the living tradition, and practitioners. 
Find more resilience
Narratives, dialogues, stories and more that expound upon the nature of reality and offer solutions that develop the mind’s capacity for equanimity.
Share your inspirations
Easily select passages from sūtras and share real Buddha quotes with your friends and loved ones.
Travel with a growing library
With almost 200 sūtras already available, the dynamic collection on your app will continue to grow for the next 90 years.
Learn, practice, and study while offline 
All our interactive tools are designed to aid your practice and to help you study, these remain fully functional even when you’re switching off in a meditation retreat or working towards a digital detox. 
THE APP INCLUDES
A dynamic collection of Buddhist sūtras encompassing teachings on everything from meditation techniques to epic and inspirational journeys and narratives; from profound presentations of philosophical logic to short stories illustrating the workings of karma.
Access to sūtra-specific introductions that articulate its key concepts, its narrative frameworks, and its socio-historical context. 
Interactive reading tools such as pop-up definitions of key terms like “samsara” or “non-duality” in a comprehensive trilingual glossary. 
Search function that allows you to look for characters, places, or philosophical concepts such as ‘Mañjuśrī’ ‘Vārāṇasī’ or ‘Bodhicitta’.
Ability to read bilingually or to compare translations with source Tibetan e-Kangyur folios integrated throughout the publications.
THE STORY BEHIND 84000
84000 is a global nonprofit initiative to translate all 231,000 pages of the Buddha’s words from the Tibetan Buddhist Canon and making them available in English, for free, for the first time ever. 
As a grants-based translation project and online publication house, we leverage and integrate new technologies to make our digital library of the Buddha’s wisdom as accessible and beneficial as possible to readers, practitioners, and scholars around the world.
Our work relies upon the dedicated and collaborative effort of scholars, professionals, volunteers, advisors, and sponsors around the world, working remotely and online, across continents. Together we translate for preservation and engage through open access for the benefit of all sentient beings. 
HAVE A QUESTION: https://84000.co/contact
LIKE US: https://www.facebook.com/Translate84000
STAY IN TOUCH: https://84000.co/subscribe
Translation Progress: https://read.84000.co/about/progress.html
Copyright Policy: https://84000.co/copyri

bluejetty:00026661:ios.description:
Keepsake is the easiest way to turn your photos into beautiful framed prints, delivered to your doorstep within days.
If you’re like us, you’ve probably got 7,000 photos on your phone. But what usually happens to them? Too often the moments that matter the most end up getting lost! With Keepsake it doesn't have to be that way.
INCREDIBLY SIMPLE
1. Choose a photo that you love
2. Preview it in over a hundred frames
3. In a few days, receive your photo in a beautiful handmade frame
PROFESSIONALLY FRAMED
We want you to love the item that shows up at your doorstep. That's why each Keepsake frame is made with incredible care. Frames are individually handmade at our studio, with professional quality materials and rigorous quality control. Whenever a Keepsake order is shipped out, we are confident that it's going to exceed expectations.
PERSONAL SERVICE
We take great pride in offering exceptional customer service. That's probably why Keepsake consistently receives such great reviews. In addition to responding to inbound questions or concerns, we review every order before it is sent to print, and we reach out if we think there is any chance you won't love your order. If you have any questions, contact us at support@keepsakeframes.com
REMARKABLY AFFORDABLE
We work hard to provide the fairest pricing possible. For customers in the US there are dozens of options under $40. Our larger frames cost a fraction of what is typically charged at a frame shop for the same handmade quality.
70,000+ FIVE-STAR REVIEWS
"I got my pics today and I absolutely LOVE them!! Thank you so much! They’re beautiful! You just never know what you’re going to get when you order something online but WOW! I’m so very pleased. Thank you again." - Crystal, Pittsburgh
"I absolutely love my framed photograph. Excellent quality and a treasure to last for years to come.” - Lorene, Seattle
"Gorgeous and excellent, just like it is every time! The shipment even arrived earlier than scheduled to a very remote rural address." - Tanya, Oklahoma

"I love my frames! If only I could get my husband to hang them up as quickly as you guys got them to me!” - Jo, Charlotte
"We love everything about it. You guys did a fantastic job and I am just beyond happy seeing these pictures hanging on the wall in my house. I will keep ordering from you guys! Thank you Keepsake! :-)” - Susie, Atlanta
"Fantastic frames! The prints are better than I anticipated considering they were a mixed bag and all from my iPhone. Thanks for making it easy and affordable!” - Noel, Madison
"My recent order was fantastic! I was able to hang all of my frames up and display them around my apartment, which made it feel more like home." - Helen, New York
"Perfection!! I love your product!! Thank you!! Some of the best gifting I’ve done since I discovered Keepsake!!" - Frank, Boulder
DOZENS OF QUALITY FRAMES TO CHOOSE FROM
It's fun to instantly preview your photo in dozens of different frame options. From tabletop frames to frames large enough to feature above your bed or sofa, browse different styles and decide which is best for your photo.
CREATE A GALLERY WALL
Looking to redecorate? It’s easy to create the gallery wall of your dreams within the Keepsake app. Add a variety of sizes and styles to your shopping cart and a few days after you order you'll receive the gallery wall your home has been begging for.
INCLUDE A FREE GIFT NOTE
With Keepsake you can send a thoughtful, personal gift in minutes. And better yet, the app makes it easy to include a fun gift note with your order
Have anymore questions about Keepsake? Email us at support@keepsakeframes.com or read our FAQ here: https://keepsakeframes.com/faq/

bluejetty:00200172:ios.description:
A living aquarium that changes with iPhone Duo. Fold it part-way for your desk. Open it flat to explore the tank. Choose the fish, plant a freshwater scene or build a reef, and share the view with someone else.
DESIGNED FOR iPhone Duo
• Fold part-way into a tabletop position to enter Desk view automatically. The aquarium and clock stay above the hinge, with feeding, lighting and aquarium controls below.
• Open the device flat to return from automatic Desk view to the full aquarium.
• The native layout responds to the hinge and keeps controls clear of the fold.
• On other iPhones, iPad and Mac, enjoy the aquarium and Desk view in their own screen layouts.
BUILD YOUR AQUARIUM
• Choose freshwater and reef fish, from shoaling tetras and angelfish to clownfish, tangs and gobies.
• Add plants, corals, anemones, rocks and wood. Place coral on live rock and adjust your scenery.
• Moving water, rippling light and real 3D scanned coral give the tank depth.
• Feed your fish and watch them gather. Tap a resident or piece of scenery to identify it.

bluejetty:00119709:ios.summary: TurboScan turns your iPhone into a full-featured and powerful scanner for documents, receipts, books, photos, whiteboards, and more. You can quickly and accurately scan your multipage documents in high quality PDFs or JPEGs, name, organize
bluejetty:00119709:ios.description:
TurboScan turns your iPhone into a full-featured and powerful scanner for documents, receipts, books, photos, whiteboards, and more. You can quickly and accurately scan your multipage documents in high quality PDFs or JPEGs, name, organize and send them anywhere. 
• Featured in The NY Times, CNN Money and The Telegraph.
• “Absolutely the best... I've tried other scanner apps and this one is the only way to go. Never going back to the other apps… TurboScan sets the standard for scanning apps.” - User review.
• “…Would recommend this flawless and incredibly useful and perfectly executed app” - User review.
TurboScan uses advanced and fast algorithms to accurately detect document edges, straighten them (correct perspective), eliminate shadows and set a perfect contrast for black on white text. Color and photo modes are also available.
TurboScan boasts a powerful yet easy to use interface. Our handy "Email to myself" feature lets you quickly send documents with one tap.
TurboScan also offers SureScan, our proprietary scanning mode for sharper scans (especially useful in low-light conditions.) SureScan automatically takes three pictures of the same document, giving you a guaranteed perfect result every time.
We do not collect any data from TurboScan and all scanning happens on your iPhone. The confidentiality of your data is never compromised. 
TURBOSCAN FEATURES: 
• Automatic document detection and capture with perspective correction
• Features SureScan for the sharpest scans
• Document naming, folder organization and smart search
• “Email to myself” feature for quick, regular emails
• Add and reorder pages at any time
• Arrange multiple receipts or cards on a single PDF page for printing, easy viewing, etc.
• Send faxes using our Turbo Fax app
• Easily email & message documents or separate pages as PDF & JPEG
• Save documents or pages to Photos
• Face/Touch ID & passcode lock for increased security
• Upload, auto-upload or backup documents to iCloud Drive
• Open PDFs or JPEGs in Google Drive and other PDF cloud apps
• Combine scans via Merge or copy & paste separate pages
• Conveniently AirDrop documents to your Mac and other devices 
• Print documents via AirPrint
• Ultra-fast scanning (under 3 seconds per page) 
• Features VoiceOver for visually impaired users
• We do not collect any user data in TurboScan
TIPS ON SCANNING 
• Make sure your document is flat. 
• Use flash in low light conditions, but avoid glare with glossy documents.
We support Ukraine.
We're constantly improving TurboScan, and we value our customers' opinions and feedback. Please email us at support@turboscanapp.com with any questions or suggestions. Thank you!

bluejetty:00079460:ios.description:
Empower Your Health Journey with the Blood Pressure app: Heart Rate.
Discover a smarter way to monitor and manage your health with the Blood Pressure App.
Key Features:
1. Contactless Face-Scanning Heart Rate Measurement:
 - Easily check your heart rate with our new, advanced rPPG (Remote Photoplethysmography) technology. Simply look into your front-facing camera for a few seconds. The app detects subtle, real-time micro-color changes in your skin caused by blood circulation to accurately calculate your heart rate (BPM) completely touch-free.
2. Fingertip Heart Rate Detection:
 - Conveniently measure your heart rate using the rear camera. Whether at rest or after exercise, our traditional pulse wave detection method ensures accurate readings. Simply press your finger against the rear camera until the circle turns red and observe the progress bar to see your results.
3. Blood Pressure Monitoring:
 - Regularly track your blood pressure levels by manually entering your logs to better understand your cardiovascular health over time.
4. Blood Sugar Tracking:
 - Easily record your glucose levels manually and monitor trends over time. Set medication reminders to help keep your blood sugar stable.
5. Hydration Reminders:
 - Stay hydrated throughout the day with personalized drinking water reminders. Easily meet your daily water intake goals.
6. Alarm Function:
 - Wake up refreshed with customizable alarm settings. Set multiple alarms according to your daily routine.
7. Personalized Health Plans:
 - Create and follow health management plans tailored to your needs. Set goals, track progress, and easily achieve your fitness targets.
8. Knowledge Updates:
 - Stay updated with the latest health trends and receive useful tips and relevant articles regularly through our knowledge push feature.
9. Comprehensive Health Tracking:
 - Monitor your overall health status with detailed reports and progress tracking. Gain a holistic view of your health journey.
Accuracy & Considerations:
Please note that the accuracy of heart rate measurements depends on various factors, including device quality and usage conditions. For high-intensity exercises or users with specific health concerns, professional monitoring devices are recommended.
Integration & Support:
- Apple Health Integration: Synchronize your blood pressure and heart rate data with Apple Health for seamless health management.
- Support: If you have any questions or need assistance, please contact us at M_proxyS@outlook.com.
Subscription Details:
- Weekly Package: $9.99/week with a discount
- Annual Package: $39.99/year
For more details, please refer to our subscription instructions: http://bpapp-better2023.com/subscription
Legal Statements:
- Disclaimer: Our app is intended for fitness and general health information purposes only and not for medical emergencies. It cannot replace professional medical diagnosis, advice, or treatment. If you have any medical conditions or health concerns, please consult a doctor. 
- Privacy Policy: http://bpapp-better2023.com/privacy
- Service Agreement: http://bpapp-better2023.com/term
Download the Blood Pressure app: Heart Rate. now and take control of your health journey!

Move the nuts to another position to remove the rod.

bluejetty:00149755:ios.description:
“单词块”的设计理念是回归背单词的本质，不预设任何学习方法，而是把精力重点放在做好词库质量、交互体验、记忆进度管理、AI人工智能技术等方面。给予用户最高的自由度，让用户自己去挖掘最适合自己的使用方法。
您可以将想要学习的单词加入“单词块”，按照应用的指导背诵和测试这些单词。AI人工智能会追踪每一次学习过程，评估出您对每个单词的掌握程度，并提醒在合适的时间进行复习。富有现代感的全新设计，更能为您带来前所未有的沉浸式体验。
■色彩记忆系统
进入应用里，您会看见各个单词以不同的颜色显示在界面上。这就是“单词块”独创的色彩记忆系统。每一种颜色代表着您对这个单词的熟悉程度，而熟悉度由系统根据您的每一次学习状态由AI智能算法分析计算得出。您可以通过颜色块直观的了解到哪些单词自己比较熟悉或者陌生、哪些单词刚刚学过、哪些单词正处于遗忘时期需要尽快复习等。
“单词块”里的每一个颜色都经过设计师精挑细选，力求以最直观易懂的方式呈现给用户，漂亮的色彩搭配可以增加单词学习的爽快度和趣味性，降低学习过程中的枯燥感。
■AI算法与深度学习
普通背单词应用的艾宾浩斯记忆曲线都是固定的，只会根据预设好的时间间隔来提醒用户复习，比较僵硬。
而“单词块”里的每一个单词都有独立的记忆曲线。通过大量用户的学习情况作为样本，训练出“单词—遗忘曲线”的映射，进而推导出“词根—遗忘曲线”，然后在漫长的英语学习中不断的利用这个映射和修正这个映射。力求用更加科学客观的方法来反馈用户的学习水平和勤奋程度。目前这个体系还未全部开放出来,后续的版本将会不断完善。
■词库介绍
本应用的单词数据库根据各类考试大纲和语料库词频收录数十万条各类单词的英文和中文释义，整合了市面上各类免费和开源资料，利用 BNC/COCA 语料库进行词频矫正，并使用 NodeBox, WordNet 等自然语言处理工具包对各类时态语态，派生词等进行补充和标注。并根据考试大纲和柯林斯星级还有牛津 3000核心词进行标注，让你一眼就能看出这个单词的重要性。
■“单词块”的学习建议:
·背单词不能一味图快
·长期坚持，形成永久记忆
·背单词最重要的就是你和它的见面次数
·不断利用碎片化时间来加强记忆
·通过音频刺激大脑记忆单词
·查看每个单词的学习进度，并分析日志
■特色总结
·独创颜色块设计，让美感与实用性完美融合
·全新的AI智能遗忘算法，准确评估每个单词的学习进度
·采用更加科学客观的方法来反馈用户的学习水平和勤奋程度
·全网最新最全的词库，包涵200多万词汇
·众多单词应用里的一股清流，无登录，无社交，无签到，无游戏，无课程推销等无关干扰功能，聚焦背单词核心体验。
·每项功能都经过严苛的测试与打磨。细节追求完美，力求为大家带来最沉浸式的体验
告知：
单词块需要请求后台播放权限，得以实现单词块的播放学习模式切换到后台继续朗读的功能。

bluejetty:00038008:ios.description:
In this diversified and fast-paced era, each of us may be a combination of multiple identities - a professional in the workplace, a warm member of the family, and a reliable partner among friends. In order to help you communicate efficiently in different social circles and professional fields, we designed "Dual Messenger", an application designed for users who want to manage multiple communication accounts.
Core functions:
Dual Messenger
Dual chat allows you to log in and manage two communication accounts at the same time. Whether it is intimate communication in private life or formal communication in the workplace, the two accounts run independently without interfering with each other to protect your privacy.
Don't miss any important information
No matter which account you use, Dual Chat can remind you of important messages from another account to ensure that you don't miss any important information.
Data security
We use advanced and secure encryption technology to ensure that the chat data in your account is only stored locally on the device, thereby fully protecting your data security.
Improve work efficiency
Dual Messenger also provides you with a wealth of other features, such as voice-to-text, contact grouping, quick phrases, emoticons, etc., allowing you to efficiently manage chat content and contacts.
Continuous Optimization
We know that users' needs and expectations are constantly changing, so Shuangxin Chat will continue to update and optimize to provide better services and experience. We will regularly launch new features, fix known issues, and make improvements based on user feedback.
Whether it is distinguishing the boundaries between work and life, or managing social accounts in different regions or languages, Shuangxin Chat can be your right-hand man. Download Shuangxin Chat now to start your new era of dual-track communication, making communication more convenient, efficient and personalized!
Disclaimer: This application is an independent message backup software and is not affiliated with any instant messaging platform. Users need to ensure that their data export behavior complies with the terms of service of the messaging platform they use.
Subscription Information
This dual-account tool provides free features and optional paid upgrades to help you manage two spaces on one device while ensuring stable performance.
Paid featur

bluejetty:00070047:ios.description:
See a horse, but don't know its breed? Just take a picture and find out!
The Horse Scanner app will identify your horse's breed reliably in just a few seconds! Besides taking a picture, you can also record a video or upload an image from your gallery.
No horse around?
Doesn’t matter! The Horse Scanner app also recognizes humans: Simply scan yourself, your friends, your family or the people around you and find out which horse you resemble the most!
------
NEW! Become a part of our Horse Scanner community!
Share your results and compare them to the results of the community! Upload pictures of your favorite horse to our Social Feed and share them with other horse lovers! Have a look at the profiles and photos of other users, like and comment on posts from the community and filter them by date or popularity!
Additionally, you can easily share your posts with your friends by simply sending a picture directly from the Horse Scanner app.
------
NEW! Catch all horse breeds and become an expert!
Catch all the horse breeds with our Gamification feature – just like in Pokémon Go! Master the challenges, earn virtual treats and become a true horse expert! Compete with your friends or users from the community and climb to the top of our ranking list!
------
So many horse breeds in the Horse Scanner app!
The Horse Scanner app currently identifies more than 160 different horse breeds, including all common breeds from the Andalusian Horse to the Tennessee Walking Horse, as well as many other popular national and international horse breeds! Our comprehensive database with information and pictures of all supported horse breeds (including the unofficial ones) can also be accessed completely without scanning!
Give us feedback on the Horse Scanner app!
Let us know if the horse’s breed has been correctly identified. If not, you will get useful tips to improve your own results. If you also indicate which horse breed is in the picture, you help us to enhance our software since the app automatically learns how to provide even more accurate outcomes. Also suggest or vote for (unofficial) horse breeds that you want us to add to the app in the future!
Get your premium upgrade!
With our premium version, the app will no longer show ads and your results will be available faster. Furthermore, you can now choose whether your horse breeds should be recognized rather quickly or with higher accuracy. With the premium version, scanning horses is also possible in offline mode, so you no longer need an active internet connection to identify their breeds. With the optional in-app purchase of our premium version, you will also help to support this app.
------
Find us on social media!
On our social media channels we provide you with the most beautiful horse pictures from the community. You will also find many interesting facts about your favorite animal. Furthermore, we will keep you updated on all new added features of the Horse Scanner app in the future.
* Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/horsescanner_app
* Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/HorseScannerApp
* Twitter: https://twitter.com/HorseScannerApp
------
Just give it a shot!
Horse recognition as easy as it gets! Despite the small app size you will get all features and be able to identify a horse’s breed or get access to our extensive database at any time! Simply scan your horse with the app and the horse breed will automatically be determined within seconds! Download the Horse Scanner app now!
Terms of Service:
https://scanner.siwalusoftware.com/terms-of-service

Catch all the horse breeds with our Gamification feature – just like in Pokémon Go! Master the challenges, earn virtual treats and become a true horse expert! Compete with your friends or users from the community and climb to the top of our ranking list!

------

So many horse breeds in the Horse Scanner app!

The Horse Scanner app currently identifies more than 160 different horse breeds, including all common breeds from the Andalusian Horse to the Tennessee Walking Horse, as well as many other popular national and international horse breeds! Our comprehensive database with information and pictures of all supported horse breeds (including the unofficial ones) can also be accessed completely without scanning!

Give us feedback on the Horse Scanner app!

Let us know if the horse’s breed has been correctly identified. If not, you will get useful tips to improve your own results. If you also indicate which horse breed is in the picture, you help us to enhance our software since the app automatically learns how to provide even more accurate outcomes. Also suggest or vote for (unofficial) horse breeds that you want us to add to the app in the future!

Get your premium upgrade!

With our premium version, the app will no longer show ads and your results will be available faster. Furthermore, you can now choose whether your horse breeds should be recognized rather quickly or with higher accuracy. With the premium version, scanning horses is also possible in offline mode, so you no longer need an active internet connection to identify their breeds. With the optional in-app purchase of our premium version, you will also help to support this app.

------

Find us on social media!

On our social media channels we provide you with the most beautiful horse pictures from the community. You will also find many interesting facts about your favorite animal. Furthermore, we will keep you updated on all new added features of the Horse Scanner app in the future.

* Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/horsescanner_app
* Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/HorseScannerApp
* Twitter: https://twitter.com/HorseScannerApp

Horse recognition as easy as it gets! Despite the small app size you will get all features and be able to identify a horse’s breed or get access to our extensive database at any time! Simply scan your horse with the app and the horse breed will automatically be determined within seconds! Download the Horse Scanner app now!

Build and decorate your Tropical Island!

PAWSOME STORY - With loads of quests to complete, you’ll never run out of things to do on your tropical island.
MAKE A WISH – Play matching games and win gifts to make the cats' dreams come true!

bluejetty:00179937:ios.name: Learn Shapes & Colors Games
bluejetty:00179937:ios.summary:
Learn shapes and colors with fun educational games for kids. Practice shape names, color recognition, tracing, drawing, matching, memory and simple logic activities designed for toddlers and preschool learners.
Learn shapes and colors whil
bluejetty:00179937:ios.description:
Learn shapes and colors with fun educational games for kids. Practice shape names, color recognition, tracing, drawing, matching, memory and simple logic activities designed for toddlers and preschool learners.
Learn shapes and colors while playing
Children can identify shapes, recognize colors and build early learning skills through simple interactive activities. Each game is designed to make learning visual, playful and easy to understand.
What kids can practice
• Shape and color recognition
• Shape names and color names
• Tracing and drawing
• Coloring activities
• Matching shapes to silhouettes
• Memory games
• Sequences and logic activities
• Size sorting and visual skills
• Reading and writing practice
Creative and educational activities
Kids can paint shapes, match colors, complete visual sequences and practice fine motor skills while learning. The activities support attention, memory, logic and early vocabulary.
Multilingual learning
Includes voices and text in multiple languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian and Portuguese, so children can learn shape and color names while improving pronunciation and vocabulary.
Why parents love it
• Simple and intuitive for young children
• Great for preschool and early learning
• Combines colors, shapes, drawing and tracing
• Supports memory, logic and fine motor skills
• Fun educational activities for everyday play
Make learning shapes and colors fun with tracing, coloring, matching, drawing and memory games in one simple app.

bluejetty:00160061:ios.name: Heatmiser Neo
bluejetty:00160061:ios.summary: The Heatmiser neoApp is intended to be compatible with the Heatmiser neoHub, neoHub Mini, and neoStat WiFi. The devices that are included are the neoStat, neoStat Pro, neoStat Touch, neoStat WiFi, neoUltra, neoAir, neoStat-HC, and neoPlug.
bluejetty:00160061:ios.description:
The Heatmiser neoApp is intended to be compatible with the Heatmiser neoHub, neoHub Mini, and neoStat WiFi. The devices that are included are the neoStat, neoStat Pro, neoStat Touch, neoStat WiFi, neoUltra, neoAir, neoStat-HC, and neoPlug. Collectively, they provide you with the most extensive method to manage your heating system and appliances from any location.
Flexible GeoLocation - With No Subscription
Our flexible Geo location system puts you in control. You don't need to switch the entire house heating off when you leave, you can decide on a room by room level what happens. 
Smart Profiles
With Neo Smart Profiles, you can create and store multiple Profiles in the neoHub ready for use later. Our new "Apply to" function lets you quickly assign the profile to any number of zones in your home. Programming your heating system has never been so simple.
Multi Location
Neo supports Multi Location, enabling you to quickly switch between any of your locations.
Hours Run

bluejetty:00178140:ios.summary:

Residents have the ability to pay rent with a single tap, man
bluejetty:00178140:ios.description:
The Greystar Resident App provides a convenient way to pay rent, submit maintenance orders with photos, and communicate with your apartment community all from your mobile phone.
Residents have the ability to pay rent with a single tap, manage one-time or recurring rent payments and receive rent reminder push notifications with the app (see below for a list of key features).
 If you have feedback, suggestions or bugs about the app itself, please email rpapp@entrata.com, we would love to hear from you!
Greystar Resident App Features:
• Make a One Time Payment - Easily submit a one time payment with the same trusted payment platform you have always used. 
• Add/Delete Recurring Payments - Easily schedule new auto-payments ensuring your rent will never be late.
• One-Tap Pay - Pay rent with a single tap right from your smartphone. The app remembers your last used payment method and knows your exact balance due.
• RentNotify - Sends push notifications to your device, reminding you to pay rent.
• Contact Property - Contact your property directly from the app. The app automatically routes your call to the appropriate after-hours number when the office closes.
• Submit Maintenance Requests - Submit a maintenance request right from the app. 
• Take a Picture of the Problem - Use your smart phone's camera to take a picture of the maintenance issue without leaving the app.
• Inspections - Complete move-in, maintenance, and other inspections right from your mobile device.
• Touch ID Login - After initial setup, securely log in to the app by scanning your finger print
• Face ID Login - Authenticate with your face with iPhone X+
• 3D Touch Support - Quickly pay rent, submit a maintenance request, or view your balance by tapping and holding the app icon. 
Please note: The Greystar Resident App is only for residents of properties using Entrata's ResidentPortal and ResidentPay products at Greystar property locations.

bluejetty:00084238:ios.description:
Earn rewards by completing online surveys and participating in selected game offers directly from your smartphone. It’s designed for people who want to make practical use of their spare time, whether at home, commuting, or taking short breaks during the day. These surveys are provided by market research companies seeking feedback from real users. Your responses help businesses improve products and services used by people every day.
Before starting any survey, you’ll see important details including the estimated completion time and the reward offered for finishing it successfully. This allows you to decide whether the survey fits your schedule. There’s no obligation to complete every available survey, and there are no long-term commitments. You choose when and how often you want to participate.
Survey availability depends on your profile and the criteria required for each study. In some cases, you may need to answer a few short screening questions to confirm eligibility. If you don’t qualify for a specific survey, you can return to the main dashboard and explore other available opportunities.
In addition to surveys, Golden Surveys also features game offers with rewards. You can earn rewards by reaching specific milestones in selected mobile games, such as completing levels or achieving certain in-game objectives. The requirements and reward amounts are clearly displayed before you begin, so you know exactly what’s expected.
All completed activities and earned rewards are automatically recorded in your account. You can check your balance at any time, review your participation history, and see which surveys or games contributed to your total rewards. Information is presented in a clear and organized way to help you track your progress easily.
Golden Surveys is built with simplicity in mind. The interface is straightforward and user-friendly, making it suitable for both new users and those familiar with survey apps. Registration is quick, and once your profile is set up, you can start participating right away.
Rewards accumulate gradually based on your activity and eligibility. This is not a guaranteed income, but an opportunity to receive rewards in exchange for your time and opinions. The amount you earn depends on the number of surveys you qualify for, the availability of game offers, and how often you choose to take part.
When your balance reaches the required minimum threshold, you can redeem your rewards via PayPal or select from available gift cards within the app. Redemption options and minimum payout amounts are clearly shown in your account. There are no hidden fees associated with requesting a payout.
Golden Surveys emphasizes transparency. Each survey and game offer includes a description of the requirements, estimated time commitment, and reward details before you begin. You remain in control of your participation at all times and can decide when to take a break or stop using the app.
New surveys and offers are added regularly, depending on active market research projects and partnerships. This means available opportunities may change over time, and new options can appear frequently.
New users may receive a welcome bonus after successfully completing their first eligible surveys. The bonus is credited directly to your account, giving you an early introduction to how rewards are added and tracked.
Golden Surveys – Earn Rewards brings together online surveys and reward-based game offers in one convenient app. You choose the activities, monitor your balance, and decide when to redeem your rewards.
Download Golden Surveys and start participating in surveys and game offers from your phone, at your own pace.

EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00026630:ios.description:
Park smarter with the SpotHero iPhone app. SpotHero helps you get everywhere, easier by making it fast and convenient to find and reserve parking in major cities. Plus, when you book your parking spot in advance, you can save up to 50%.
SpotHero gives you access to thousands of garages, lots, and valets nationwide. Whether you’re commuting to work, heading to the airport, or exploring your city, we have a parking spot near you. Use the SpotHero parking app to reserve parking in New York City, Los Angeles, Chicago, Atlanta, Austin, Baltimore, Boston, Dallas, Denver, Detroit, Houston, Indianapolis, Milwaukee, Minneapolis, Miami, New Orleans, Newark, Oakland, Philadelphia, Sacramento, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, St. Louis, and Washington, D.C.
How does it work? It’s easy. Just look, book, and park!
1. Look: Enter the dates and times you need parking. Then compare parking garages and rates near your destination.
2. Book: Pre-pay to reserve your spot.
3. Park: Follow the directions on your parking pass to your selected garage, park your car, and go! 
SpotHero is now integrated with Apple CarPlay. Drivers can use SpotHero with CarPlay to find, book and pay for off-street parking in over 300 cities across North America without touching a phone.
Parking for work? Create a business profile to separate business and personal parking expenses, then automatically send receipts to Concur, Expensify, Certify or Chrome River. Have a commuter benefits card? Use pre-tax dollars to pay for daily parking near your work. Need to book monthly parking? Tap the Monthly Parking tab on the search screen to get started and simplify your commute.
Have a question?

Discover AI Character from around the globe and speak with them to discover their capabilities.
From your morning cup of tea to brushing your teeth at night, AI Character has the conversations to make your day. Whether you’re a chatterbox, a tech fanatic or simply looking for a laugh, there’s something for everyone. Enjoy a never-ending stream of AIs you’ll love to chat with.
With the official mobile app for AI Character you can:
- Chat with ultra-realistic AI personalities
- Enjoy unlimited free messaging (and no ads!)
- Discover millions of user-created Characters
- Use advanced creation tools to create anything you need
【Real-Time AI Character Interaction for Immersive Experiences】
Powered by the most capable AI models, AI Character provides an immersive and interactive experience, allowing users to converse with diverse AI personalities. Each interaction is tailored to be engaging, making every conversation with AI characters a unique and captivating journey.
【Effortless Creation of Unique AI Characters】
Users can craft characters that truly represent their vision, adding a personalized touch to their digital interactions. Whether for fun, storytelling, or unique digital presence, Rochat provides the tools to bring distinctive virtual personas to life effortlessly.
【Unlock the Power of AI, Easy and Efficient】
AI Character offers a suite of creator tools, designed to not only inspire your creativity but also assist in your creative process. These tools can help you brainstorm ideas, generate written content, and even create visual artwork. Whether you're working on a writing project, developing graphic designs, or exploring artistic concepts, AI Character provides a versatile and innovative approach to creativity, blending cutting-edge AI technologies to support and enhance your artistic endeavors.
Immerse yourself in captivating stories, get homework help from your favorite anime personas, learn a new language, and even write a novel… all with the help of the most advanced AI assistant that YOU design! The only limit is your imagination and we encourage you to push the frontier of what’s possible with this innovative technology. Welcome to the AI Character community We’re excited to see what you bring to life!
【About PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION】
You can subscribe to get unlimited access to premium bots. The subscription will automatically renew unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period unless you change your subscription preferences in your account settings. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed or canceled via your iTunes Account settings: Setting > iTunes & App Store > Apple ID > manage subscription after purchase.

ColorFold is a puzzle game that's all about folding and moving coloured ribbons - sounds easy, right?
Move the ribbons in order to fill all checkpoints with the right color. Overlap ribbons, use barriers as a strategic advantage or use the mirrored ribbon, which copies your moves, to make it to the very end. Or use the new oneway-gates and tunnels to complete all levels.
But I don't want to spoil it all - check it out for yourself, especially if you're into challenging puzzles!

Features:
- 200 handcrafted levels
- Universal app with iCloud saves
- Taptic Engine support
- no ads
- no in-app purchases

Happy folding!

bluejetty:00155384:ios.description:

Toda semana, adicionamos novas figurinhas e recursos para manter o app atualizado.
Assinantes podem sugerir figurinhas que desejam ver no app.
Faça parte da nossa comunidade de CriativasLovers e transforme a forma como você se expressa nos stories.

Além de tudo isso, você conta com funcionalidades incríveis, como: trocar a cor das figurinhas, colocar opacidade, favoritar suas figurinhas preferidas, criar suas próprias figurinhas dentro do app, salvar suas cores mais usadas nas figurinhas...

Criado para facilitar a vida dos criadores de conteúdo, o app é referência no Brasil para quem deseja engajar e se destacar com stories impecáveis e originais.

Toda semana, adicionamos novas figurinhas e recursos para manter o app atualizado.

Assinantes podem sugerir figurinhas que desejam ver no app.

Faça parte da nossa comunidade de CriativasLovers e transforme a forma como você se expressa nos stories.

bluejetty:00137106:ios.description:
An adrenaline-fueled drag racing game that puts players in the driver's seat of fully manual cars, complete with clutch control. Set in a sprawling cityscape teeming with rival gangs and their formidable leaders, players must rise through the ranks and conquer the streets through sheer skill and speed.
In "Car Manual Shift 4", players navigate the treacherous urban jungle, challenging rival gangs and their kings in pulse-pounding drag races. With each victory, players earn reputation and cash to upgrade their car's performance, fine-tuning every aspect from engine power to car paint and skins.
But it's not just about speed; strategy and precision are key. Players must master the delicate balance of shifting gears and timing their clutch release to maximize acceleration without losing control. Each race is a test of nerve and technique, where split-second decisions can mean the difference between victory and defeat.
As players progress, they unlock access to a garage filled with an arsenal of high-performance cars, each offering unique handling and customization options. From classic muscle cars to sleek imports, there's a ride for every racing style and preference.
To suit every player’s preferred experience, the game features three exciting modes:
1. Manual Mode: Full control with clutch, gears, and gas for the ultimate authentic racing challenge.
2. Automated Mode: No clutch needed, with manual gear shifting and gas for a balanced yet thrilling experience.
3. Tiptronic Mode: No clutch and no gears—just a + and - button to seamlessly switch gears, perfect for those seeking simplicity without sacrificing intensity.
Get ready to dominate the streets and prove you're the ultimate racing champion in "Car Manual Shift 4"!

bluejetty:00126700:ios.description:
Learning English is important from the basics, and phonetic symbols (IPA) are the first knowledge that English learners need to master.
**Key Features:**
- **Comprehensive Phonetic Symbol Learning**: Covers all English phonetic symbols, including short vowels, long vowels, diphthongs, and consonants, helping you fully understand and master English pronunciation.
- **Interactive Learning**: Enhances your learning effectiveness through lively and fun interactive exercises. The app provides rich examples and exercises to ensure that you do not feel bored during the learning process.
- **Phonetic Symbol Comparison**: Unique comparison features for similar phonetic symbols, helping you distinguish common pronunciation errors and improve your pronunciation accuracy.
- **Native Speaker Demonstrations**: Learn correct pronunciation methods step-by-step with demonstrations of standard mouth movements by native speakers, making your pronunciation more natural.
- **Pronunciation Tips Sharing**: Detailed analysis of pronunciation tips, helping you grasp the key points of pronunciation and solve pronunciation problems.
- **Real-time Feedback**: Provides real-time pronunciation scoring and feedback, helping you correct pronunciation errors promptly and continuously improve.
- **Word Pronunciation Details**: Shows the pronunciation details of each word, comparing the pronunciation of each syllable, and learning the correct pronunciation through examples.
**Target Audience:**
- **English Beginners**: Start from scratch, systematically learn English phonetic symbols, and lay a solid foundation for pronunciation.
- **Learners Seeking to Improve Pronunciation**: Correct pronunciation errors and improve pronunciation accuracy and fluency.
- **English Enthusiasts**: Further understand the mysteries of English pronunciation and improve listening and speaking skills in English.
Whether you are a beginner or already have some knowledge of English, our app will be the best partner for your English learning journey. Download now and start your English learning journey!

bluejetty:00088837:ios.description:
Dreamy Room is more than a game; it’s a heartfelt journey that reminds us of the beauty in life’s quiet, ordinary moments. 
With every box you open, you’ll uncover personal belongings and carefully find the perfect spot for each item. As you unpack, you'll reveal the story of a life, room by room, year by year, piecing together tender memories and heartfelt milestones.
Take your time to organize, decorate, and create cozy spaces that tell a story without a single word. There’s no timer, no pressure—just the peaceful satisfaction of bringing order to chaos.
From tiny trinkets to treasured keepsakes, every object carries meaning. You'll find yourself reminiscing, imagining, and smiling as you unpack a life and watch it unfold before your eyes.
Let the gentle visuals, soothing sounds, and thoughtful gameplay wrap you in a warm hug of nostalgia and comfort. 
Why You'll Love Dreamy Room?
A Relaxing Escape: It’s the perfect blend of mindfulness and creativity, offering a peaceful retreat from the chaos of daily life.
Beautiful Storytelling: Each item you place reveals pieces of a life story, told entirely through objects—personal, intimate, and deeply relatable.
A Cozy Atmosphere: With soft visuals, calming music, and no timers, it’s all about taking your time and enjoying the process.
The Joy of Organizing: There's something deeply satisfying about putting everything in its perfect place and creating a space that feels just right.
Nostalgia and Emotion: From childhood bedrooms to first apartments, every room tells a story that sparks memories and emotions we all share.
Unique Gameplay: It’s unlike anything else—simple, intuitive, and endlessly charming.
Dreamy Room isn’t just a game—it’s a cozy escape into the beauty of life’s little details, a journey into the little moments that make a house feel like home.
