bluejetty:00140483:ios.description:
Discover new dimensions of creativity with ArtEasy!
Learn how to draw step by step with built-in lessons — from basic shapes to advanced sketches. The lesson library is constantly expanding, making ArtEasy a growing learning platform for artists of all levels.
ArtEasy is a mobile app that lets you draw using augmented reality technology (AR drawing). Project images onto any surface through your smartphone camera and trace them to create bright and original drawings.
The AR Drawing app is perfect for both beginners and experienced artists — everyone can unlock their creative potential here.
Download AR Drawing app "ArtEasy" and start making unique pictures today — using augmented reality and your imagination using your phone.
What the app offers:
– Convenient projection of images onto any surface: paper, wall, table, etc.
– Add your own images from the gallery or browser — draw whatever you like.
– Generate custom templates using AI — just type your request and get a unique sketch created instantly.
– Built-in image search: enter a query in the search window, browse the results in your browser, and instantly import any sketch or picture into the app.
– “My Templates” section, where all your added images are saved.
– Large catalog of ready-made sketches, constantly updated with new collections.
– Drawing lessons to help you learn and improve step by step.
– Simple and user-friendly interface — suitable for all skill levels.
– “Favorites” tab to save your preferred templates for quick access.
Template categories include:
– Anime
– Cartoons
– Anatomy (eyes, lips, hands, etc.)
– Animals
– Cars
– Tattoos
– Simple drawings for kids
– People
– Nature
– Food, and more.
Who ArtEasy is for:
– Those who want to learn to draw from scratch.
– Artists aiming to improve their skills.
– Everyone who wants to create and enjoy the process.
Download the AR drawing app "ArtEasy" now and learn how to draw like never before! Unlock new creative possibilities and take your skills to the next level with augmented reality.
Subscription information:
– Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.
– Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
– Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, with the cost of renewal specified.
– You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal after purchase by going to your Apple ID account settings.
– Subscriptions can be canceled at any time in your Apple ID settings. All prices include applicable local sales taxes.
– Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
– After the 3-day free trial period, if offered, the subscription will automatically renew at the applicable rate unless canceled before the trial ends.
Privacy Policy: https://arteasy.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://arteasy.app/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00035979:ios.description:
To install ESET Password Manager, you either need to receive the invitation to use it or have an ESET HOME Security Premium or ESET HOME Security Ultimate subscription.
ESET Password Manager allows you to manage your passwords, credit card numbers and other sensitive information, and access them from anywhere.
All content in the application is encrypted, protected by a master password, and ONLY YOU have access to it.
The ESET Password Manager app allows you to:
- Take advantage of Password Generator to create random and secure passwords 
- Increase the security of stored passwords with Two-Factor Authentication
- Manage access to your passwords with the Secure Me feature that:
 - provides a complete overview and detailed information about active sessions on all of your devices and browsers
 - allows you to log out of all your sessions remotely
 - provides actions to improve your security (delete cookies, download history and bookmarks, close tabs, log out from all Password Manager’s sessions), either on a device or remotely, depending on platform or browser. 
- Use ESET Password Manager for Two-Factor Authentication to your accounts for even stronger security
- Check a Security report to see if your passwords are among breached passwords and data leaks
- Add multiple identities for easier completion of online forms 
- Prioritize favorite accounts to move their passwords to the top of the list
- Access your passwords on the go from your iOS and macOS devices, and other platforms. 
ESET technology protects more than one billion internet users worldwide.
Find out more about the ESET Password Manager iOS app for ESET HOME Security Premium or ESET HOME Security Ultimate: 
https://www.eset.com/int/home/protection-plans/
For more info about privacy policy, visit:
https://help.eset.com/password_manager/3/en-US/privacy_policy.html
For EULA visit:
https://help.eset.com/password_manager/3/en-US/terms-of-use.html

Welcome to Jelly Mukbang Hero ASMR Game, the most addictive and satisfying game where you become a true Jelly Master! bluejetty:00081622:ios.description:
“Top 5 Games of the Week” – Pocket Gamer
“Phantolex is smart, brain-teasing, [and] throws surprises” – Metro.co.uk
"Best and freshest [word game] on iPhone” – Stuff.tv
Phantolex is a rogue-like word game with a twist: the goal is to avoid spelling the word. Think of it like hot potato - you'll take turns adding letters, but don't be the one to finish the word. As you progress, you'll use powers and face tougher levels, but if you lose, it's game over!
How to Play:
- Build Words: Take turns against Casp adding letters and avoid being the one to complete a word.
- Strategic Powers: Use powers like Letter Rewind, Bluff Stopper, and Word Connoisseur to gain an edge.
- Endless Levels: Progress through increasingly challenging levels, unlock rewards, and win a run!

bluejetty:00114185:ios.description:
Fuel your day the healthy way. Stack Wellness Cafe makes healthy eating transparent and affordable. We offer nutrient-rich smoothies, bowls, wraps, salads, and healthy snacks perfect for your pre- or post-workout fuel, and active healthy lifestyle. • Order ahead & skip the line – lunch is ready when you are. 
• Customization made simple – swap proteins, add double meat, track macros. 
• Real-time nutrition – see calories, protein, carbs & fats before you check out. 
• Reward points on every dollar – unlock $-off coupons and free smoothies faster.

• Location finder – get directions, hours and phone numbers for every café. 
• In-app promos & limited editions – be first to try new seasonal flavors.
Whether you’re grabbing a protein-packed breakfast, a 15-minute meal deal, or a post-workout smoothie, the Stack Wellness Cafe app keeps clean eating easy, affordable and fast.

bluejetty:00126624:ios.description:
Love birdwatching? Then you must have this app! Take hundreds of different bird sounds with you to the forest or field! 
OVER 200 SPECIES of birds and over 1400 high quality sounds. 
The application covers most of the territory of Europe and can be successfully used in the most part of Northern, Central and Eastern Europe, including Scandinavia, Baltic States, Balkan countries, Transcaucasia, Northern Kazakhstan and other adjacent territories.
In our application:
• Galliformes
• Geese
• River Ducks
• Sea & Diving Ducks
• Sandpipers
• Birds of Prey
• Gruiformes
• Owls
• Urban birds
• Garden birds
• Forest birds
• Meadow birds
• Wintering birds
• Seagulls
• Storks, Herons & Bitterns
ALL SOUNDS:
• Male songs
• Calls
• Alarm calls
• Juveniles calls
• Aggression calls
• Group songs
• Display flight
• Communication calls
ORGANIZE your own playlist and listen to birds! 
Download the app and have a professional birdwatching experience!
PROTECT BIRDS FROM STRESS!
Do not use the app to play voices for a long time, this can disturb them, especially during the nesting period. Play recordings to attract birds for no longer than 1-3 minutes! If birds show aggression, stop playing the recordings.
Privacy Policy: https://tapa.su/birds-privacy-policy/
Terms Of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00039550:ios.description:
Using Temp-Mail app, you can instantly generate disposable temporary email address and immediately receive emails, including photos or any other attachments. 
Forget about revealing your real email to everyone. It causes endless spam, advertising mailings, email hacking, and phishing attempts. Keep your real inbox clean and secure. Temp Mail provides a temporary, anonymous, free, disposable email address in 10minute mail style. 
This app is an advanced version of services also known as 10minutemail, disposable-mail, fake email, guerrillamail, mailinator, getairmail,mohmal mail, throwawaymail, tempmail, tempail, anonymous-mail, spambox, tmail, burnermail, trashmail, 20minute email, and others. But much more robust and with an option to unlock unique premium features. 
Why use Temp-Mail?
● Hide yourself from spam
● No registration is required
● Generate temporary disposable email
● Protect your privacy and anonymity by not allowing spam in your personal inbox
● Receive multiple or single attachment(s) which can be downloaded from email 
● Multi-language 
● Emails are constantly being securely deleted forever
With Temp-Mail app, you can : 
● Generate a new email address instantly 
● Copy to clipboard or using QR-code 
● Receive emails and attachments automatically
● Get push notification of new emails
● Read incoming emails, including attachments 
● Download sources (EML), including attachments 
● Quickly delete and/or generate new email addresses 
Access Extra features with Premium : 
● Custom email names 
● Multiple mailboxes 
● In-app emails view 
● Premium domains 
● Extended email storage
● Premium support 
● No ads 
If you choose to purchase Temp-Mail Premium, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. Premium subscription prices can depend on user country, you can see exact terms and prices clearly on purchase screen. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription. 
All personal data are kept according to privacy policy, terms of service and available here: 
https://temp-mail.org/privacy-policy-app 
https://temp-mail.org/terms-of-service-app 
Temp-Mail in the press:
Our service was mentioned a lot in various publications, youtube videos and social media posts. 
"Dealing with spam flooding your inbox can be stressful, and you have better things to do than go through and delete them." - Entrepreneur.com
"It’s a great way of maintaining some anonymity and keeping your main email free from phishers, scammers, and dodgy data buyers." - TheNextWeb.com
"The iOS app gives you a temporary e-mail address so that your 'real' inbox stays clean. This makes it an ideal solution for dealing with newsletters, bots and questionable websites"- Iphoned.nl
"However, the more secure method is to take advantage of the Temp Email app. With this app, it will generate a temporary email address that isn't associated with you or your personal information. With this app, you will receive any emails sent to this email address such as any account verifications or confirmation codes." - Gadgethacks.com
---
Please note: You cannot send email using this app, only receive. 
Moreover, our free service handling a couple millions emails per hour. Therefore, we are not able to store emails more than 1-2 hours and the domains may be the subject for change. Do not use temporary emails for registering important accounts or receiving sensitive data. We have no ability to restore emails or domains once removed. 
Please send us any suggestions or inquiries to : support@temp-mail.org

No Extra Devices: Accurately measure your pulse and HRV (Heart Rate Variability) anytime, anywhere.
Daily Mood Tracker: Log your feelings and reflect on your day with our built-in thought diary.
Smart Insights: Spot trends and see how your body responds to waking up, exercising, or stressful moments.

bluejetty:00100445:ios.description:
Tavern Tale is an indie action RPG that blends cute 3D fantasy charm with dark roguelike adventure. The entire world has been sealed into a mysterious cube by an evil witch. Her mobs roam everywhere.
But in a hidden corner stands a warm little tavern built by the dwarf Hank and his friends—the only safe shelter left inside the cube.
Your adventure begins the moment you push open the tavern door.
[Tiny Board, Bold Roguelike]
This cube world shifts with every step—sometimes a blessing, sometimes a crisis. Surprises, choices, quick action, and a dash of luck blend into a uniquely thrilling roguelike run each time. Every dungeon, every forest path hides a new story waiting to unfold.
[30+ Heroes to Build Your Dream Squad]
Meet the adorable heroes:
• Snow, the gentle-hearted girl
• Kelly, the treasure-loving mage 
• Master Otto, the tai-chi otter who strikes with style
And more heroes await.
Each hero brings exclusive magic, signature trinkets, and a unique RPG-style growth path—discover wild build synergies and craft your dream squad.
[Casual Growth, Clever Depth]
Tavern Tale mixes roguelike adventure with a cozy, progression-driven RPG core.
8 magic paths, 200+ spells, endless trinket synergies. Collect StarCookies, slot Starstones, and grow powerful—with zero pressure. 
Every hero comes with growth paths, exclusive magic, and build-changing trinkets—letting you craft a playstyle that feels truly your own.
[A Fantasy Story You Live In]
From the noisy tavern hub to the cube's strange secrets, every corner drips with fairy tale imagination—dark yet cute, dangerous yet heartwarming. Chat with quirky guests, uncover the world's hidden story, travel through forests under the moon, and grow bonds with companions who journey beside you. 
A charming, dark-fantasy roguelike adventure is unfolding inside this cursed cube.
Will you break the witch's spell and escape?
Welcome to Tavern Tale!

bluejetty:00126100:ios.description:
Holy Rosary by JELOYO - Your Daily Catholic Prayer Companion
Prayer brings us closer to God, strengthens our faith, and fills our hearts with peace, hope, and love. In the midst of our busy lives, taking a few moments to pray helps us experience God's presence and seek His guidance every day.
Holy Rosary by JELOYO is a complete Catholic prayer app designed to accompany you on your spiritual journey. Whether you are seeking peace, offering prayers for loved ones, or deepening your devotion to Jesus and Mother Mary, this app brings meaningful Catholic prayers and devotions together in one place.
From the Holy Rosary and Audio Rosary to powerful Catholic Novenas, Divine Mercy Chaplet, Holy Bible, Daily Mass Readings, and Prayer Requests, discover a beautiful way to make prayer part of your everyday life.
HOLY ROSARY AND AUDIO ROSARY
Experience the beauty of the Holy Rosary and meditate on the life of Jesus through Mother Mary.
- Pray the Joyful, Sorrowful, Glorious, and Luminous Mysteries.
- Follow the daily Rosary mysteries for each day of the week.
- Choose Short, Medium, or Long Rosary prayers.
- Listen to guided Audio Rosary prayers with different voice options.
- Enjoy adjustable playback speed and background audio.
CATHOLIC NOVENAS AND 54-DAY ROSARY NOVENA
Discover traditional Catholic Novenas and strengthen your devotion through daily prayer.
- Pray 9-Day Catholic Novenas and the 54-Day Rosary Novena.
- Track daily prayer progress, completed days, and Novena streaks.
- Set personalized reminders for individual Novenas.
- Follow your prayer journey and stay consistent.
Explore Novenas to Our Lady of Lourdes, Fatima, Velankanni, Mount Carmel, Guadalupe, Our Lady of Sorrows, Mary Undoer of Knots, Mother of Perpetual Succour, and more.
DAILY CATHOLIC PRAYERS AND REFLECTIONS
Bring God's presence into every moment of your day.
- Morning Prayers to begin your day with faith.
- Night Prayers for peace and restful sleep.
- Daily Christian Affirmations for hope and encouragement.
- Gratitude Prayers to thank God for His blessings.
- Daily Bible Verses for spiritual inspiration.
HOLY BIBLE AND DAILY MASS READINGS
Grow in faith through the Word of God.
- Read the Holy Bible and reflect on Scripture.
- Follow Daily Catholic Mass Readings.
- Read the First Reading, Second Reading, Psalm, and Gospel.
- Highlight, copy, and share meaningful Bible verses.
DIVINE MERCY CHAPLET AND WAY OF THE CROSS
Deepen your devotion to Jesus through the Divine Mercy Chaplet and the 14 Stations of the Cross. Reflect on His mercy, sacrifice, and unconditional love through traditional Catholic prayers.
PRAYER REQUESTS - PRAY FOR ONE ANOTHER
Prayer becomes even more meaningful when we pray together.
- Share your personal prayer intentions.
- Pray for the needs and intentions of others.
- Offer prayers for healing, family, peace, and loved ones.
- Join a caring community united in faith.
PRAYER REMINDERS AND PROGRESS TRACKING
Make prayer a consistent part of your daily routine.
- Set separate reminders for different Catholic Novenas.
- Schedule reminders for the 54-Day Rosary Novena.
- Track 9-Day Novena streaks and completed prayers.
- View your prayer status and continue your spiritual journey.
A BEAUTIFUL WAY TO GROW IN FAITH
Whether you are beginning your Catholic prayer journey or have been praying the Rosary for years, Holy Rosary by JELOYO offers a peaceful space to connect with God.
Find comfort in prayer, strength in Scripture, and hope through the intercession of Mother Mary. Let every prayer bring you closer to Jesus and fill your heart with His love.
Download Holy Rosary by JELOYO and make daily prayer a beautiful habit.
Pray with Mary. Walk with Jesus. Grow in Faith.

bluejetty:00018933:ios.description:
Brick Game - Retro Games is the compilation of the best games from the most popular console of the 1990s. Do you feel tired of with complicated and difficult games? Did you miss the favorite classic games? Let's play this game to feel nostalgic!
Game features:
• 19 games in 1
• Many level and speed
• 11 different classic themes
• 8 bits sound
• Share high score with your friends, family via social apps
• Submit score to leaderboard
Game list:
A - Brick Puzzle Classic:
Move and rotate the falling blocks. Lines are cleared when they are filled with blocks and have no empty spaces
B - Tank Classic:
Move tank and shoot bullet to kill enemy. The speed and intelligence of the enemy will increase after each level
C - Racing Classic:
Move racer left right to avoid enemy, the speed will be increase after each level
D - Snake Classic:
Move the snake to avoid obstacles and eat more foods to grow in size
E - Supplement Shooting Classic:
Move the gun platform, shoot block to the sky to fill the falling blocks. When the blocks are filled, they will collapse upwards
F - Shooting Players Classic:
Move the gun platform, shoot to destroy the falling blocks before they touch the ground
G - Brick Breaker Classic:
Smash a wall of bricks by deflecting a bouncing ball with a paddle
H - Frog Across River Classic:
Control player move and jump to avoid all obstacles
I - Match Three Classic:
Change blocks of different shapes to match given blocks falling down
J - Brick Puzzle Classic II :
After brick fall down, all bricks will move right 1 unit
K - Brick Puzzle Classic III :
After brick fall down, all bricks will invisible
L - Brick Puzzle Classic IV :
After some bricks fall down, all bricks will move up 1 unit
M - Brick Puzzle Classic V :
Instead rotate brick, in this mode the brick can be exchange to other shapes
N - Brick Puzzle Classic VI :
The reverse of original version through vertical axis
O - Racing Classic II:
Control the racer avoid all obstacles on the road. The speed will be increase after each level
P - Ping Pong Classic:
Control the paddle to hit a ball back and forth and compete against with a computer-controlled opponent. The aim is reach ten points, points are earned when opponent fails to return the ball to the player.
Q - Racing Classic III:
Control racer avoid enemy in 3 lanes road, the speed will be increase after each level
R - Snake Classic II:
Move the snake to avoid obstacles, through 4 holes and eat more foods to grow in size
S - Brick Puzzle Classic VII:
With bomb and single brick, the game will be exciting

bluejetty:00187992:ios.description:
Beekeeper, the all-in-one Frontline Success System, is transforming the way frontline businesses work. Our mobile-first platform helps companies ditch paper and manual processes to improve employee engagement, retention, and performance.
Empower employees with direct access to the people, processes, and systems they need to do their best work. Companies around the world use Beekeeper to connect their teams, unify their systems and drive their businesses forward.
Give your employees one place to look for shift schedules, paystubs, onboarding, training, tasks, safety checklists, announcements, and more.
Use Beekeeper for:
 · Real-time Communication and Collaboration - use chats, streams, surveys, polls, and campaigns that close the loop with your frontline. Communication happens in real-time. And cross-team collaboration can happen anytime and from anywhere with inline translation. 
 · Boosting Frontline Productivity - Replace paper and manual processes with modern ways to get work done. Digitize daily tasks, checklists, and forms to prevent mistakes and save teams time. Automate critical processes to improve your teams’ productivity.
 · File Sharing - share documents, photos and videos with your co-workers.
 · Shift Management - Mobile-first shift notifications built for frontline teams. Easily accommodate employee requests to offer shift flexibility.
 · Streamlining Employee Services - Extend existing HRIS systems so team members can access shifts, pay slips, & training – all from one app on their mobile phones. Services that used to take days can happen in minutes: from PTO requests and shift changes to onboarding or offboarding processes. Automate your workflow by integrating the tools and services you already use, including Workday, ADP, Microsoft Azure, SAP, and more
 · Obtaining Data-Driven Insights on Your Frontline - Capture data that used to be hidden in paper forms and spreadsheets. Managers make better decisions while offering the best possible employee experience.
 · Boosting Employee Engagement and Reducing Turnover - simple employee surveys let you gather critical feedback in minutes and make impactful changes.
 · Fast-Track Frontline Digital Transformation - Save time and IT costs with easy, out-of-the-box integrations, dedicated configuration support, and automated workflows. You can even create custom integrations or workflows with Beekeeper’s open API and suite of tools for developers.
 · Enterprise-Level Security and Compliance - your data and privacy are protected with state-of-the-art encryption.
Made with love in Switzerland.

Empower employees with direct access to the people, processes, and systems they need to do their best work. Companies around the world use Beekeeper to connect their teams, unify their systems and drive their businesses forward.

Give your employees one place to look for shift schedules, paystubs, onboarding, training, tasks, safety checklists, announcements, and more.

Use Beekeeper for:

 · Real-time Communication and Collaboration - use chats, streams, surveys, polls, and campaigns that close the loop with your frontline. Communication happens in real-time. And cross-team collaboration can happen anytime and from anywhere with inline translation. 

 · Boosting Frontline Productivity - Replace paper and manual processes with modern ways to get work done. Digitize daily tasks, checklists, and forms to prevent mistakes and save teams time. Automate critical processes to improve your teams’ productivity.

 · File Sharing - share documents, photos and videos with your co-workers.

 · Shift Management - Mobile-first shift notifications built for frontline teams. Easily accommodate employee requests to offer shift flexibility.

 · Streamlining Employee Services - Extend existing HRIS systems so team members can access shifts, pay slips, & training – all from one app on their mobile phones. Services that used to take days can happen in minutes: from PTO requests and shift changes to onboarding or offboarding processes. Automate your workflow by integrating the tools and services you already use, including Workday, ADP, Microsoft Azure, SAP, and more

 · Obtaining Data-Driven Insights on Your Frontline - Capture data that used to be hidden in paper forms and spreadsheets. Managers make better decisions while offering the best possible employee experience.

 · Boosting Employee Engagement and Reducing Turnover - simple employee surveys let you gather critical feedback in minutes and make impactful changes.

 · Fast-Track Frontline Digital Transformation - Save time and IT costs with easy, out-of-the-box integrations, dedicated configuration support, and automated workflows. You can even create custom integrations or workflows with Beekeeper’s open API and suite of tools for developers.

 · Enterprise-Level Security and Compliance - your data and privacy are protected with state-of-the-art encryption.

Made with love in Switzerland.

bluejetty:00141967:ios.description:
Design Your Dream Home, Inside & Out
Meet Deco—the most complete interior design app powered by AI. Whether you’re planning a full remodel, refreshing one room, or simply exploring ideas, Deco gives you everything you need to transform your space. Snap a photo, pick your style, and watch your dream home appear in seconds.
Your Ultimate Interior Design Features:
► INTERIOR & EXTERIOR REDESIGN
Redesign anything—from a single room to your entire house. Upload photos of your bedroom, living room, kitchen, or even your home’s exterior and watch them transform.
► WALL PAINT & WALLPAPER CHANGE
Test different wall colors and patterns without lifting a brush. Try bold accent walls, calming neutrals, or playful textures to see how they transform your space.
► FLOOR RESTYLE
Swap out old floors for stylish parquet, tiles, or sleek modern finishes. Instantly see how new materials change the look and feel of your room.
► GARDEN DESIGN
Bring life to your outdoor spaces with AI-powered landscaping. Add greenery, pathways, or seating areas to visualize your perfect backyard retreat.
► CUSTOM DESIGN – YOUR HOME, YOUR STYLE
Want something unique? Describe your dream style in words, and Deco AI will generate a personalized design made just for you.
► ROOM STAGING
Turn empty rooms into fully furnished spaces. Add sofas, beds, tables, and décor to see how furniture fits and flows before you buy anything.
► COLOR PALETTES
Discover harmonious combinations that tie your whole design together. From subtle tones to vibrant mixes, find palettes that create balance and mood.
► DIVERSE STYLE CATALOG
Explore a wide range of design styles: cozy boho, minimalist, farmhouse, modern chic, eclectic, Parisian, and beyond. There’s a look for every taste.
► DESIGN GALLERY
Keep all your creations organized in one place. Perfect for mood boards, inspiration, or planning your next big renovation.
► UNLIMITED DESIGNS WITH PRO ACCESS
Get unlimited transformations, faster results, and full creative freedom by upgrading to Deco Pro. 
► SAVE & SHARE
Download your designs in high quality and easily share them with friends, family, or even professional designers.
From living rooms and bedrooms to gardens and backyards, Deco is your creative toolkit for every corner of your home. No need for multiple apps—everything you need for redesign, planning, and inspiration is right here.
Download Deco today and start your journey to a beautifully redesigned home!

Answer all questions based on official IQ tests to determine if you're a genius!

* Accurate and Expert-Prepared: This highly accurate IQ test is crafted by experts to ensure reliable results.
* Interactive Design: Enjoy a beautiful and engaging user interface.
* Unlimited Tests: Take as many IQ tests as you want.
* Solutions Included: Access solutions for all questions to learn and improve your IQ.
* Global Ranking: Receive your IQ score and see how you rank globally.
* Social Sharing: Share your IQ score with friends on Facebook.

* Time Commitment: The IQ test takes approximately 30-45 minutes to complete.
* Comprehensive Analysis: Get a detailed breakdown of your IQ score.
Why Choose Superb IQ Test?
If you love quizzes, puzzles, and brain teasers, this app is perfect for you!

bluejetty:00174623:ios.description:

o app conta com as datas de pagamentos do fundo de garantia 2026.
Um app simples e objetivo para consulta de datas do FGTS.
Para realizar a consulta da data, basta escolher o mês de seu aniversário, o mês influencia na data de pagamento pesquisada pelo app.
Ao selecionar o mês o aplicativo já lhe informará a data de pagamento do FGTS. Saque Aniversário.
Principais funções:
Planejador financeiro: Tenha controle total das suas finanças pessoais com o planejador. Organize seus gastos.
Calculadora de Recolhimento: A calculadora de recolhimento mensal é uma ferramenta prática e intuitiva, projetada para ajudar a estimar tanto o valor mensal do recolhimento quanto o montante todo. Ideal para planejar suas finanças
Calculadora de rescisão CLT: A calculadora efetua o cálculo referente à rescisão de contrato de trabalho.
Cálculo de Critérios PIS/PASEP: A calculadora verifica a elegibilidade ao abono salarial calculando os critérios. 
Calendário Abono Salarial: Descubra quando receber seu PIS/PASEP
Valores a receber: Verifica se existem valores esquecidos em bancos, consórcios ou outras instituições financeiras. Orienta sobre como solicitar o resgate.
Calculadora carro novo, compare o custo do carro atual com o novo cenário e entenda o impacto mensal.
Notícias públicas .

bluejetty:00044386:android.description:
🌟 Take Control of Your Financial Journey
Struggling to track daily expenses, manage multiple savings plans, or forecast monthly budgets? Meet Personal Budget & Loan Tracker, your financial management tool designed to simplify money tracking, debt management, and financial planning. Whether you’re saving for a vacation, managing personal loans, or optimizing spending habits, this app empowers you to achieve financial freedom with precision.
📌 KEY FEATURES TO MASTER YOUR FINANCES
1. 🏦 REAL-TIME BALANCE & ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
Effortlessly select your preferred currency from multiple currencies for accurate money management.
2. 💸 EXPENSE TRACKER & BUDGET PLANNER
Record daily expenses with comprehensive categorization (food, bills, entertainment, etc.).
Set monthly budgets and get alerts when you’re close to overspending.
Use pie charts and bar graphs to visualize spending patterns and optimize budgets.
3. 📅 LOAN & DEBT MANAGEMENT
Track loans (borrowed or lent) with details like interest rates, payment deadlines, and reminders with smart note.
Generate export reports for loan agreements or financial audits.
4. 💰 INCOME TRACKING & SAVINGS GOALS
Log income activities (salary, bonuses, side hustles) and compare them against expenses.
Create savings plans for big goals (vacations, emergencies) with progress trackers.
Budget forecast tools to predict cash flow and adjust spending habits.
5. 📊 VISUAL FINANCIAL INSIGHTS & REPORTS
Dynamic dashboards with pie charts and categorized spending breakdowns.
6. 🛠️ ADVANCED TOOLS FOR SMART USERS
Atomic brokerage integration to monitor investments alongside daily expenses.
💡 Why Choose Personal Budget & Loan Tracker?
User-friendly interface with personalized insights and monthly spending reports.
All-in-one solution: Combines expense manager, debt tracker, and financial planner in one app.
Secure & efficient: Manage financial data without upgrade required for core features.
🔧 Additional Features to Elevate Your Experience
Multiple savings plans and bill reminders to stay organized.
Export reports for loan agreements or financial audits.
Date range filters and automatic draft payments for seamless money management.
✨ Download Personal Budget & Loan Tracker to transform your financial routine with innovative personal loans, streamlined debt management, efficient daily expense tracker and intuitive personal budget tools.
⚠️ Disclaimer
This app is for personal budgeting and expense tracking only. It does not provide financial, investment, or legal advice. No banking services, loans, or transactions are supported. All data is stored locally on your device.

bluejetty:00174824:ios.description:
Welcome to the era of AI-driven imagery with AI Leap — Your Ultimate Free AI Photo Editor and Generator!
Formerly known as LightX Express, AI Leap is a powerful and free-to-use AI centric app designed for users seeking an advanced AI photo editing and generating experience.
Here's a glimpse of what AI Leap has to offer:
►AI Image Generator:
This text-to-image AI is the perfect tool if you're looking to create AI-generated photos without any prompt expertise. Generate AI photos of celebrities in a fantasy world or a futuristic landscape in any style. The tool's ability to choose from various styles, puts you in full control of the generated outcome.
►AI Headshot Generator:
Create professional headshots effortlessly by seamlessly changing backgrounds and outfits in ordinary selfies. Perfect for both men and women, this feature maintains your facial features while providing realistic results.
►AI Art Generator:
Enjoy the perfect blend of art and technology! Create stunning AI paintings and AI drawings with just a few words. AI Leap offers a variety of artistic styles to choose from, making it easy for you to bring your envisioned AI art to life.
►AI Filters:
Give your selfies, landscapes, and even pet pictures a touch of magic with AI Filters. Turn your images into anime-inspired scenes or experiment with a variety of popular filters to add that extra flair to your visuals. 
►AI Outfits:
Experiment with different outfits using AI without altering your facial features. Easily explore a variety of fashion options for both men and women using preset styles or create your own outfit combinations by describing your ideal attire.
►AI  Hairstyles:
Try out new hairstyles and hair colours with AI. The AI seamlessly integrates new hairstyles into your picture, making them appear realistic; The fastest and easiest way to see which hairstyle works for you. 
►AI Tattoo Generator:
Your long-time search for your next tattoo is over. The AI Tattoo Generator from AI Leap makes it easy not only to design your tattoo but also to try it on your body. Simply mask the part where you want the tattoo, write a prompt to describe the tattoo, and generate realistic results.
►AI Portrait Generator:
Explore the realms of AI selfies with our AI Portrait Generator. Transform into different fictional or TV characters from head to toe effortlessly. This tool is designed to produce highly artistic and creative results while preserving your unique look.
►AI Avatar Generator:
Craft digital representations of yourself in style! Get yourself into various fantasy skins with AI Avatar Creator, represent your identity, preferences, or characteristics in one click. 
Upon login, enjoy 10 free credits for image generation on the platform; where each credit generates one image.
PRO SUBSCRIPTION 
Unlimited Access Subscription
- You can subscribe for unlimited access to all features and content offered for purchase within “AI Leap”.
- Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan. Alternatively a one-time payment plan is available (this is not a subscription).
- Subscriptions auto-renew at the cost of the chosen package, unless cancelled 24-hours in advance prior to the end of the current period. The subscription fee is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Per Apple policy, no cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
- Terms of use: https://www.lightxeditor.com/terms/
- Privacy policy: https://www.lightxeditor.com/privacy/

Every block has a place. Find it—and watch a picture appear.
Pixaw combines the satisfying fit of a block puzzle with the colorful reveal of pixel art. Drag shaped pieces onto the board, match the colors and letter hints, and complete the picture one piece at a time.

• Look at each piece’s shape, colors and letters.
• Find its matching space on the picture board.
• Drag it into place and fill the artwork.

Enjoy familiar block shapes and a variety of pixel pictures. Choose a difficulty for the artwork and give your observation and spatial thinking a gentle workout.
MAKE ROOM FOR MORE ART
Complete pictures, display your artwork in your museum and grow a collection you can enjoy looking back on.
YOUR NEXT LITTLE BREAK
Pick a picture for your commute or a quiet moment at home. If you enjoy jigsaw puzzles, colorful block games and relaxed picture puzzles, try fitting your first Pixaw piece.

Meet Brello: A complete telehealth platform created to simplify your weight loss goals and longevity journey.
Built for women, Brello helps you track your weight loss progress, manage your plan, and feel supported every step of the way.
REACH YOUR WEIGHT GOAL
Set your starting weight and goal, then track your progress with easy-to-use charts.
Brello also lets you measure changes in your waist, arms, hips, and chest to see real results over time.
NEVER MISS A SHOT
On prescribed medication?
Brello sends you timely reminders and keeps track of your injection history and dosage.
You can also log symptoms, side effects, mood, and physical activity to see how your body responds day by day.
ORDER REFILLS & TRACK YOUR SHIPMENTS
Brello simplifies your refill process from pharmacy partners.
Track your prescription status, from medical approval to shipment, all in one place.
BRELLO COMMUNITY
Become part of something bigger by getting direct access to our community - Brello’s Thrive Tribe.

Brello protects your health data with HIPAA-compliant systems and strict privacy safeguards.
DISCLAIMER
Content in the Brello app is for informational purposes only and does not constitute medical advice. Consult with a healthcare provider for any questions about your treatment, medical condition, or need for medical advice.

bluejetty:00063243:ios.summary:
You will have an exciting experience With Defense Legend 3: Future War. 
 Tower Defense 2 ended: the dark forces were repelled. However, a part of them escaped and planned to reinforce their forces to attack our world.
bluejetty:00063243:ios.description:
You will have an exciting experience With Defense Legend 3: Future War. 
 Tower Defense 2 ended: the dark forces were repelled. However, a part of them escaped and planned to reinforce their forces to attack our world. 
 Defense Legend 3: Future War inherits and develops the unique features of Tower Defense_Defense Legend 2. In addition, Defense Legend 3: Future War has also added new features such as: superheroes, weapon diversity, map diversity… 
Combination of tactical defense and role-playing is a special feature in Defense Legend 3: Future War. The player are both the commander who has a strategy and the superheroes who fights the evil forces.
 # NEW FEATURE
Superheroes is a new feature that make a difference for Defense Legend 3: Future War. Moreover, the weapon will be updated constantly to help players have new tactics. Simultaneously, the evil forces also develop new creatures constantly that make it difficult for players. Players have to have flexible strategies to deal with them. Boss of the enemy directly takes part in the battle that increases difficulty for players.
 # ITEMS
Defense Legend 3: Future War inherits and develops the weapons that brought victory in Tower Defense 2: Defense Legend 2. 
 + LDC-055-G3(landmine consortium_generation-III): The third - generation landmine supports in case of large numbers of enemy troops.
 + UXO-W-II(Unexploded ordnance-waves-II): The second-generation sound waves are upgraded with greater power than the previous generation, produces sound waves that destroy enemies on a large scale.
 + I-A-III(Ice-Age-III): The ice wave freezes all enemies on the way in a certain period of time.
 + BF1-III(stealth bomber – future-III): The third - generation BF1 Combat Team with five planes which carry bombs to destroy a large of enemies.
 + Hellfire Area II: Upgrade hellfire area with faster speed shoot that destroys all enemies on the way.
 + Supergun-FII: Version II of the Supergun-F, which operates like a cannon with a nuclear warhead. Terrible destruction. Shooting range is not limited. Version II is upgraded with auto-attack feature.
 +W-R-II(Wheel reaper): Weapons with the death wheel symbol will always be the terror of enemy. The version II is upgraded and searches enemy better.
 +A-B-S-II(Air Bomb Storm): Super weapons are made by the army. Weapons combine energy in the air and release massive amounts of energy to kill enemies.
 + The military not only upgrades old weapons but also develops new weapons to fight to the dark forces.
 # MAP DIVERSITY
We will fight in a lot of different terrains, from the hot desert to the frozen land or mountain....v.v
In Tower Defense 2: Defense Legend 2, we have to fight in different terrains that forces us to have the best tactic for each terrain. It proves that we can completely overcome all situations by the best strategy. Defense Legend 3: Future War will bring many surprises to the players.
Players are ready to become commanders or powerful heroes to defeat the enemy. Enjoy the Defense Legend 3: Future War!
Please give us feedback to improve the game for a better experience. Thank you so much!
 Fanpage: https://www.facebook.com/Defense-Legend-3-2476729859218727

bluejetty:00180290:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00180290:ios.description:
All-in-one Social Commerce management system for Facebook, Instagram, LINE Official Account and LIVE selling
Most Favorite Features 
- See chats, comments from FB IG and respond to them in 1 place.
- Manage orders, and keep track of order statuses, automate your workflow
- Keep track of stocks with the inventory management system
- Create your own online store in few clicks, no coding
- Chatbot auto-reply to FAQ and shortcut keys
Other features
- Auto-update order status
- Notify tracking no. and barcode reader to read tracking no.
- Auto-save address and phone no. from chat messages
- Group customer with ‘Tags’
- Sales report to identify your best selling items
- Get notifications if an order has been made
*Available for Thai, Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia 
**Some feature are not available in your country
------------
ระบบจัดการร้านค้าออนไลน์บน Facebook, LINE OA, Instagram และ LIVE สด ครอบคลุมทุกขั้นตอนการขาย แชท ขาย จ่าย ส่ง สต๊อก จะขายแพลตฟอร์มไหนก็จัดการได้ในที่เดียว 
ระบบทำอะไรได้บ้าง? 
►ระบบจัดการแชท 
- รวมแชท Facebook, LINE OA และ IG
- ตอบแชทลูกค้าจากที่เดียว
- ระบบดูดแชท ดูดออเดอร์จากไลฟ์
- ระบบตอบอัตโนมัติ คีย์ลัดช่วยตอบ
- บรอดแคสต์ข้อความฟรี
- ระบุแอดมินตอบแชท เปิดบิล
- ระบบแจ้งอัพเดตสถานะออเดอร์ 
- ระบบแจ้งเลขพัสดุให้ลูกค้าอัตโนมัติ
►ระบบจัดการออเดอร์
- บิลออนไลน์ บันทึกข้อมูลออเดอร์
- ระบบดูด CF เปิดบิลอัตโนมัติ
- แจ้งเลขบัญชีร้านค้า
- ระบบดูดชื่อที่อยู่ ลูกค้าอัตโนมัติ
- แยกสถานะออเดอร์ รอจ่าย โอนแล้ว รอส่ง ฯ
- Export ข้อมูลการขายเป็น Excel
►ระบบชำระเงิน
- รองรับทุกธนาคาร
- เพิ่มช่องทางการชำระค่าสินค้าด้วยบัตรเครดิต
- แจ้งเตือนเมื่อลูกค้าชำระเงิน
- ระบบตรวจสอบสลิปโอนเงินอัตโนมัติ
- ระบบบันทึกสลิปโอนเงิน
►การจัดส่ง
- เชื่อมต่อขนส่ง ปณ.ไทย, Kerry, BEST, J&T, Flash และ Ninja Van
- ให้บริการทั้งแบบ Drop-Off และ Pickup
- ระบบแจ้งเลขพัสดุให้ลูกค้าอัตโนมัติ
- รองรับ COD 
►ระบบจัดการสต๊อก
- บันทึกสต๊อก เข้า-ออก
- เช็คสต๊อกสินค้าแบบเรียลไทม์
- แจ้งเตือนเมื่อสินค้าในสต๊อกใกล้หมด
- สต๊อกสินค้าแบบมีหลาย SKU
- คืนสินค้าเข้าสต๊อกอัตโนมัติเมื่อลูกค้าไม่ชำระเงิน
- Import - Export สต๊อกสินค้าด้วย Excel 
►การบริหารจัดการอื่นๆ
- Page365 Store หน้าเว็บไซต์ พร้อมโดเมนส่วนตัว
- ระบบพิมพ์ใบเสร็จ ใบกำกับภาษี ใบจ่าหน้าพัสดุ
- ระบบจัดการแอดมิน 
- หน้าสถิติ รายงานยอดขาย ต้นทุนกำไร สินค้าขายดี
- เชื่อมต่อระบบบัญชีภายนอก PEAK Account และ FlowAccount
- เชื่อมต่อ Facebook Ads และ Google Analytics 
Page365 Terms of Service: 
https://www.page365.net/terms-of-service
Page365 Privacy Policy: 
https://www.page365.net/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00033009:ios.description:
Between The Reins provides an authentic and unedited look into the training programs of three world champions. It is the only barrel racing platform that offers real and unfiltered content, covering every aspect of the training process, from groundwork with a 2-year-old horse to tuning up an open horse.
With our expert advice, you will learn how to improve your horsemanship, become a stronger rider, develop a stronger mental game, and more. Inside or outside the arena - these skills will teach you how to be successful.  
Between The Reins' extensive library allows you to search by keyword, rider, horses, or pattern-related issues.  With five new videos released each week, you can keep track of your favorite horse through its entire training process. 
Additionally, our video library features highly popular round table discussions, where our trainers delve into major challenges within the barrel racing industry and conduct interviews with other top professionals in several equine performance disciplines.
These videos show the real process of developing champion barrel racing horses.  Learn current strategies and techniques being used on horses at their unique time of development and training.  See the real struggles and successes of training barrel horses from multi-million dollar winning world champion trainers!
Our app offers auto-renewing subscriptions.
You'll receive unlimited access to content on all your devices. Payment is charged to your account at confirmation of purchase. Pricing varies by location and is confirmed prior to purchase. Subscription automatically renews each month unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period, or the trial period (when offered). Cancel anytime in Account Settings. 
Terms of service: https://watch.betweenthereins.us/pages/terms-of-service
Privacy policy: https://watch.betweenthereins.us/pages/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00140622:ios.description:
TRAIN SMARTER. FIGHT FASTER. REACT BETTER.
Meet Boxing Round Timer Pro, the most powerful and customizable round timer for boxing, MMA, kickboxing, Muay Thai, or any high-intensity interval training. Whether you are a fighter sharpening your reactions, a coach managing class sessions, or an athlete crushing HIIT and Tabata, this app adapts to your style. It is more than a simple boxing bell, it is your intelligent corner partner.
WHY THIS TIMER STANDS OUT
Unlike any other boxing timer, Boxing Round Timer Pro introduces an exclusive Reaction Training Mode designed to simulate real fight unpredictability. Set random action cues in custom time ranges and get sound signals to perform specific combos, defensive moves, or explosive exercises. Perfect for developing fight IQ, reflexes, and real-world reaction speed.
You can also split rounds into equal segments. For example, play a signal every 30 seconds during a 3-minute round. Ideal for pacing drills, changing intensity, or rotating exercises seamlessly without losing rhythm.
FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE FOR EVERY TRAINING STYLE
 - Adjustable rounds. Set the structure that fits your routine.
 - Authentic boxing bells and claps. Realistic sounds that mirror professional gyms.
 - Visual cues and color indicators. Instantly see when to fight, rest, or get ready.
 - Intra-round signals. Add alerts within each round to mix up exercises or combos.
 - Reaction Training Mode. Create random action cues to simulate real-fight scenarios.
 - Simple, clean interface. Go from idea to action in seconds.
 - Optimized for all devices. Works on phones, tablets, and smart displays.
PERFECT FOR ALL TYPES OF WORKOUTS
 - Boxing, Kickboxing, MMA, Muay Thai
 - HIIT, Tabata, CrossFit
 - Circuit, Cardio, or Strength workouts
 - Gym and home fitness
 - Reaction, coordination, and reflex drills
SIMPLE. RELIABLE. FREE.
No subscriptions. No ads. No limits. Boxing Round Timer Pro delivers professional-grade performance with zero distractions. Configure your workout, hit start, and let the timer handle the rest while you focus on your performance.
TRAIN ANYTIME, ANYWHERE.
From beginners learning to pace their rounds to advanced fighters mastering timing and reaction, this app delivers precision, motivation, and control in every session. You will always know when to strike, when to rest, and when to push beyond your limits.
Download Boxing Round Timer Pro and experience the evolution of fight training.
React faster. Move smarter. Dominate every round.
Free - No ads - Reaction training - Fully customizable - For all combat sports

bluejetty:00138450:ios.description:
k.ride is the global platform of Kakao Mobility, the no. 1 mobility service provider in South Korea.
Now with k.ride, you can request a ride anywhere in the world without installing a new app for every trip!
Service countries (35 in total):
- Asia & Oceania: South Korea, Japan, Cambodia, Malaysia, Philippines, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Taiwan, Thailand, Guam
- North America: Canada, United States
- Europe: Austria, Belgium, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Hungary, Ireland, Latvia, Lithuania, Malta, Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Sweden, United Kingdom
Multilingual support
k.ride supports 133 languages so users can easily search for destinations and communicate with drivers in their preferred language. Plus, our app is available in four languages—English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese—ensuring a seamless experience wherever you go.
Cashless payments
Easily register your payment method using a credit or debit card, or take advantage of simple mobile payment for a hassle-free experience. Rest assured—with our safe payment system, your rides are automatically processed right after your ride ends using your registered payment method.
* Supports Alipay+ & WeChat Pay
* Alipay+ supported wallets: Alipay, AlipayHK, Touch 'n Go eWallet, Boost, TrueMoney Wallet, Rabbit LINE Pay, and GCash
Easy sign-up and app security
Sign up effortlessly by authenticating your mobile device or linking your social media account. Plus, enjoy peace of mind with our high-level security, including two-factor authentication, keeping your account safe and secure.
Customer support is available year-round from 9 AM to 2 AM (KST), and easily accessible within the app. (App menu > Support)
For more information, please visit the k.ride website.

Uncover the hidden truths with the ultimate guide to psychology, body language, and microexpressions!
Ever wondered what someone’s smile is really saying? Or how to read the subtle signs of deception? With this app, you’ll dive deep into the fascinating world of psychology and body language to uncover the hidden emotions people don’t say aloud.
Key Features:
- Decoding Body Language: Learn to interpret gestures, postures, and subtle movements that reveal a person’s true feelings.

- Interactive Quizzes & Exercises: Put your new knowledge to the test with fun and engaging challenges to sharpen your skills.
Whether you’re a student of psychology, a professional in communication, or just someone curious about understanding people better, this app provides all the tools you need. Elevate your social interactions, spot lies, and read people like a book!
Why Install This App?
- Instantly Applicable Knowledge: The tips and techniques you learn can be applied immediately in real-world conversations.
- Fun and Engaging: Interactive content that makes learning enjoyable and practical.
- For Everyone: No prior knowledge required. Whether you’re a beginner or an expert, there’s something valuable for you.
Unlock the power of non-verbal communication – download the app today and start reading between the lines!

Unlock Culinary Creativity with OrganizEat Recipe Keeper
Recipes are at the heart of OrganizEat Recipe Keeper. Store, access, & organize your favorite recipes in one convenient place. Our recipe keeper ensures that you have paprika meatballs, tasty secret recipes, and a variety of dishes readily available with just a few taps.
KEY FEATURES

Our intuitive organizer allows you to tag recipes, making it effortless to find your favorite dishes. Fridge organizing becomes a breeze as you store and manage recipes tailored to your needs. 
But we don't stop at recipe storage. OrganizEat Recipe Keeper simplifies the process of adding new recipes to your collection. Import recipes from popular websites like Allrecipes, Food Network, and more. Our recipe scanner allows you to capture recipes instantly by snapping a photo. It's a time-saving solution!
Get Organized and Cook with Ease

Custom Recipe Organization: Organize recipes into personalized folders
On-the-Go: Carry your recipes wherever you go; no internet access is required
Declutter Your Home: Eliminate cookbook clutter by storing all your recipes in one place

We offer a reliable and efficient recipe storage solution that keeps your collection safe and accessible across multiple devices. Sync your recipes effortlessly and enjoy peace of mind knowing that your recipe keeper box is always up to date.
As an avid cooking organizer, use customizable options to tailor your recipe journal. 
Make use of notes and comments to enhance your cooking experience further. It's your recipe book, reflecting your unique culinary journey. 
With OrganizEat Recipe Keeper, convenience is paramount. Our user-friendly interface ensures you can view your recipes easily while cooking.
We've included a screen that stays on, ensuring smooth navigation and easy access to your recipe keeper box.
Visit our website http://home.organizeat.com to learn more, or check out our Facebook page where you can read our users' feedback: https://bit.ly/2GOFoF5

bluejetty:00175429:ios.description:
The Newsday app provides extensive Long Island local news coverage 24/7.
Newsday subscribers have unlimited access to the app. Or, you can subscribe via iTunes for an all-access digital subscription. 
App features
Customizable alerts
 Personalize your experience and enable notifications you want to receive, choosing from breaking news, weather, traffic, sports, business, opinion and more.
Newsday on your TV
Watch our award-winning videos and documentaries from the app on your flat screen from Feed Me TV to breaking news with our redesigned video player, complete with playlist functionality and casting capability.
The Digital Crossword
Enjoy Newsday’s daily interactive crossword puzzles presented by Stan Newman. You can start and save puzzles for later, check for errors as you play and reveal answers if you’re stuck.
The Digital Paper
Enjoy an interactive version of Newsday print edition with exclusive photos and videos that come alive off the page. Open articles in easy-to-read story windows, download the paper to read offline and bookmark content to read later. Plus, check out current and past editions of Feed Me magazine, Newsday Classic editions, the Fun Book and other special sections.
Offline reading
 When in airplane mode or not connected to the Internet, the text of all articles loaded when you were connected last will be available for you to read. You can also save any article, video or photo for viewing later.
Section swipe and customized navigation
 Easily swipe left and right from section to section rather than having to open them individually through the navigation menu. Our redesigned navigation also lets you customize which sections you want to see and the order you see them in. You can also customize sections for news and information in your community.
Manage your newsletters
 Subscribe to all of Newsday’s newsletters delivered to your inbox, from breaking news, the morning update, afternoon update and more in the app.
Manage My Account
 Update your information and personalize your subscription. You can schedule a vacation hold on your print subscription, resolve a delivery issue, view and pay your bill, enroll in eBilling or EZ-Pay, update your billing address and more.
 Interactive weather map
 Our weather map can be easily customized to show you a variety of weather conditions on Long Island and around the world. Take a look at the future cast, which shows you what the next six hours of weather could bring and lets you easily track rain, snow and storms. You can save up to 10 locations for quick reference.   
Sports scores
 You can view full stats from all of your favorite pro sports teams on the scores pages and see all upcoming games.
 Subscription information 
• Subscriptions available starting at 29 cents for six months followed by a $29.99/month rate.
• Our subscription will automatically renew each month through your iTunes account and you can cancel at any time.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. 
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled. Cancellations are not eligible for a refund and become effective at the end of the current billing period.
 Privacy policy: http://www.newsday.com/html/device/privacypolicy.html
 Terms of service: http://www.newsday.com/html/device/tos.html

Ball Sort offers a delightful blend of puzzle challenges, color sorting, and satisfying time killer experience. Engage your mind with color ball sorting games that involve clever puzzle solving and logical maneuvers, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a great stress and anxiety relief.

HOW TO PLAY:
- Tap a tube to pick up the top ball, then tap another tube to move it
- You can only stack the ball into a tube with the same color ball on top and there's enough space in the tube
- Try not to get stuck: you can always use hints or retry the level at any time

KEY FEATURES:
- Simple but addictive gameplay
- Smooth 3D graphics
- Vibrant Colors
- Thousands of levels to challenge
- Variety of tubes with interesting shapes
- NO TIMER, enjoy the Ball Sort puzzles at your own pace
- NO penalties, you can restart the current level at any time

bluejetty:00143761:ios.description:
Decorate your farm and build your town with adorable kitties from the game "Cats and Soup", which has achieved 60 million downloads!
[Game Features]
- Farming and Town Building with Adorable Cats! 
Grow crops on your farm and harvest a variety of goodies in this charming farming simulation.
Build facilities and use the harvested crops to produce various tasty dishes and items. 
Expand your town to make more room for buildings and turn your cat island into the perfect kitty paradise! 
- Decorate Your Town with Cute Props! 
Personalize your farm and town with over 100 decorative items. 
From cute decorations to gorgeous landscaping pieces, create a farm and town that's uniquely yours!
A well-decorated village might even win the coveted title of "Today's Town"!
- Collect a Variety of Cats and Costumes! 
Visit the observatory to collect lovely kitties and stylish outfits. 
Shall we take a look at hou the cute kitties work in their adorable outfits?
Fill your farm with these lovable cats!
- Visit Your Friend's Cat Town! 
Check out fellow hoomans' Fluffy Towns. 
Follow your favorite towns, send gifts to your friends, and help them build their own adorable kitty family!
- Deliver your Harvested Goods! 
Complete delivery missions for animal traders like the pelican, mole, and whale!
Ship out the hay, crops and items you've harvested from your farm and receive rewards!
Get delivery bonuses, plus extra mileage for special costumes. 
- Explore with Your Feline Friends! 
Take your cats on adventures to place like valleys, ponds, and mines! 
Earn special activity rewards and exchange them for coins at the Night Market. 
[Customer Support]
fluffy@arumgames.com

bluejetty:00062295:ios.description:
HSK Vocabulary - your essential companion for mastering Chinese words for the HSK exam (汉语水平考试).
Whether you're just starting with 你好 or tackling advanced HSK 6 vocabulary, this app gives you everything you need to learn, practice, and retain 5000+ Chinese words.
COMPLETE HSK WORD DATABASE
• All 6 HSK levels (HSK 1–6)
• 5000+ words with hanzi, pinyin, and translations
• Traditional characters support (繁體字)
SMART QUIZZES
• Test your knowledge with multiple quiz types
• Track your scores and progress over time
• Compete on the global leaderboard
FLASHCARDS
• Swipe-based flashcard practice
• Auto-play mode with customizable timer
• Perfect for daily review sessions
MULTILINGUAL SUPPORT
• Translations available in 13 languages
• English, Russian, Tajik, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Arabic, and Khmer
• Download only the languages you need
BOOKMARKS & SEARCH
• Bookmark words for focused study
• Search by hanzi, pinyin, or translation in any language
• Quick access to your saved vocabulary
PROGRESS TRACKING
• See your results for every level and section
• Star ratings show your mastery level
• Personal profile with overall statistics
DESIGNED FOR LEARNERS
• Clean, distraction-free interface
• Works offline after initial download
• Optional ad removal for uninterrupted study
Start your HSK journey today - from beginner to advanced, one word at a time.

bluejetty:00162586:ios.name: Avena Health
bluejetty:00162586:ios.summary:

Avena Health helps you organize and follow it in a practical, cl
bluejetty:00162586:ios.description:
Avena Health is the platform that connects your day-to-day life with the plan set by your health specialists.
Your specialist defines your plan, recommendations and routines.
Avena Health helps you organize and follow it in a practical, clear and sustainable way, every day.
We work with more than 15,000 specialists, available online and in person, focused on different health goals, lifestyles and life stages.
With Avena Health you can:
• Connect with your specialist and get your questions answered*
• Receive and view your personalized meal plan*
• Explore thousands of recipes and options for your day
• Swap foods within your plan based on your preferences
• Generate grocery lists automatically
• Set meal and hydration reminders
• Track your daily eating
• Check the recommendations from your specialist
• Access video workout routines
• Connect your data with Apple Health (HealthKit)
* Free if your specialist already works with Avena. If you don't have a specialist yet, it requires the paid program with a specialist (see Pricing).
Avena Boost (subscription, purchase required)
• AI habit analysis
• Photo food logging
• Weekly score and personalized insights
Recipes and content
Access more than:
• 15,000 recipes
• 500 types of meal plans
Pricing
• Downloading the app and creating an account is free.
• If your specialist already works with Avena, using the app is free for you.
• If you don't have a specialist yet, you can book your first consultation with a one-time in-app purchase. Ongoing monthly follow-up with your specialist is a paid one-to-one personal service, purchased separately.
• Avena Boost is an auto-renewable monthly or yearly subscription, purchased in the app. It renews until you cancel it in your Apple ID settings.
Important
• Avena is a support tool.
• All decisions about your health are made by your specialists.
Legal
• Terms of use: https://avena.io/terminos-y-condiciones/
• Privacy policy: https://avena.io/aviso-de-privacidad/
• Reference: World Health Organization – Healthy diet: https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/healthy-diet

bluejetty:00015209:ios.description:
How to learn english? By reading and listening.
With simultane books feature you can read and listen at the same time. This will have huge impact for you to get familiar with English language. You will learn the reading and listening at the same time. This will help you with writing and speaking. 
This app has both. It will help you to learn English. It has 12 reading books in it. It will help you learn new English words. It is easy to use. Reading experience developed to be the best. 
It has hours of audiobooks in it. It will improve your listening. Listening and reading is important to speak a language. You can listen audio books in the background. It is fun to listen audiobooks while commuting.
There are books selected carefully for beginners in this app. These books are world classics. Thus, it is easy for you to understand the content of the books.
The books in the application are;
- A Little Princess
- Five Children and It
- Little Wizard Stories of Oz
- The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
- Peter Pan
- The Railway Children
- Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
- Through the Looking Glass (And What Alice Found There)
- Treasure Island
- The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
- Gulliver's Travels into Several Remote Regions of the World
- Pinocchio: The Tale of a Puppet by Carlo Collodi
and many English audio books...
For more, please visit https://nataljamorozova.com

bluejetty:00126120:ios.description:
Amin: It is an application that works on mobile phones that provides a real-time or advance taxi reservation service and provides a food delivery service. It covers all governorates of Iraq and is currently available in the governorates of Baghdad, Najaf, Babylon, and Holy Karbala.. Amin: Trusted: The company has been officially registered in the relevant government departments within a certificate. Establishing and licensing the practice of the profession and obtaining all official approvals.
Amin: It is a smart application that the passenger uses to book a taxi, which is characterized by an easy-to-use interface. The application works in the city center and the districts as well..
Amin: Where does he work? The service is currently available in Baghdad, Najaf, Babylon, and Karbala governorates, and we plan to expand soon.
Amin: Simple and intuitive interface
1- Download our free application
2- Open the application and log in with your name and phone number.3- Click on the “Request” option. You can move the pickup location to the street or place from which you want the driver to pick you up, anywhere. It is easier for the driver to wait for you at the specified location.
4- Choose the service: Express, Savings, Gold, State, etc…
5- Select the place you want to go to. Or you can move the pin directly to the specified location or enter the exact address6- Click to confirm the order, you will see how quickly our taxi driver will arrive. His details, photo and vehicle details will also be displayed. You can always track your taxi driver in the app.
7- Immediately after the trip, you can pay the driver in cash or through the wallet. The trip summary will be automatically sent to your email. If you have already entered it during login to check it yourself! Simply download the (Amin) app in Arabic or (Amin) in English, sign up for free and start riding within minutes.
Our support is at your disposal. We will do what we can to help you.
You can contact us on phone: 9647800091125
Or call the short number: 6965
Or visit the website: https://www.amin.taxi
Or send us an email: support@amin.taxi
#Amen_easier_faster

bluejetty:00087282:ios.name: fieldmargin: manage your farm
bluejetty:00087282:ios.summary:
“The app farmers have been waiting for.” A modern, easy to use farming app that lets you keep track of everything that happens on your farm in one place. 
Map fields, plan work and record observations; all shared with your team so everyone
bluejetty:00087282:ios.description:
“The app farmers have been waiting for.” A modern, easy to use farming app that lets you keep track of everything that happens on your farm in one place. 
Map fields, plan work and record observations; all shared with your team so everyone stays up to date. Data is synced to the cloud so it stays safe and is accessible from your phone, tablet or laptop. Spend less time dealing with paperwork and more getting farm work done. 
A DIGITAL FARM MAP
- Quickly map and measure your farm’s fields and features by drawing or using GPS
- Record field usages and plan rotations
- Share with your team to help them navigate and avoid hazards
- Add more detail with drone and satellite imagery
KEEP TRACK OF WORK
- Plan work to be done in your fields and around the farm
- Assign to team members, add planned dates and record when they’ve been completed
- All accessible on your phone so no more printed job sheets
- (coming soon) Add inputs such as spray or fertilizer 
RECORD ISSUES AND MEASUREMENTS
- Make notes for issues and observations with location and photos
- Keep a log of data recorded such as rainfall or pest counts
A HISTORY OF WHAT’S BEEN DONE ON YOUR FARM
- Simple record keeping for your farming business
- Easily look back at a history of the work that has been done in your fields
- Get reports of field work done and inputs used
COMMUNICATE WITH YOUR TEAM
- Add unlimited team members so farm workers, agronomists, consultants, vets and contractors can easily collaborate
- Build in messenger and commenting makes it easy to discuss issues
- Share your location with your team to improve farm safety
- Connect with your John Deere machinery to view live locations
WORKS OFFLINE
- Keep using the app even when you don’t have signal
SUITABLE FOR ALL TYPES OF FARM
- Used by thousands of farms in 170+ countries from small farms and smallholders to large contractors
- Built to be flexible so it works for different types of agriculture including arable crops, livestock (sheep and cattle), horticulture, vineyards and forestry
--- 
Also available from fieldmargin:
FREE
- Map your farm
- 30 day note and job history
- Up to 5 inputs
- Up to 1 herd
- Unlimited team members
ESSENTIALS
- All Free features
- Unlimited history
- Reporting up to 5 inputs
- Map printing
- Yield recording
$13.49 monthly, $134.99 annually
PLUS
- All Essentials features
- Unlimited inputs
- Full livestock management
- Full reporting
- Report export & printing
$33.99 monthly, $349.99 annually
PRO
- All Plus features
- Field Health satellite imagery analysis
- Map Comparison
$60.99 monthly, $599.99 annually
---
Price may vary by location. A purchase for your chosen plan will be applied to your iTunes account on confirmation. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime with your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
For more information, see our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy https://fieldmargin.com/terms-and-privacy-policy.html
Support http://support.fieldmargin.com/

Your new favorite way to shop Chico’s is here. Whether you’re looking for the latest and greatest styles in women’s clothing, or shopping for classic pieces to add to your closet, you can find it all on the Chico’s app. Shop for any occasion with our selection of women’s tops, pants, denim, dresses, jackets, activewear, accessories and more. 
For over 30 years, we’ve helped millions of women feel confidence and joy. Though we’ve evolved, we’ve always believed in the power of originality—that difference makes us—and our in-house team designs with this philosophy in mind.
FEATURES
Push Notifications. Stay up-to-date on Chico’s promotions and exclusive offers when you enable push notifications. 
Save Your Favorites. Found the perfect item? Heart it to curate your style wishlist and come back to purchase anytime. Our search and filter tools make it easy to find exactly what you’re looking for.
Manage Your Account. The Chico’s app is so much more than an online store. It’s never been easier to manage your rewards, track your orders, or update your account settings. 
Barcode Scanner. Shopping in-store? If you see an item you’d like to purchase, but there are none left in your preferred size or color, use the in-app barcode scanner to get it online. You can also read helpful ratings and reviews from other shoppers.
Find A Store Near You. Don’t want to wait for shipping? Use the app to find our nearby Chico’s boutique locations.
Download our new app to get the best of Chico’s, right at your fingertips.
Tell us what you want to see in the app. Email appfeedback@chicos.com. And stay tuned for new features!

bluejetty:00090706:ios.name: Art Raffle
bluejetty:00090706:ios.summary: If you have a hard time choosing tangle patterns for your Zentangle® project, let the universe decide. Eni Oken's Art Raffle is based on her successful "Bijou Raffle" lesson: pull out random cards with tangle patterns and art enhancers to i
bluejetty:00090706:ios.description:
If you have a hard time choosing tangle patterns for your Zentangle® project, let the universe decide. Eni Oken's Art Raffle is based on her successful "Bijou Raffle" lesson: pull out random cards with tangle patterns and art enhancers to inspire you to create Zentangle® like you never have done before. 
In this beautifully elegant digital version, you can select up to 8 different cards, randomly selected from a collection curated and prepared by Eni herself. You can save different raffle selections and even search to easily find your favorite cards. 
LEARN SO MUCH MORE WITH EACH CARD
But that's just the beginning, this digital version does so much more than the traditional game. The BACK OF EACH CARD contains a wealth of information about the tangle or art enhancer: step-outs, descriptions, links to samples and lessons. 
The game is so soothing and addictive you'll find yourself perusing the cards randomly just to learn more about each card! 
ELEGANT GESTURAL COMMANDS
The game is made to behave as closely to the real raffle game as possible. Gestures such as flicking, tapping and zooming in make this game super fun to play. You can even move the cards around!
SAVE RAFFLE GAMES
You can save raffle games for later and create as many raffles as you like. Rename and edit the raffle games, discard cards or add different ones. 
MORE CARDS COMING
This introductory version comes with a starter pack of tangle patterns, art enhancer prompts and strings. This is just the beginning, more cards are coming soon! 
YES, IT'S ENTIRELY FREE
The Zentangle world has quite literally saved Eni's life after battling stage 4 cancer. Today she is a CZT (Certified Zentangle Teacher) and teaches hundreds of students through video lessons and live online classes via her Art Club. This app, which took many months to develop, is Eni's profound and sincere THANK YOU gift to this loving and nurturing artistic community! 
Wishing you a happy Art Raffle!
Copyright 2020 Eni Oken Designs, Inc. 
Developed by Blind View Studios.

bluejetty:00131826:ios.description:
Alook is a minimalist yet powerful browser, built to be the best browser for iOS.
Core Features 
- Lightning-fast experience: no push notifications, no news, no ads, and millisecond-level startup. 
- Audio and video: floating playback, speed control (0.5x-16.0x), background playback, AirPlay, DLNA, mini player, single-track loop, picture-in-picture, screenshots, mirroring, long-press speed control, and more. 
- File management: manual downloads, unzip/compress (zip, rar, 7z, including encrypted archives), create/edit files, open as plain text, choose file encoding, import from Photos, move/copy files, Wi-Fi transfer, and more. 
- E-book reader: supports txt, pdf, epub, kindle, mobi, azw, azw3, azw4, prc, and pdb, with Simplified/Traditional Chinese conversion. 
- Reading mode: smart pagination, Simplified/Traditional Chinese conversion, designed for novels. 
- Image mode: batch save and image compression. 
- Ad blocker: built-in Adblock Plus with multilingual rules, third-party rules, custom ad marking, and intrusive ad blocking. 
- Custom search engines: automatically detects search boxes on webpages so you can add them quickly. 
- Translation: built-in translation for 14 languages, including full-page and selected-text translation. 
- JavaScript extensions: run custom JS code. 
- File sharing: works with iOS Files and iTunes file sharing. 
- Device support: iPhone, iPhone XS Max, iPad Pro, and cross-device sync. 
- Website settings: configure floating video, ad blocking, no-image mode, clipboard access, and JavaScript per site. 
- iPad support: Split View and drag and drop. 
Other Features 
- iCloud sync for bookmarks, custom ad rules, search engines, and plugins. 
- Private/incognito browsing. 
- Custom immersive wallpapers. 
- Next-page preloading. 
- Custom site icons. 
- BigBang text selection. 
- Handoff support. 
- Auto-refresh. 
- Pull to refresh webpages. 
- Pull down on the home page to search. 
- Custom website home page. 
- Full-page screenshots. 
- Developer tools: view source, Eruda, vConsole, Cookie management. 
- Night mode: OLED pure black mode and eye-care webpage colors. 
- No-image mode: smart no-image browsing. 
- Full-screen mode: swipe to hide the toolbar. 
- Find in page. 
- Site search with the default search engine. 
- Password manager support: 1Password, LastPass, Avast Passwords, and more. 
- QR code tools: scan, recognize QR codes in images, and generate QR codes from links. 
- Desktop/mobile site switching with custom User-Agent support. 
- Block redirects to the App Store. 
- Print and create PDFs. 
- Quickly enter URLs and open copied URLs. 
- Page-turn buttons and tap-to-turn. 
- Swipe back from anywhere. 
- View site certificates. 
- Touch ID or Face ID authentication. 
- Custom long-press shortcuts. 
- Import and export bookmarks. 
- Custom fonts, language, page swipe speed, and screen rotation lock. 
Privacy and Security 
- Data protection: account, password, and activity data are not uploaded. 
- Incognito mode: browsing history, cache, and cookies are not saved. 
- Data storage: unlike browsers that store bookmarks and data in a developer database, Alook stores bookmarks and data in the user’s private iCloud database, accessible only by the user. 
User Reviews 
- keeyang1985: Conscientious software. I like it very much, and it is worth the price. Small, fast, and free of unnecessary clutter. It is the browser I have always wanted. 
- Wen Jing: The happiness brought by a good app is hard to beat. I might have missed the best browser I have ever used. Other browsers scatter features everywhere; Alook brings them together and is excellent value for the price. 
If you have any questions before or after purchase, please contact us. 
X/Twitter: AlookBrowser 
Email: AlookApp@qq.com
