bluejetty:00011914:android.summary: Emergency Rescue is a thrilling ambulance driving game where you become a real city ambulance driver and respond to urgent 911 ambulance rescue calls. Your mission is to rush through traffic, pick up injured patients, and deliver them safel
bluejetty:00011914:android.description:
Emergency Rescue is a thrilling ambulance driving game where you become a real city ambulance driver and respond to urgent 911 ambulance rescue calls. Your mission is to rush through traffic, pick up injured patients, and deliver them safely to the emergency hospital. With realistic controls, sirens, and challenging rescue missions, this ambulance simulator gives you the true experience of being a life-saving rescue driver.
Emergency Ambulance Rescue puts you in the driver’s seat of life-saving missions where every second counts. As a city ambulance driver, your duty is to respond quickly to 911 emergency calls, navigate through heavy traffic, and transport patients safely to the emergency hospital. This thrilling ambulance driving game challenges your skills as a rescue driver while delivering a realistic city rescue experience.
Take on different roles, from city rescue ambulance operations to high-speed emergency ambulance drives. In critical situations, you can even fly the rescue helicopter or heli ambulance to complete life-saving airlift missions. Each level brings intense city rescue challenges that test your driving skills, speed, and responsibility.
Not only do you drive a rescue ambulance, but you can also take command of a rescue helicopter or heli ambulance for critical airlift missions. From city rescue ambulance operations to countryside emergencies, every mission tests your speed, accuracy, and responsibility.
Fans of ambulance games 2021 and rescue ambulance 911 will love the action-packed gameplay, realistic environments, and exciting rescue missions. Whether it’s a rescue ambulance on the ground or an air heli ambulance, your job is clear – save lives and become the ultimate hero in ambulance games!
With detailed environments, siren-packed action, and realistic controls, Ambulance Rescue 911 and ambulance games 2021 fans will enjoy an immersive simulation of what it feels like to be on the frontline of saving lives. Step into the role of an emergency ambulance driver, complete intense rescue challenges, and prove that you’re the ultimate hero in ambulance games and rescue ambulance simulators.

bluejetty:00070321:ios.name: Learn Japanese Kanji: Benkyō
bluejetty:00070321:ios.summary:
When you learn Japanese, memorizing vocabulary or kanji takes too much time: Benkyō manages your drills with AI so it's more effective and painless.
Review whenever it’s convenient, leverage AI to organize your studies, and keep yourself m
bluejetty:00070321:ios.description:
When you learn Japanese, memorizing vocabulary or kanji takes too much time: Benkyō manages your drills with AI so it's more effective and painless.
Review whenever it’s convenient, leverage AI to organize your studies, and keep yourself motivated with progress tracking.
Fully works offline.
• Browse all Kanji, Vocabulary, & Kana
• Drill with smart, custom and SRS quizzes
• Train using multiple choice, keyboard or even handwriting recognition quiz inputs
• Check your statistics and progress
• Practice drawing, learn stroke order
FEATURED by Apple on the App Store: 
• "This week's favorites" (Mar. & Apr. 2021 - France)
• "Widgets: improve your language level" (Apr. 2021 - France)
• "Find a new passion or profession" (May 2021 & Feb./Mar. 2022 - France)
• "Add widgets to your home screen" (Feb./Mar. 2022 - France)
== Features ==
1) JAPANESE DATABASE
- Search and filter more than 10,000 Kanji and 8,000 Vocabulary entries plus Hiragana & Katakana
- Browse by JLPT, category, frequency, grade, etc...
- Listen to prononciations, check writing stroke order & train drawing
- Organise your content with lists
- Search Kanji (and Kana) by simply writing them in the free drawing mode, magic!
2) LEARNING DRILL
Practice makes perfect, Benkyō provides 3 kind of quizzes
• FLEX SRS
An exclusive AI powered algorithm that brings the right quiz questions at the right time to optimize your memory performances and the retention of what you learn
• SMART QUIZ
A quick and easy way to focus on specific flashcards: those you struggle the most with, or that you should review a bit more
• CUSTOM QUIZ
Maximum flexibility for advanced users, choose entries to be quizzed on (by applying filters, and optionally refine selection manually), choose the kind of flashcards (reading, writing, speaking and understanding) for each entry family, and input mode
Plus:
- 3 different quiz inputs: multiple choice (4 propositions), keyboard (type the answer, better to recall the information from your memory), and drawing (draw the kanji or kana with your finger or pencil) with automatic recognition (feels like magic, and you can adjust it's sensitivity)
- If you get a question wrong or pass: you have the opportunity to pause the quiz and review the entry details so you memorize it for the next time. Here you go, learned something new!
- Optionally set quiz reminders at times of your choosing
3) PROGRESS TRACKING
Learning Japanese is a long adventure, visualizing your progress is always a motivation boost
- Quiz scores, streaks and average times, by entry type and globally
- Chart for visualizing evolution over time
- Flashcard rankings by score and streak
- Complete quiz history
- Widgets
Benkyō is designed to allow you to drill Japanese on the train, during coffee, or other spare time you have, so that at the end of the day you made progress in Japanese without effort!
And the app is going to be even better with your feedback.
Try it, you will be surprised!
-----------------------
PLEASE NOTE:
You need a subscription to access all features.
• After the free trial (if offered) and once your purchase is confirmed, your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account.
• Subscriptions automatically renew unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
• Your account is charged for renewal within 24-hours before the current subscription period ends.
• You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewals by going to your Account Settings on the App Store.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to that publication.
-----------------------
• Twitter/X: @BenkyoApp
• Privacy Policy: https://benkyo.page.link/privacy
• Terms of use: https://benkyo.page.link/tnc

City Rewards can be used to collect reward points when purchasing merchandise at all City Mart Supermarkets, marketplace by City Mart, Ocean Supercenters, City Care Health & Beauty Stores, Seasons Bakery & Café, City Books & Music, Safari Bookstores, City Baby Club outlets and other participating outlets.
Enjoy full features of City Rewards by downloading the City Rewards app. You will be able to use City Rewards on your smartphone in just a few easy steps by following the in-app instructions.
In this new version you'll notice:
1) City Points as your Primary Balance
2) A new way of seeing all Merchants, all Rewards
3) Mobile Telco Topups
4) A different section for City Gift with your City Cash MMK Balance
5) One-time use and expiry vouchers
6) City Mall Online Browser shoppability
7) New and Improved UX design and functionality
8) Bug fixes and Enhancements
9) A lot more Coming Soon!
Present your City Rewards physical card or City Rewards app when you make a purchase at participating stores to earn points, enjoy exclusive promotions or member discounts.
Points accumulated can also be used to offset your next purchase as cash equivalent. Do note that the points will expire after a year at the end of the equivalent month in which they were earned.
If you forget to bring your card or phone, you can simply provide your mobile phone number, NRC number (for Myanmar citizens), or Passport number (for other nationals) to earn points or enjoy member promotions and discounts. You will not be able to redeem points without presenting your physical card or app to protect your interest.

bluejetty:00176403:ios.name: Camino Maps
bluejetty:00176403:ios.summary:
Camino Maps is the free offline guide to the Camino de Santiago including all Albergues, GPS maps, and itinerary planning. Trusted by tens of thousands of pilgrims!
Routes:
Camino Francés with all variants, Portuguese Way / Caminho Portugu
bluejetty:00176403:ios.description:
Camino Maps is the free offline guide to the Camino de Santiago including all Albergues, GPS maps, and itinerary planning. Trusted by tens of thousands of pilgrims!
Routes:
Camino Francés with all variants, Portuguese Way / Caminho Português with Coastal, Central, and Litoral.
Navigation:
Explore the Camino with confidence using our detailed maps. Live GPS navigation, cached maps, precise elevation and route profiles.
Sanctuary & Shelter:
Find Albergues, Hostels, Pensions, and Hotels within the app and entirely offline. We have the most up-to-date list of accommodation complete with photos, reviews, and direct booking links with email, Whatsapp, and 3rd party booking.
Plan Stages:
Configure each part of your plan by choosing daily stages. We'll show your booking details, route profiles, and suggested next stages as you build out your plan.
Pack with Purpose:
Prepare for your pilgrimage with our community-curated packing list. From essential gear to spiritual tools, ensure you're ready to embrace every moment of your journey, body and soul.
Discover the Camino's Hidden Gems:
Immerse yourself in the rich heritage and spiritual significance of this ancient route. Uncover local secrets, cultural highlights, and mystical landmarks that make each step unforgettable. Get your stamps in your Credencial / Pilgrim Passport along the way!
The Camino Maps App: Your Spiritual Guide
Experience an unparalleled user journey with the most accurate and current data available—all at no cost. Download now and let your path of self-discovery and enlightenment begin. Embrace the Camino's transformative power and forge unforgettable memories.
Buen Camino!

bluejetty:00131735:ios.name: Daylio Journal - Mood Tracker
bluejetty:00131735:ios.summary:
Self-Care Bullet Journal with Goals - Mood Diary & Happiness Tracker
Daylio enables you to keep a private journal without having to type a single line. Try this beautifully designed & stunningly simple micro-diary app right now for FREE!
bluejetty:00131735:ios.description:
Self-Care Bullet Journal with Goals - Mood Diary & Happiness Tracker
Daylio enables you to keep a private journal without having to type a single line. Try this beautifully designed & stunningly simple micro-diary app right now for FREE!
** WHAT IS DAYLIO **
Daylio is a very versatile app, and you can turn it in whatever you need to track. Your fitness goal pal. Your mental health coach. Your food log. Your gratitude diary. Mood tracker. Exercise, meditate, eat, and be grateful. Take care of your mental, emotional, and physical health. Good self-care is a key to improved mood and reduced anxiety.
This is the time for your wellbeing, self-improvement, and self-care. Use Daylio as your daily bullet journal. We build it on three principles:
1.) Reach happiness and self-improvement by being mindful of your days.
2.) Validate your hunches. How does your new hobby influence your life?
3.) Form a new habit in an obstacle-free environment—no learning curve. Daylio is super simple to use, create your first entry in two steps.
For anxiety and stress relief, make sure to include activities that help you to cope with negativity. Everybody can use a mood boost! You can measure their impact on your mood in stats. 
** HOW DOES IT WORK **
Pick your mood and add activities you have been doing during the day. You can also add notes and keep an old school diary. Daylio is collecting recorded moods and activities in the statistics and calendar. This format will help you to understand your habits better. Keep track of your activities and create patterns to become more productive!
You can review all entries in the statistics on charts or the calendar and share them with your friends.
To make it even better, Daylio allows you:
- Make reflection a daily habit
- Discover what makes you happy
- Use a big database of beautiful icons for your personalized activities 
- Mix and match your own moods using funny emojis
- Explore exciting statistics about your life on weekly, monthly or yearly charts
- Deep dive into advanced statistics for every mood, activity or group
- Customize color themes
- Enjoy nights with dark mode
- See your whole year in 'Year in Pixels'
- Create daily, weekly or monthly goals and motivate yourself
- Build habits and collect achievements
- Share statistics with your friends
- Safely back up and restore your entries via your private Google Drive
- Set reminders and never forget to create a memory
- Turn on PIN lock and keep your diary safe
- Export PDF and CSV documents to share or print your entries
** PRIVACY AND SECURITY **
We are a top private journal since we do not store or collect your data.
At Daylio, we believe in transparency and honesty. Your data is stored locally on your phone. You can optionally schedule backups to your private cloud storage or take your backup file with you anywhere. Data are entirely under your control at all times.
Data stored in the app's private directories are not accessible by any other apps or processes. Your backups are transferred to the iCloud Drive via the secure (encrypted) channels.
Journaling has never been easier!
---
Read our full Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy:
Terms of Use:
https://daylio.net/faq/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy:
https://daylio.net/faq/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00145321:ios.description:
Candy is sweet, but Bitcoin is sweeter! From the creators of Bitcoin Blast comes the newest iteration of the classic match-3 tile swapping candy game, Sweet Bitcoin! 
In this mouthwatering puzzle game, you’ll experience colorful Bitcoin candy treats, timeless gameplay, and delightful rewards. Finesse your way through hundreds of sugary levels collecting treats in groups of 3 or more. Each level has a unique goal, and you only have a certain amount of moves to complete the goal. 
Creating long chains of candy will create sugar rush combos that will unlock exclusive power-ups that will help you complete harder levels. Sweet Bitcoin is filled with hilarious animations, exciting puzzles, and fun surprises! 
Challenge yourself and work your way through hundreds of sugary puzzles and earn sweet Bitcoin treats. You can earn Bling Points in-app if you log into your Bling account. 
Make Sweet Bitcoin your sweet escape—a game so addictive it will have you hankering for more! 
How to Play: Each level has a unique set of tasks you must complete to progress to the next level. Complete the tasks by swiping candy tiles in any direction to create a chain of 3 or more matching candies. You only have a certain amount of moves to complete each task. Creating longer chains of candy provide you with sugar rush combos, and saccharine power-ups. 
Features 
Lip-Smacking Puzzles 
Hundreds of Sweet Levels 
Tasty Power-Ups 
Sugar Rush of Animations 
Yummy Bitcoin Treats

bluejetty:00062093:ios.summary:

*****Enlightening!

Designed to he
bluejetty:00062093:ios.description:
Comprehension Therapy is a professional speech therapy app that targets auditory and reading comprehension of single words in 5 languages. 
*****Enlightening! 
***** Superb! 
***** A Wonderful Tool! 
***** Exceptional App! 
Designed to help people with aphasia and cognitive deficits from stroke and other brain injuries, it is also a valuable tool for older children with special needs including autism. 3 user-friendly modes include Listen, Read, and Listen&Read to target individualized goals. The app automatically adjusts difficulty based on performance, allowing for independent practice. Built-in scoring, hints, and a results summary that can be e-mailed to the therapist in report format make therapy easy! Over 500 nouns, 100 verbs, and 100 adjectives are paired with full-color photographs, recorded voice, and clear text for hours of therapy. You can add your own images too! 
**Try it for FREE as part of Language Therapy Lite or buy this app in our 4-in-1 Language Therapy*** 
Features 
3 modes: 
- "Listen": match an auditory stimulus (spoken word) to a picture 
- "Read": match a written stimulus (printed word) to a picture 
- "Listen & Read": match an auditory stimulus (spoken word) to a written word 
Over 700 clear full-color photographs of functional vocabulary selected by a Speech-Language Pathologist 
10 categories of nouns including animals, foods, objects, concepts, places, people, body parts and more; select which categories are targeted 
Select from 2, 3, 4, or 6 photos on the screen or use the "Auto" feature to automatically adjust the field size based on performance 
3 levels of difficulty adjust the relatedness of foils (semantic and phonemic) to move from Easy to Hard 
Aphasia-friendly interface avoids use of professional jargon and features clear symbols for independent use by children and adults 
Child-friendly mode eliminates references to alcohol and violence as well as disables links to outside sites (iTunes & social media) 
Real recorded voice provides 5 choices of languages with neutral accent in slow, natural speech for easy comprehension in English (US/Canada), English (UK), Spanish, German, and French 
Smooth and automatic transitions to the next set allow for multiple repetitions in far less time than it takes to select and lay out photo flash cards, while still allowing you to move forward and back to review answers or skip ahead 
Automatic scoring tracks success and progress on-screen 
Results can be e-mailed in table and report-ready format so clients can keep their therapist informed of their progress for telepractice and therapists can send results to themselves for charting later, using the copy-and-paste ready format to decrease documentation time 
All Tactus Therapy Solutions Apps participate in the 50% off Volume Purchase Program, so talk to your school about buying in bulk! 
This app collects NO personal information, has NO in-app purchases, and primary links to outside pages can be deactivated.

2. You can pay for your additional shopped items like drinks and snacks together wh
bluejetty:00093534:ios.description:
Pay in Store
1. You have to pay at the store, because you don’t have to pay over the app. You don’t have to input your credit card information on the app.
2. You can pay for your additional shopped items like drinks and snacks together when you pay for your order at the cashier before pick up.
3. When paying for your order, you can show the Current Order screen on the app or provide your name and/or phone number to the cashier.
4. You will receive a Ready Notification on your phone when the order is ready. You can also view the Order Status Display TV at the store to check on the status of your order.
5. If your current location is 5 miles away from the selected store for pickup, you will not be able to place an order.
Convenient Functions
1. App remembers your favourite dishes so that you can reorder them on your order history.
2. The order steps are the same as the deli order kiosk at the store. You can customize any items on your app just like our deli order kiosk.
3. You can select your pickup store when you sign-in. You can change your pickup store selection at any time on your account screen.
About “Cancel Order”
You can cancel your order before the kitchen starts preparing your order. You cannot cancel the order once the order preparation begins.

bluejetty:00091551:ios.description:
Hawkeye is an artifact for network environment security detection.
With the popularity of network equipment, its application scenarios are increasing day by day, which brings convenience to people's life. But unfortunately, we have also noticed that there are a small number of people who abuse this technology and use it for improper purposes. For example, they install hidden devices in private places (hotel rooms, rental houses, SPA massage parlors, dressing rooms, bathrooms) without authorization, invade the privacy of others, and use the contents for improper business benefits.
Hawkeye can detect all electronic devices in the wifi network environment in real time, and distinguish between safe electronic devices and suspicious sneak-camera equipment, protecting your privacy in real time.
Main functions:
- WIFI device detection
- Display all connected devices
- Network routing security detection and delay
- Analysis of safe devices and suspicious devices
- Anti-secret camera safety guide
- Fresh and ad-free, simple to operate
Subscription Service: In-app subscription service is available at $4.99/ week and $9.99/ month. Unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current validity period, the subscription will automatically renew and the subscription fee will be charged to your APP Store account when you confirm your purchase. Users can also manage their subscriptions in the APP Store account settings after purchase and choose to turn off auto-renewal.
Cancel Subscription: If you need to cancel the renewal, please go to Settings--> enter iTunes Store and App Store--> tap App ID, select View Apple ID, enter Account Setting, tap Subscription, and select Cancel Subscription. If you do cancel the subscription at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period, the subscription will be automatically renewed.
Privacy Policy: https://shimo.im/docs/9030MnMXjYszexqw/
User Agreement: https://shimo.im/docs/25q5M4M9Y9soEeqD/

bluejetty:00133655:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00133655:ios.description:
Rome is the heart of Italy, the Eternal City on seven hills, where time has stood still. You will plunge into its charming atmosphere together with the characters in this game... 
 There are many myths and legends about a secret trove of artefacts in the library of the Vatican - the city-state in the very centre of Rome. One of these legends is the story of the Chronovisor - a mysterious device that "carries you back in time"…
 In this game you will go for a walk around Rome to search for the secret of the Chronovisor and save the heroes who have fallen into a trap. You will make unbelievable discoveries on your way: alien artefacts, mysterious Masonic symbols and secret Roman dodecahedrons. You can explore the labyrinthine alleys of the Trastevere district and admire the antiques in the Flea Market, visit the Catacombs and the Castle of the Holy Angel, the Roman Forum and Piazza Navona. And in the end the Vatican Museums will show you one of their secrets...
 Main game features:
- Experience unusual 360-degree panoramas and 3D views!
- Serial plot structure: a captivating story with unpredictable events.
- Enchanting music will immerse you in the charming atmosphere of the game.
- Most of the hidden objects are genuine vintage!
- Vivid, memorable characters.
- Build your collection of artifacts. Go through scenes again to try new quests and get new rewards!
- Hint will support you and help to find any hidden object.
- You can fully complete the game without spending a dime.
The game is TRULY FREE: the whole adventure is open to you without any additional purchases, so it's entirely up to you to buy optional tools.
We'll be happy to stay in touch with you at www.facebook.com/CrispApp. Feel free to leave comments, ask questions, and get news about upcoming games!

bluejetty:00178139:ios.description:
Zyskaj pełną kontrolę nad podróżą – od tankowania, przez zakupy, aż po wygodne ładowanie samochodu elektrycznego w sieci ORLEN Charge. Nie musisz już szukać każdej karty z osobna: VITAY, KDR, BiznesTank żeby ich użyć na stacjach ORLEN — znajdziesz je w swoim telefonie, który masz zawsze przy sobie. Dzięki przejrzystemu menu zdobędziesz łatwy dostęp do mnóstwa funkcjonalności. Z tej wyjątkowej aplikacji możesz korzystać na stacji, w podróży i w domu. Intuicyjne menu, czytelne strony i szybkie kroki — wszystko dla Twojej wygody! 
Pobierz aplikację już dziś! 
• od teraz na stacji zidentyfikujesz się jednym kodem OR, zawierającym kartę VITAY, KDR, BiznesTank oraz aktywowane kupony 
• płać mobilnie za paliwo i inne produkty/usługi za pomocą ORLEN Pay bez podchodzenia do kasy
• ładuj wygodnie swój samochód elektryczny dzięki modułowi ORLEN Charge
• wykorzystuj punkty VITAY do rabatowania zakupów w internetowym Sklepie ORLEN VITAY
• z modułem Energa24 miej pod ręką dostęp do eFaktur i płatności za rachunki 
• w module mBOK odczytuj stan gazomierza oraz licznika energii elektrycznej, kontroluj bieżące saldo płatności
• dzięki atrakcyjnym kuponom szybciej zbieraj punkty na wymarzone produkty w Sklepie 
• planuj swoją podróż w nawigacji w aplikacji ze stacjami ORLEN, żebyś szczęśliwie dojechać do celu 
• przeglądaj w łatwy sposób historię transakcji VITAY 
• korzystaj z rabatów KDR i BiznesTank 
• sprawdzaj historię swoich transakcji w usłudze ORLEN Pay 
• miej pod ręką dostęp do kompletnej oferty produktów z oferty Stop Cafe 
• zbieraj pieczątki za zakup kawy i odbieraj nagrody
• sprawdzaj aktualne promocje w Sklepie ORLEN VITAY

Lesbian Chat is a safe lesbian community focused on conversation, respect and genuine interaction. Explicit content is not allowed.
If you are looking for a lesbian chat app to talk, meet women and be part of an active lesbian community, Lesbian Chat is the right place for you.

Turn your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch into your FAVORITE teacher of Croatian.

◆ Master your accent with the Speech Studio. Simply record yourself saying a phrase and then hear your voice next to the teacher’s. You’ll be AMAZED how quickly your foreign accent melts away.

◆ Nemo is NOT BUILT AROUND LESSONS at all. It is meant to be picked up and put down throughout the day, whenever you have a few minutes to spare.
◆ Builds a foundation of Croatian empowering you to speak CONFIDENTLY in EVERYDAY CONVERSATIONS. 
◆ NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE of Croatian required.
Nemo® is specially DESIGNED to tap the remarkable power of your mobile device, and your brain, to their fullest. 
PERSONALIZED FOR YOU
Nemo is your personal trainer, tracking your PROGRESS across every single word and phrase.
◆ Practice Croatian the way you'll use it. Nemo is fully customizable.
◆ Nemo immerses you in the sounds of Croatian so you naturally speak with ease.
◆ Dive into WHAT YOU WANT to learn at any time.
◆ You control which words to practice – skip words you don’t want to learn or already know.
◆ Turn on Review Mode to study what you practiced earlier in the day to BOOST your memory retention.
◆ Hear English descriptions of all words, in a flashcard format.
◆ Quiz your mastery of the vocabulary.

Maximize your time investment by targeting the most basic and high frequency words of the language.
Upgrade to the complete version to:
◆ Get off the beaten path or find comfort with DIRECTIONS, TRAVEL and HOTEL phrases.

◆ Spark new friendships with COMPLIMENTS and CONVERSATION STARTERS.

bluejetty:00154724:ios.description:
Stay Close and Connected
Keep in touch with your friends and family. Stay safe and always know how to reach your loved ones when it matters most.
Easily Find Your Loved Ones
Discover the exact location of your friends and family quickly and effortlessly. Stay informed and connected at all times. Gone are the days of uncertainty when a family member is running late or a friend is traveling in an unfamiliar place. With advanced location-sharing technology, finding the exact whereabouts of your loved ones is now quick and seamless. A simple check on your device reveals their real-time location, eliminating guesswork and unnecessary worry. Whether you’re coordinating meetups, ensuring a child has arrived safely at school, or checking on an elderly relative, this instant access to location information keeps you informed and connected at all times.
Keep Track of Your Family Anytime
Monitor your family’s real-time locations and make sure they are safe wherever they go. Peace of mind is just a glance away.
A World Where Distance Doesn’t Mean Disconnection
The ability to stay connected with friends and family, instantly locate them, and monitor their well-being transforms the way we care for one another. No longer do miles or busy schedules have to create barriers—technology bridges the gap, keeping relationships strong and safety a priority. In an unpredictable world, having the tools to stay close to your loved ones isn’t just a convenience; it’s a necessity. With real-time location sharing and constant connectivity, you can face each day with confidence, knowing that no matter where life takes you, your loved ones are always within reach.

bluejetty:00129684:ios.description:
A Magical AR Video App Made for Kids
FluoWorld is an augmented reality video app designed for children to create magical AR videos, fantasy stories, and animated worlds using 3D filters, interactive objects, colorful doodles, and animated characters.
Created especially for kids, FluoWorld turns everyday moments into imaginative adventures through a safe kids camera focused on creativity, storytelling, movement, and fun.
Create Fantastic AR Stories
Kids can add animated 3D objects and characters directly into their videos.
They can move, rotate, resize, and place objects freely in space to build their own magical scenes.
From fantasy worlds to playful stories, every video becomes a unique creative experience.
Draw in Augmented Reality
One of FluoWorld’s core features is AR drawing.
Kids can draw directly in the air using multicolor 3D doodles that float and move in space.
They can sketch shapes, symbols, trails, and effects around them, turning movement and imagination into living drawings.
A powerful tool to express creativity in a fun and intuitive way.
Dance with Hip Hop AR Dancers
Bring energy and movement into videos by dancing with animated Hip Hop dancers in augmented reality.
Kids can interact, move, and dance alongside virtual dancers that appear in their real environment.
Perfect for creative expression, movement-based play, and fun AR performances.
Themed 3D Worlds for Every Season
Explore themed AR worlds such as Christmas, Halloween, Easter, birthdays, and fantasy adventures.
Cute characters, funny objects, magical props, and seasonal content inspire creativity all year long.
New themed content keeps kids engaged and excited.
Live AR Video Effects
Apply real-time augmented reality video effects while recording.
Enjoy smooth live AR capture that blends motion, action, drawings, and characters together.
Ideal for storytelling, dancing, and imaginative play.
Designed for Kids, Trusted by Parents
FluoWorld is built with parents in mind.
The app works fully offline and contains no ads, no tracking, and no external links.
Simple controls and a safe camera experience allow kids to explore freely while giving parents complete peace of mind.
Save and Share Magical Moments
Record and save AR videos directly on the device.
Share creations safely with family and friends.
Perfect for creative play, memories, and storytelling moments.
A Complete AR Creative Playground for Kids
FluoWorld is the ultimate kids AR video app for creating fun videos, fantasy stories, AR drawings, and interactive dance experiences with 3D effects.
A safe, creative, and joyful space where imagination comes to life.
---------------------------------

bluejetty:00039867:ios.description:
bTaskee is Southeast Asia's leading home services super app, trusted by over 2 million customers across Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, and Malaysia.
After 10 years, we celebrate a major milestone with the relaunch of bCare — our specialized home healthcare service offering Elderly Care and Patient Care, delivered by trained, dedicated, and verified caregivers. The app also integrates KAI, an AI assistant ready to answer any question, anytime.
Beyond bCare, bTaskee's home services ecosystem includes 20+ offerings: Cleaning, Home Moving, Industrial Cleaning, bBeauty (Makeup, Hair Styling, and Nail at home), bWellness, Child Care, Deep Cleaning, Upholstery Cleaning (curtains, mattresses & sofas), A/C Cleaning, Cleaning Washing Machine, Office Cleaning, Office Carpet Cleaning, House-keeping, Laundry, Home Cooking, Grocery Assistant, Disinfection Service, and Water Heater Cleaning.
7 reasons families choose bTaskee:
1. 10 Years of Trust
For more than a decade serving millions of families across Southeast Asia, bTaskee has built a comprehensive service ecosystem — from home cleaning and appliance care to home healthcare (bCare), at‑home beauty (bBeauty), and enterprise welfare solutions.
2. Present Across Southeast Asia
From Hanoi to Bangkok, and from Jakarta to Kuala Lumpur — bTaskee delivers quality home services across more than 50 provinces and cities in 4 countries (Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, and Malaysia), bringing trusted help right to your doorstep wherever you are
3. Professional & Trustworthy Taskers
More than 15,000 Taskers are carefully selected, thoroughly trained, and fully background‑checked. Our transparent rating system ensures consistent service standards and complete customer satisfaction.
4. Trusted by 2 Million+ Customers
With over 2 million customers, 21 million service hours completed, and a 97% satisfaction rate, our service quality speaks for itself. Plus, the app makes it easy to save and rebook your favorite Taskers anytime.
5. 24/7 Support — Never Miss a Request
KAI, the AI assistant built right into the app, responds instantly day or night. And whenever you need extra support, our professional Customer Care team is available across multiple channels.
6. Flexible Payment Options
Pay with ease using bPay wallet, MoMo, ZaloPay, ShopeePay, VNPAY, VietQR, Visa/Mastercard, or even cash.
7. Exclusive Benefits with bRewards
Earn bPoints with every service to redeem rewards from bTaskee and our extensive partner network. bRewards helps you save more and enjoy more perks while caring for your home.
Download the bTaskee app today and experience a tidier home, a more relaxed life!
Contact bTaskee:
- Website: https://www.btaskee.com/

bluejetty:00021165:ios.name: Background noise Sleepy sounds
bluejetty:00021165:ios.summary: Sometimes the child is naughty and nothing can help the parents to calm him down and put him to sleep. It also happens that the baby wakes up every 15 minutes or does not want to sleep in the crib. Perhaps the baby is too tired, but cannot
bluejetty:00021165:ios.description:
Sometimes the child is naughty and nothing can help the parents to calm him down and put him to sleep. It also happens that the baby wakes up every 15 minutes or does not want to sleep in the crib. Perhaps the baby is too tired, but cannot fall asleep on its own - this often happens in newborns!
In the practice of many parents, we have learned that monotonous sounds (the so-called "white noise"), for example, the clamor of a fan, vacuum cleaner, are more effective as a lullaby for a child's sleep than music or singing.
Also, the baby falls asleep better (as he calms down) to the sounds outside the window, the sound of the rain or the uproar of the street. The baby's sleep becomes deeper, its quality improves. When using white noise, the newborn does not wake up every 20 minutes, which also allows the mother to rest better.
What if there are no such sounds? Use a mobile gadget with many preset white noise options! Our application can make different tones that have a positive effect on the child's sleep:
- rain
- fan
- hairdryer
- air conditioning
- "mom sounds" - ch-ch-ch, motion sickness
- "in my mother's womb"
- wind
- sea, forest and other sounds of nature
- pure white noise
- animal sounds
- train, car, plane, subway
White noise helps the child to calm down, speeds up the time to fall asleep. In the studies conducted, most infants were able to fall asleep to white noise within five minutes, while without it, 25 percent of newborns fell asleep during the same time.
Application features:
- Over 80 ringtones
- Loop playback without stops
- Timer with smooth start and fade out
- Background playback - you can use other applications during playback. You can set a timer, switch to background mode, or turn off the screen. After the time expires, the sound will be smoothly turned off, the application will be closed.
- Work offline without the Internet
- Night mode
- Unlimited playtime helps baby sleep longer
The premium version of the app contains more useful features such as:
- extended library of tones
- unlimited offline time
- unlimited mixes
- no ads in the app
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
We offer subscription plans in the app that unlock premium functions of the app:
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
- Price can depend on location
For more information please visit the link https://support.apple.com/HT202039
Privacy Policy: https://doc.whisperarts.com/policy/whispy/ios/
Terms of Use: https://doc.whisperarts.com/terms/whispy/ios/
This app is as easy to use as possible and includes ambient sounds to help you relax during the day and get a good night's sleep.
Ensure good sleep for your baby and the whole family!
We are always glad to receive your questions, suggestions, and comments. Contact us at support@whisperarts.com

bluejetty:00015662:ios.description:
Master important SAT concepts with Magoosh's SAT flashcards! It's easy to use and will help you memorize key concepts quickly!
• English and Math SAT concepts 
• 350 vocab words picked by an expert SAT tutor
• Definitions and example sentences for every concept and word
• Decks for every difficulty level
• Track your progress as you study
• Smart algorithm focuses your practice for efficient learning
This app gives you access to all of Magoosh’s SAT flashcards. Sign in with a Magoosh account (or create a new free one) to save your progress to the web so that you can continue your practice online at http://sat.magoosh.com/flashcards
Written by SAT experts
=====
The entire SAT wordlist is selected and defined with usage examples by Magoosh’s expert SAT tutors, headed by Chris Lele. He has been teaching the SAT for more than 10 years, runs a popular vocabulary series on YouTube and he’s also written an eBook on vocabulary. He is unbeatable in Scrabble, or any other word game for that matter.
Review that really sticks
=====
Academic research has found that memories are formed by repeated exposure to new information, so Magoosh’s flashcard app uses a spaced repetition system. Concepts and words you are learning will reappear frequently (occurring less frequently the better you know them) and words you already know won’t be repeated. 
“I really like the way the words appear and the simple interface to show progress of the user. You guys have put good use of algorithms so one comes out learning the words well. The best flashcard app to date.” - Arif
“Absolutely awesome. This is an excellent way to significantly improve vocabulary in a short amount of time. I learned 100 new words while waiting for my flight at the airport. Good job Magoosh!” - Tameka
About Magoosh
=====
We're an online test prep company with a focus on teaching the SAT through videos and personalized customer support.
In addition to our online course, we blog about SAT words, formulas, grammar, review, writing and an occasional question of the day along with SAT study guides and study tips at http://magoosh.com/sat/
More SAT study tools
=====
Search the app store for “magoosh sat” to continue your prep for the College Board’s SAT with Magoosh’s SAT Prep & Practice app.
When you’re ready to practice for the full SAT exam, Magoosh’s website has more than 700 excellent SAT Math, SAT Reading and SAT Writing practice questions, each with its own detailed video explanation. After each quiz, you can review your answers to see your strengths and weaknesses. Visit https://sat.magoosh.com for more information.
(Magoosh also has an app for learning English grammar. Search the store for "magoosh english" to find it)
Your Magoosh account
=====
If you don't already have a Magoosh account, just enter your email address, choose a password and tap "Sign In" and we'll create one for you! It's completely free, and we only use your email address to sync your progress to the web so that you can continue your practice online at http://sat.magoosh.com/flashcards/vocabulary
Have any questions? Please ask!
=====
Customer satisfaction is incredibly important to us. If you have any questions or comments, please send us an email at support@magoosh.com or call +1-510-214-0212 and we’ll get back to you as quickly as we can.
“I didn’t have much time to prepare, and Magoosh made it possible for me to succeed on the test in a short period of time. I looked at Kaplan SAT, Barron’s, and Princeton Review products, and I can confidently say that Magoosh was definitely the best.”
“The team is really great and actually cares about your score as much as they would care about their own. Simply the best.”
Don’t wait until the last minute to start studying, start using Magoosh’s SAT Flashcards app today!

bluejetty:00070339:ios.description:
Can you Find the Differences? Play this free puzzle game with us to train your brain and relax your mind!
With over 20,000 challenging levels, Find the Differences: Spot Fun is an engaging and relaxing photo hunt puzzle game where you can unleash your inner detective by identifying differences between two almost identical pictures. 
All you need to do is very simple - compare two similar images and look for hidden objects in unique scenarios such as "The Browns", "Vintage Women" and "Funny Animals". Play Find the Differences game to develop your powers of observation while enjoying peace of mind now!
How to Play:
- Compare two almost identical pictures and find the differences between them;
- Tap the screen every time when you spot a difference;
- Zoom in or out a picture to spot differences more easily;
- Use hints when you need a clue to look for differences;
- Challenge completed! Go to the next level to continue your Differences journey! 
Key Features:
- No timer: Enjoy the pleasure of discovering differences at your own pace, anytime and anywhere!
- Tons of challenging levels: A wide range of difficulty levels, from easy to hard, are waiting for you to tackle!
- Beautiful HD images: Explore different themes such as nature, architecture, food and animals around the world as you go on the photo hunt!
- Special challenges and rewards: Take part in daily challenges and time-limited puzzles to earn rewards.
- Suitable for all ages: Both adults and kids can improve their cognitive ability and develop concentration skills while having fun!
- Simple yet engaging gameplay: Compare two similar images, tap the hidden differences you discover and use hints when you need a clue.
Are you ready to be a professional dectective and start the photo hunt? Download it, relax and have fun with Find the Differences!

bluejetty:00062031:ios.description:
Learn faster and remember longer with Brainscape, the AI flashcard app that combines scientifically proven spaced repetition and active recall. Create flashcards instantly from notes, PDFs, images, and text, or study millions of expert-created flashcards for exams, languages, certifications, and more. Whether you're switching from Anki or another flashcard app, Brainscape helps you study more efficiently.
Brainscape’s intelligent study system is designed around proven cognitive science principles that help you learn faster and remember longer. By combining active recall, metacognition, and spaced repetition, Brainscape helps serious learners spend less time studying and retain more of what they learn.
How Brainscape works.
Study any subject using smart flashcards designed to maximize retention:
- Actively recall answers instead of passively rereading notes
- Rate your confidence from 1–5 after each card
- Let Brainscape automatically optimize review timing using spaced repetition
- Focus more time on difficult concepts and less on material you've already mastered
This unique combination of active recall, self-assessment (metacognition), and spaced repetition is designed to help you learn more efficiently.
Where do all of Brainscape’s awesome flashcards come from? Three places:
1. Exper-created flashcards: Study professionally designed collections covering:
- Foreign languages
- MBE (Bar Exam)
- NCLEX
- MCAT
- AP courses
- Series 7
- GRE
- And many more
2. Community-created flashcards: Search millions of flashcards created by students, teachers, professionals, and organizations around the world.
3. Create your own flashcards: Instantly create multimedia flashcards from:
- Notes
- PDFs
- Images
- Documents
- Text input
Add images, audio, and collaborate with classmates or colleagues.
Why learners all over the world use Brainscape
- AI-powered flashcard creation
- Scientifically designed spaced repetition
- Active recall learning techniques
- Progress tracking and study insights
- Millions of existing flashcards ready to study
- Available across web and mobile devices
How much does it cost? Creating and sharing great text flashcards is FREE. (Woohoo! And sorry, we do have to charge for image creation for security reasons.) And for unlimited access to ALL of Brainscape's user-generated and premium, expert-curated content, as well as optional features, like bookmarks and card reversibility--or to me your content private, you can upgrade to Pro for $19.99 (monthly), $59.99 (every 6 months), or $95.99 (annually). Alternatively, you can unlock a LIFETIME of learning with Brainscape for a one-time cost of only $199.99 American dolla billz.

bluejetty:00074020:ios.name: Network Analyzer: WiFi Scan
bluejetty:00074020:ios.summary: Network Analyzer is a free, easy-to-use network toolkit that turns your iPhone or iPad into a handy diagnostic instrument. Scan your network, discover every device connected to it, and troubleshoot connection problems in seconds - no techni
bluejetty:00074020:ios.description:
Network Analyzer is a free, easy-to-use network toolkit that turns your iPhone or iPad into a handy diagnostic instrument. Scan your network, discover every device connected to it, and troubleshoot connection problems in seconds - no technical background or extra hardware required.
Built for curious home users and IT professionals alike, it packs a LAN device scanner, ping, traceroute, port scanner, DNS lookup, and whois into one clean, fast app. Try it for free, and upgrade to Network Analyzer Pro whenever you want advanced tools like traceroute visualization on the map, internet speed test, Wake on LAN, IP calculator, MAC address browser, and more.
LAN scanner:
- Fast and reliable detection of all network devices
- IP addresses of all discovered devices
- MAC addresses and vendor names of discovered devices
- NetBIOS, mDNS (Bonjour), LLMNR, DNS, SNMP, and WS-Discovery name where available
- Reachability (ping) test of discovered devices
- IPv6 availability and discovered IPv6 addresses
Ping & traceroute:
- Round-trip delay including IP address and hostname for every network node
- Country detection of the analyzed server
- Support for both IPv4 and IPv6
Port scanner:
- Scan common ports, custom port ranges, or the complete port range
- Detection of closed, firewalled, and open ports
- Description of the known open port services
Whois:
- Look up domains, IP addresses, and AS numbers
- Support for both classic whois and the modern RDAP protocol
DNS lookup:
- Functionality similar to nslookup or dig
- Query all record types at once or one specific type
- Support for A, AAAA, CAA, CNAME, HINFO, LOC, MX, NAPTR, NS, PTR, SOA, SPF, SRV, SSHFP, TXT records
Network information:
- Default gateway, external IP (v4 and v6), DNS server, HTTP proxy
- Wi-Fi network information such as SSID, BSSID, router vendor, security type, IP address (v4 and v6), and subnet mask
- VPN, USB Ethernet, and personal hotspot connection details
- Cell network information such as IP address and network type, with dual SIM support
More:
- Light and dark theme
- Full IPv6 support everywhere
- Detailed help
- Regular updates

• 20+ unique yoga classes designed by certified yoga experts for all levels. 
• Increase flexibility to boost your performance.
• Leave the stress and focus on positive energy.
• Balance the body while focusing the mind.
• Collection of sounds and melodies to create unlimited ambiances and atmosphere, stress & anxiety relief.
MAIN CLASSES:
BALANCE - different yoga styles are combined that are focused to improve your balance.
STRENGTH - a combination of power yoga poses that will help you to build your body strength.
FLEXIBILITY - learn to focus how to breath, on your muscle recovery and flexibility of your body.
GET IN SHAPE:
Quick Yoga Fix - fit yoga into a busy day with a sequence that is both grounding and energizing.
Getting Toned - develop muscle tone in key areas, including arms, shoulders, core, glutes, and legs.
Morning Yoga - start your day with an invigorating yoga practice that emphasizes moving the spine in all directions.
Daily Yoga for ABS - target and tone deep abdominal muscles.
Yoga for Runners - yoga offers a unique combination of balance flexibility, strength, and mindfulness training that can help runners to improve performance.
Boost Your Energy - recharge with this sequence designed to invigorate your body, mind, and spirit.
Challenge Your Flexibility - develop flexibility through a series of intense stretches and apply the results to more advanced yoga posture.
NUTRITION - be in the best shape ever! learn what to eat, discover fat burning foods and recipes. Eat tasty meals to speed up your metabolism.
MORE:
• Discover new Apps from VGFIT and achieve fitness goals.
• Find out more Yoga Classes and Guides for your healthy lifestyle.
• Play classes on your TV with AirPlay or Chromecast mirroring.
• Get Motivation and share it with friends Join vgfit.com community.

The synchronization with Apple Health can be switched off in the application Settings.

As a Yoga app user, you can choose the subscription plan that best suits your needs, by considering the yoga classes, and the costs. Our Premium 1-year subscription plan offers unlimited access to all yoga poses, all yoga classes and nutrition plan in exchange for a single payment. In addition 1-month are available for users. For your convenience, Yoga subscriptions are set to automatically renew within the 24-hour period prior to the subscription end date. You can cancel your subscription at any moment in your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the terms. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00061906:ios.description:
iDoceo is a powerful assistant for teachers. 
You can add an unlimited number of students and classes.
iDoceo is paid only once and you get the full app and its updates.
There are no additional subscriptions or in app purchases. 
iDoceo respects your privacy and confidentiality. Works completely offline. No internet connection required. 
All your data is stored locally in your iPad, unless you enable the synchronization options.
An all-in-one tool for teachers that consists of:
 - Fully fledged gradebook for teachers, with custom calculations, attendance and can be linked to Google Classroom,Moodle, MSTeams
 - Lesson planner: Week/Day views
 - Diary: Day/Week/Month/Timeline views of a single classroom
 - Teacher Timetable
 - Seating plans
 - Resource manager that will help you keep track of PDFs, audio,files,links,images,etc.
 - Notepads with handwritten notes, drawings and timestamped text
 - Configurable reports in PDF, XLS and TXT
Below the list of its main features. More details at www.idoceo.net
• TEACHER PLANNER, DIARY AND SCHEDULE 
 - Configure simple week schedules or complex rotating cycles with holidays. Unlimited combinations for each term
 - Individual diary for each classroom. Single day view, week, month and timeline. Add&Edit iCal events
 - Timeline view with all your lessons on sight. Bump, lock and yank lessons.
 - Add files from any source, video, audio, handwritten notes, links and resources to your lesson plans.
 - Create PDF/XLS reports of your planner and diary.
• TEACHER GRADEBOOK
 - Use rubrics, categories, icons, colors, text or number based grades. You can configure your own grading system
 - Evidence tracking features. Take pictures, record video and audio and attach it to any cell and student.
 - Calculate simple weighted averages, additions or create your own Excel like formulas with conditions and complex functions.
 - Add unlimited columns, folders, rows and pages to organize your information
 - Use configurable editors on each column for ultrafast edition and adapt the gradebook to your needs
 - Send personalized e-mail reports to your students with their grades, annotations or files 
 - Filter information of students or groups on screen
 - Share your gradebook configurations with other users
 - Import your current data from any XLS, CSV or iDoceo template file
 - Import your students photos from a single image with face detection or in bulk with separate files
 - Export everything to native PDF, XLS or CSV 
• SEATING PLANS 
 - Add columns and edit your data as if you were in the gradebook. 
 - Up to ten seating plans per classroom with five different modes and backgrounds
 - Random group generator and picker.
• TO-DOs, TEXT AND HANDWRITTEN NOTES
 - Create unlimited standalone notepads or linked to a classroom. Configurable sheets
 - Full PDF report of your notepads.
 - To-dos with alarm events
 - Timestamped text notes for meetings, linked to a class or a student
• RESOURCE MANAGER
 - Record audio and video, add handwritten notes, signatures, files ,images, links, add text or annotations 
anywhere: gradebook cells, students, classroom, diary, planner.
 - Full PDF reader with bookmarks and thumbnails
 - Play Keynote presentations, view XLS files, audio and videos.
• SYSTEM TOOLS
 - Multiple backup options: Dropbox, Google Drive, iCloud or your own WebDAV server.
 - Works in landscape, portrait and full screen mode (gradebook)
 - Password protect your contents
 - Random picker and spinning wheel on summary,gradebook and seating plan
 - Class’ summary with configurable widgets.
 - Bulletin board with resources and notes.
 - Recycle bin with recently erased students, columns and classes
 Thanks for all your support and great comments in the App store!
 Visit our website's forum at www.idoceo.net or send us an e-mail from the app > Help > Support&Suggestions
if you have any questions or suggestions for our next updates.

 - Challenging Levels – Hundreds of unique puzzles to keep your mind sharp and your heart engaged.
Whether you're a casual player or a puzzle pro, Dream Slide Mahjong offers a serene escape with a touch of mystery. Ready to slide your way into the truth?

bluejetty:00177688:ios.description:
تطبيق دليلك هو أداة ذكية ومبتكرة تهدف إلى تسهيل عملية التعرف على هوية المتصلين والبحث عن الأرقام والأسماء في العالم العربي حيث يقدم تجربة فريدة للمستخدمين الذين يسعون إلى معرفة من يتصل بهم أو الوصول إلى معلومات دقيقة حول جهات الاتصال سواء كانت شخصية أو تجارية يتميز التطبيق بواجهة استخدام بسيطة وسلسة تتيح لأي شخص التنقل بين أقسامه بسهولة والبحث عن الأرقام أو الأسماء أو حتى الشركات والمحلات التجارية في مختلف المناطق العربية
يعتمد التطبيق على قاعدة بيانات ضخمة ومتجددة تحتوي على ملايين الأرقام المسجلة مما يمنح المستخدم فرصة كبيرة للوصول إلى نتائج دقيقة وسريعة عند البحث كما يتيح للمستخدمين إمكانية توثيق حساباتهم وإضافة معلوماتهم الشخصية أو التجارية مما يعزز من مصداقية البيانات ويساهم في بناء مجتمع رقمي موثوق وآمن
واحدة من أبرز ميزات التطبيق هي خاصية كشف هوية المتصل حيث يمكن للمستخدم معرفة اسم المتصل حتى وإن لم يكن مسجلًا في جهات الاتصال الخاصة به وهذه الميزة تساعد في تجنب المكالمات المزعجة أو الاحتيالية وتمنح المستخدم راحة البال أثناء استخدام الهاتف كما يمكن للمستخدمين الإبلاغ عن الأرقام المزعجة أو غير المرغوب فيها مما يساهم في تحسين جودة الخدمة وحماية المستخدمين الآخرين
يتيح التطبيق أيضًا إمكانية البحث باستخدام الاسم أو الرقم أو حتى جزء من الاسم مما يسهل عملية الوصول إلى المعلومات المطلوبة بسرعة وفعالية كما يمكن استخدامه للبحث عن المحلات التجارية أو الشركات في منطقة معينة مما يجعله أداة مفيدة لأصحاب الأعمال والباحثين عن خدمات أو منتجات معينة
التطبيق متوفر على متجر التطبيقات ويمكن تحميله مجانًا وهو يدعم اللغة العربية بشكل كامل مما يجعله مناسبًا لجميع المستخدمين في المنطقة العربية كما يتم تحديث قاعدة البيانات بشكل دوري لضمان دقة المعلومات وتوفير أفضل تجربة ممكنة للمستخدمين
من خلال هذا التطبيق يمكن للمستخدمين بناء شبكة تواصل أكثر أمانًا وفعالية والتفاعل مع قاعدة بيانات ضخمة تتيح لهم معرفة من يتصل بهم والبحث عن أي رقم أو اسم بكل سهولة وموثوقية إنه ليس مجرد تطبيق بل هو دليل رقمي شامل يساعدك في حياتك اليومية ويمنحك القدرة على التحكم في اتصالاتك ومعرفة كل ما تحتاجه عن الأرقام والأسماء في لحظات
-- “Remove Ads” Subscription --
- Enjoy the app without the interruption of any ads.
Your payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew each month 24-hours before the end of the current period, and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00082686:ios.description:
Join over 200k authors writing their next masterpiece with Novelist!
Novelist is the all-in-one app for writing your novels—completely free with no ads or in-app purchases.
We give you the freedom to create without limits. Whether you're plotting, outlining, organizing, or scheduling, Novelist provides powerful tools to help bring your story to life.
Key Features:
▪ Plot: Organize your story elements like on a board. Easily edit, move, merge, reorder, and add notes, tags, metadata, or images. Everything is customizable.
▪ Write: Craft scenes directly in the app. Annotate or write with rich formatting tools.
▪ Organize: Structure your story into acts, chapters, or any format you like.
▪ Schedule: Set word count goals or deadlines to stay on track.
Advanced Tools:
▪ Autosave, find/replace, add comments, and restore previous versions from history
▪ Mention story items directly in your text for quick reference
▪ Split your screen with reference panels to inspect items while writing
▪ Track your progress daily with detailed stats
▪ Real-time preview without leaving the app
▪ Export and share your manuscript in EPUB, ODT, or HTML formats
▪ Enjoy an interface optimized for large screens
▪ Write on any browser with the companion web app
▪ Create templates for book series to streamline your workflow
▪ Backup and restore locally or with Google Drive
▪ Switch to dark mode for comfortable writing during long sessions
Your story, your way—with Novelist.

bluejetty:00031319:ios.description:
Managing client bookings and schedules shouldn’t take extra time. Masters is a powerful appointment scheduler designed to help beauty professionals stay organized and focused. This all-in-one scheduling app brings together a smart calendar planner, a flexible organizer, and a reliable crm into a clear, structured workflow that also works as a practical schedule maker for everyday planning. With an intuitive reminder app, Masters makes managing your time, clients, and services simple and efficient.
Whether you run a hair salon, manage a nail salon, or work as an independent beauty professional, Masters easily adapts to your routine. The built-in appointment scheduler enables seamless booking appointments, while the crm keeps client details clear and easy to manage in one system. Use the scheduling app as your daily organizer with a smart calendar planner to stay on top of bookings and reduce missed appointments.
Why Masters is the best solution for beauty professionals and small businesses
• Smart scheduling tools — manage client bookings quickly and clearly within a single business calendar.
• Flexible planning features — organize services, shifts, and availability using a clear work schedule calendar.
• Built-in crm — keep client history, preferences, and notes stored in a clean, structured format.
• Reliable reminder app — automatic notifications work as an appointment reminder to help reduce no-shows.
• Advanced planning functionality — supports daily organization with an intuitive schedule maker.
• Simple organizer — replace spreadsheets with one convenient daily schedule planner.
Perfect for every beauty professional
Masters fits the needs of brow artists, nail specialists, hairstylists, and other experts who manage their own clients using a flexible calendar planner. Appointments and availability are organized through a clear business calendar, while a visual appointment scheduler and a simple to do list help keep daily work on track. Masters also works well for professionals in a hair salon or nail salon, where shared planning and coordination are part of everyday work.
Boost productivity with smarter planning
Masters is more than a simple scheduling app — it’s a complete organizer for professionals who value clarity. The crm works alongside the calendar planner to keep your day structured, while the reminder app ensures clients stay informed. With tools like a built-in schedule planner and to do list, your workflow stays clean and predictable.
Say goodbye to chaos and manual planning. Masters helps you:
• Automate booking appointments through a reliable appointment scheduler.
• Manage shifts and availability in a clear business calendar.
• Use the crm to track clients and services efficiently.
• Stay on track with a smart appointment reminder inside the reminder app.
• Plan flexibly and schedule anywhere with a modern scheduling app.
Designed for real workdays
Masters works as an agenda planner for busy professionals who need clarity in their daily routines. It functions as a practical work schedule planner, while the organizer keeps everything easy to manage in one place. As one of the most effective apps for schedule management, Masters helps hair salon, nail salon, and other beauty professionals stay organized and grow.
Join thousands of professionals who rely on Masters daily
With a powerful appointment scheduler, intuitive crm, and a dependable reminder app, Masters becomes a reliable organizer for everyday work. From managing schedules with a flexible calendar planner to handling booking appointments and daily tasks, this scheduling app helps you stay focused and work more efficiently.

Managing client bookings and schedules shouldn’t take extra time. Masters is a powerful appointment scheduler designed to help beauty professionals stay organized and focused. This all-in-one scheduling app brings together a smart calendar planner, a flexible organizer, and a reliable crm into a clear, structured workflow that also works as a practical schedule maker for everyday planning. With an intuitive reminder app, Masters makes managing your time, clients, and services simple and efficient.

Whether you run a hair salon, manage a nail salon, or work as an independent beauty professional, Masters easily adapts to your routine. The built-in appointment scheduler enables seamless booking appointments, while the crm keeps client details clear and easy to manage in one system. Use the scheduling app as your daily organizer with a smart calendar planner to stay on top of bookings and reduce missed appointments.

Why Masters is the best solution for beauty professionals and small businesses
•   Smart scheduling tools — manage client bookings quickly and clearly within a single business calendar.
•   Flexible planning features — organize services, shifts, and availability using a clear work schedule calendar.
•   Built-in crm — keep client history, preferences, and notes stored in a clean, structured format.
•   Reliable reminder app — automatic notifications work as an appointment reminder to help reduce no-shows.
•   Advanced planning functionality — supports daily organization with an intuitive schedule maker.
•   Simple organizer — replace spreadsheets with one convenient daily schedule planner.

Perfect for every beauty professional
Masters fits the needs of brow artists, nail specialists, hairstylists, and other experts who manage their own clients using a flexible calendar planner. Appointments and availability are organized through a clear business calendar, while a visual appointment scheduler and a simple to do list help keep daily work on track. Masters also works well for professionals in a hair salon or nail salon, where shared planning and coordination are part of everyday work.

Boost productivity with smarter planning
Masters is more than a simple scheduling app — it’s a complete organizer for professionals who value clarity. The crm works alongside the calendar planner to keep your day structured, while the reminder app ensures clients stay informed. With tools like a built-in schedule planner and to do list, your workflow stays clean and predictable.

Say goodbye to chaos and manual planning. Masters helps you:
•   Automate booking appointments through a reliable appointment scheduler.
•   Manage shifts and availability in a clear business calendar.
•   Use the crm to track clients and services efficiently.
•   Stay on track with a smart appointment reminder inside the reminder app.
•   Plan flexibly and schedule anywhere with a modern scheduling app.

Designed for real workdays
Masters works as an agenda planner for busy professionals who need clarity in their daily routines. It functions as a practical work schedule planner, while the organizer keeps everything easy to manage in one place. As one of the most effective apps for schedule management, Masters helps hair salon, nail salon, and other beauty professionals stay organized and grow.

Join thousands of professionals who rely on Masters daily
With a powerful appointment scheduler, intuitive crm, and a dependable reminder app, Masters becomes a reliable organizer for everyday work. From managing schedules with a flexible calendar planner to handling booking appointments and daily tasks, this scheduling app helps you stay focused and work more efficiently.

bluejetty:00161773:ios.description:
Embark on an endless underwater cooking journey - a mysterious world waiting to be explored.
⇪ Welcome to Cooking Aquarium - A Star Chef, an engaging cooking game with simple gameplay but endless fun. 
Have you ever imagined dining on delectable dishes while submerged beneath the surface of the water, surrounded by coral reefs and tiny fish? 
↪ Discover the amazing setting of Cooking Aquarium while dining at a distinctive network of undersea restaurants!
▶ HOW TO PLAY:
↥ Choose a restaurant: You'll have access to a few basic restaurants at the start of the game. As you progress, new restaurants with various cuisines and themes will become available to you.
↥ Prepare dishes: Customers will order meals from the menu, and it's your job to prepare and serve them. Be quick and efficient, as guests will become impatient to eat if you take too long.
↥ Upgrade your equipment and ingredients: You can upgrade your equipment and ingredients as you earn money. This will allow you to prepare delicious meals for diners more quickly and earn more money.
↥ Complete objectives: Each level has objectives that you need to complete, such as serving a certain number of customers or earning a certain amount of money ↝ Completing these objectives will earn you stars, which will unlock new levels.
↥ Use boosters: You can use boosters, such as extra time or double income, to help you complete levels more easily ↝ These boosters can be purchased with coins or gems.
↪ WHAT WILL YOU FIND MOST FASCINATING?
⌲ Underwater setting and interacting with sea creatures: The underwater setting offers a unique and visually stunning environment for players to explore.
⌲ Wide variety of restaurants: Chefs can choose from a number of restaurants with different themes and cuisines, each with its own unique delectable menu and challenges.
⌲ Plenty of yummy food: Burger, pizza, hotdog, french fries, sushi, king crab, lobster, beefsteak, ramen noodle, takoyaki, bento, ice cream, chicken, fast food,... Not only delectably cooked but also beautifully presented
⌲ Seafood cuisine: Make a variety of tasty seafood dishes, which can be different from other cooking games that focus on land-based cuisine.
⌲ Daily and weekly events: "Cooking Aquarium" regularly holds events that offer special rewards for players who participate.
Play exciting moments with "Cooking Aquarium - A Star Chef" today! ⇪

bluejetty:00151106:ios.description:
UPPR MGMT
A hair style is a first impression and a closing statement. It speaks volumes about who you’ve been, who you are and who you aspire to be, and every element of UPPR MGMT has been built around this core belief. 
Deciding to cater to the city’s diverse array of styles, the shop was created with the belief that great barbering should go beyond the simplified standard of a quick cut. Our goal has been to bring to life a shop that caters to the modern gentleman, understanding that this has become more a quality of character, and is no longer encompassed by one singular style. UPPR MGMT is a barbershop that delivers a high-quality barbering experience no matter the style. Whether you’re in for a quick fade or an intricate cut, your attention to detail is recognized by a welcoming lounge and a passionate hair-stylist whose priority is ensuring that you leave looking and feeling your best.
Our app let’s you book and pay for a haircut or shave in a few taps.
- Check availability and reserve a time slot that fits your schedule.
- Use your card on file to quickly and securely pay for your service and tip so you never need cash on hand.

bluejetty:00100068:ios.description:
Picture Block Jam — Slide, Match, and Reveal Beautiful Pictures!
If you love block puzzles, color block games, or relaxing blast-style brain teasers, this game is made for you. Picture Block Jam combines the joy of sliding colorful blocks with the satisfaction of completing beautiful pictures. Match, move, and reveal stunning scenes while training your brain in this relaxing yet challenging puzzle game.
Relax, Match, and Unwind
Slide and fit blocks into the right places to complete each picture. Every move matters — find the perfect spot, connect the colors, and watch the full image come to life!
With soothing sounds and calming visuals, Picture Block Jam is your perfect companion to unwind anytime, anywhere.
Brain-Training Puzzle Gameplay
Think ahead like a true block puzzle master! Plan your moves, use logic, and enjoy the satisfying “click” when the right pieces fit together.
Perfect for fans of classic block games, color block jam puzzles, or woodcraft-style puzzles — simple to play, but tough to master.
Reveal Hidden Stories
Each completed image uncovers a unique story — from peaceful landscapes to cozy homes, from cute animals to magical moments.
The more you play, the more stories you unlock. It’s not just a puzzle, it’s an artistic journey told through images.
Game Features
- Slide colorful blocks to complete stunning pictures

bluejetty:00139720:ios.summary: Step into the eerie world of "Mystical Riddles: Haunted Portraits," where suspense, mystery, and intrigue converge in these captivating f2p hidden object games. Armed with a unique camera that can reveal what lies beneath the surface, you’l
bluejetty:00139720:ios.description:
Step into the eerie world of "Mystical Riddles: Haunted Portraits," where suspense, mystery, and intrigue converge in these captivating f2p hidden object games. Armed with a unique camera that can reveal what lies beneath the surface, you’ll need to solve crimes and mysteries that have baffled everyone else. "Mystical Riddles" blends the best elements of mystery games and suspense games, offering players a chance to delve into a world filled with shadows, secrets, and hidden dangers. As you explore the gallery, you’ll encounter a series of complex challenges designed to test your skills as a detective!
You may not be a photographer, but you have the most extraordinary camera in your use, so you might as well learn something helpful by attending one of the exhibitions of the outstanding photographer Oliver Cook. It's quite strange since nobody had ever heard of this name before and suddenly the man became a true genius. The characters in his work really look so alive, as if they are about to step out of the frame and share a few secrets with you. Discover the secret of his unbelievable success and don't let it fade away with the appearance of ugly rumors about people disappearing in his celebrated gallery.
Unravel the Mystery!
Dive into the heart of the art gallery and join one of the most captivating mystery games available. Explore a world filled with lifelike portraits and solve crimes and mysteries that are guaranteed to captivate fans of suspense games. As a detective, every clue you find brings you closer to uncovering the truth!
Intricate Puzzles and Mini-Games!
"Mystical Riddles" offers a diverse array of challenges, from hidden object games to crime mystery games tasks. Each puzzle is crucial for detectives eager to solve crimes and mysteries. This magic mystery game combines suspense games with logic, ensuring a thrilling experience for those who love mystery games!
Make Impactful Choices!
In this casual game, your decisions as a detective will shape the storyline. The choices you make determine how you solve crimes and mysteries, leading to multiple endings. "Mystical Riddles" challenges you to think critically and act wisely to uncover the secrets hidden within this suspense game!
Play for Free!
Whether you’re a fan of mystery games, suspense games, or simply love to solve crimes and mysteries, this game provides endless entertainment. Optional in-game purchases are available to enhance your detective experience even further!
Can you unravel the riddle of the disappearing visitors before the gallery’s macabre beauty consumes you, or will you become another lost soul in this haunting world?
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00171211:ios.name: MyPlaces!
bluejetty:00171211:ios.summary: Did you ever need to remember a special place where you have been or have to plan an itinerary for one of your trips? MyPlaces is an application for iPhone and iPad that allows you to store, annotate, organize and share your favorite places
bluejetty:00171211:ios.description:
Did you ever need to remember a special place where you have been or have to plan an itinerary for one of your trips? MyPlaces is an application for iPhone and iPad that allows you to store, annotate, organize and share your favorite places in a simple and intuitive way.
Found an interesting place?
Save your current position with the auto location feature or use the search tool to find places far away from you searching by name or by GPS coordinates.
Attach notes and pictures
Assign a title to your places, include text notes and images that you can choose from your camera roll or take directly with the device camera.
Every place in the right folder
Keep all your places in order by organizing them into folders. For example, you are spending your holidays in London and you want to remember the most beautiful places you visited? Create a folder named "Holiday in London" and add the places in which you have been, perhaps attaching some nice pictures.
See your places the way you like
Choose whether to show your places on a map or a list. The list is customizable and allows you to choose which information to display. The map instead allows you to compare the places with your current position.
Export and share your places
Thanks to the export features of MyPlaces you can export or share your places in many formats.

Use Alertable for locations in Canada to stay aware and plan ahead. Check in advance for commun
bluejetty:00142909:ios.description:
Alertable emergency alerts and mass notifications keep you informed of emergencies and daily incidents in your community, workplace and school.
Use Alertable for locations in Canada to stay aware and plan ahead. Check in advance for community events, closures, restrictions, hazards, danger and more. Know before you go. Keep yourself and others informed and up to date with Alertable.
Notifications are fast, reliable and easy to see and hear. Personalize notifications by type and severity. Choose notifications for many locations including home, work, school, cottage, family and friends locations and more. Change your locations and other personalized options in Settings, after the fact.
Key features:
• Canada wide public safety alerts (from Canada’s Alert Ready emergency alert system)
• severe weather alerts (from Environment and Climate Change Canada)
• fast and reliable, highly optimized alert notifications
• easy to setup and use
• customizable, choose the types of critical, advisory and information alerts you wish to receive
• targeted, alerts for only locations you are interested in
• follow me, alerts for where you are at
• maps, helpful for seeing the geographical area the alert is for
• sharable, alerts can be shared on social media, email and text message
• informative, emergency descriptions, impact areas and actions to take to remain safe
• local, community notifications for closures, outages, restrictions, disruptions, re-openings,
Interruptions and more
• workplace, get alerts from your organization
• accessible, full use by people with different abilities
• multilingual, translate alerts into your device’s language setting
